## 1. 패키지, 데이터 불러오기
```{r}
keep_removed_figures <- FALSE   # 2026-10-20 원고에서 제거된 그림(FigureR*)을 다시 만들려면 TRUE
library(mixOmics)   # tidyverse보다 먼저 로드 : mixOmics::map이 purrr::map을 가리지 않도록
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(randomForest)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# 재현성 : fold 배정·bootstrap·random forest가 모두 set.seed에 의존하므로 RNG 종류를 고정
RNGkind("Mersenne-Twister", "Inversion", "Rejection")

# 섹션 10-8·11-8은 전역 객체(common_gene, proteome_mat, rna_mat, random_forest_trees)를
# 임시로 바꿔 앞 섹션 함수를 재사용하므로, 이 문서는 globalenv에서 knit되어야 한다
# (RStudio Knit 버튼 또는 rmarkdown::render(envir = globalenv())).
stopifnot(identical(environment(), globalenv()))

dir.create("table", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figure", showWarnings = FALSE)

save_table_fun <- function(
    df,
    filename,
    caption,
    digits = 3,
    landscape = FALSE,
    fontsize_pt = NULL
) {
  ft <- flextable(df) %>%
    colformat_double(digits = digits) %>%
    theme_booktabs() %>%
    bold(part = "header") %>%
    align(align = "center", part = "all")
  if (!is.null(fontsize_pt)) {
    ft <- ft %>% fontsize(size = fontsize_pt, part = "all")
  }
  ft <- ft %>%
    autofit() %>%
    fit_to_width(max_width = if (landscape) 9 else 6.5)

  doc <- read_docx()
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, caption, style = "heading 2")
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)
  if (landscape) {
    doc <- body_end_section_landscape(doc)
  }
  print(doc, target = file.path("table", filename))
}

save_figure_fun <- function(plot, filename, caption, width = 6.5, height = 4) {
  doc <- read_docx()
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, caption, style = "heading 2")
  doc <- body_add_gg(doc, value = plot, width = width, height = height)
  print(doc, target = file.path("figure", filename))
}

# 입력 데이터 폴더 : 기본값은 Rmd 기준 상대경로(공개 저장소용).
# 다른 위치를 쓰려면 환경변수 CPTAC_INPUT_DIR 로 지정 (예: Sys.setenv(CPTAC_INPUT_DIR = "D:/data/inputdata"))
input_dir <- Sys.getenv("CPTAC_INPUT_DIR", unset = file.path("..", "inputdata"))
if (!dir.exists(input_dir)) {
  stop("입력 데이터 폴더를 찾을 수 없습니다: ", input_dir,
       "\n  Rmd 상위 폴더에 inputdata/ 를 두거나 CPTAC_INPUT_DIR 환경변수를 지정하세요.")
}

clinical <- read.delim(file.path(input_dir, "HS_CPTAC_BRCA_2018_CLI.tsi"), header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

proteome <- read.delim(file.path(input_dir, "HS_CPTAC_BRCA_2018_Proteome_Ratio_Norm_gene_Median.cct"), header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

rna <- read.delim(file.path(input_dir, "HS_CPTAC_BRCA_2018_RNA_GENE.cct"), header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

batch <- read_excel(file.path(input_dir, "S039_Breast_Cancer_Prospective_Collection_Specimens_r1.xlsx"))
```

## 2. 분석 대상 정리 및 확인
```{r}
# 같은 환자-실험 조합의 반복 기재는 한 번만 count
# 서로 다른 TMT experiment에 배정된 동일 환자는 batch가 모호하므로 주 분석에서 제외

batch_1 <- batch %>%
  filter(`Sample Type` == "Tumor") %>%
  transmute(
    Sample.ID = case_when(
      !is.na(`Participant Protocol Identifier : Collection Protocol Registration`) ~
        paste0(
          "X",
          `Participant Protocol Identifier : Collection Protocol Registration`
        ),
      str_detect(`Specimen Label`, "^CPT") ~
        str_extract(`Specimen Label`, "CPT[0-9]+"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    TMT.experiment = as.character(`TMT experiments`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sample.ID), !is.na(TMT.experiment)) %>%
  distinct(Sample.ID, TMT.experiment)

multi_tmt_id <- batch_1 %>%
  count(Sample.ID, name = "N_TMT") %>%
  filter(N_TMT > 1) %>%
  pull(Sample.ID)

batch_2 <- batch_1 %>%
  filter(!Sample.ID %in% multi_tmt_id) %>%
  distinct(Sample.ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

clinical <- clinical %>% filter(Sample.ID != "IDX")
proteome <- proteome %>% filter(IDX != "IDX")
rna <- rna %>% filter(IDX != "IDX")

common_sample <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  list(
    clinical$Sample.ID,
    colnames(proteome)[-1],
    colnames(rna)[-1]
  )
)

if (
  anyNA(proteome$IDX) || anyNA(rna$IDX) ||
    anyDuplicated(proteome$IDX) || anyDuplicated(rna$IDX)
) {
  stop("RNA 또는 protein 원자료의 유전자명에 결측 또는 중복이 있습니다.")
}

common_gene <- intersect(proteome$IDX, rna$IDX)
proteome_mat <- proteome %>%
  filter(IDX %in% common_gene) %>%
  arrange(match(IDX, common_gene)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("IDX") %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(common_sample)) %>%
  as.matrix()

rna_mat <- rna %>%
  filter(IDX %in% common_gene) %>%
  arrange(match(IDX, common_gene)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("IDX") %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(common_sample)) %>%
  as.matrix()

normal_like_id <- clinical %>%
  filter(
    Sample.ID %in% common_sample,
    PAM50 == "Normal-like"
  ) %>%
  pull(Sample.ID)

clinical_data <- clinical %>%
  filter(
    Sample.ID %in% common_sample,
    PAM50 != "Normal-like"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.ID, PAM50, ESTIMATE.TumorPurity, Necrosis) %>%
  inner_join(batch_2, by = "Sample.ID") %>%
  mutate(
    PAM50 = factor(
      PAM50,
      levels = c("Basal", "Her2", "LumA", "LumB")
    ),
    TMT.experiment = factor(TMT.experiment),
    ESTIMATE.TumorPurity = as.numeric(ESTIMATE.TumorPurity),
    Necrosis = as.numeric(Necrosis)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample.ID, common_sample))

id_order <- clinical_data$Sample.ID

# 표·그림 표시용 subtype 라벨 (분석 내부값 Basal/Her2/LumA/LumB는 그대로 둠)
subtype_label <- c(
  Basal = "Basal", Her2 = "HER2", LumA = "Luminal A", LumB = "Luminal B"
)
proteome_mat <- proteome_mat[, id_order, drop = FALSE]
rna_mat <- rna_mat[, id_order, drop = FALSE]


# RNA와 protein이 분석 대상 전 표본에서 결측 없이 관측된 유전자만 남김
n_common_gene_before_filter <- nrow(proteome_mat)
gene_complete_rna <- rowSums(!is.finite(rna_mat)) == 0
gene_complete_protein <- rowSums(!is.finite(proteome_mat)) == 0
complete_gene <- rownames(proteome_mat)[
  gene_complete_rna & gene_complete_protein
]
if (length(complete_gene) < 2) {
  stop("RNA와 protein이 모든 분석 대상에서 완전한 유전자가 부족합니다.")
}
common_gene <- complete_gene
proteome_mat <- proteome_mat[common_gene, , drop = FALSE]
rna_mat <- rna_mat[common_gene, , drop = FALSE]

sample_flow_summary <- tibble(
  N_common_all_three = length(common_sample),
  N_excluded_normal_like = length(normal_like_id),
  N_excluded_multi_TMT = sum(
    clinical$Sample.ID %in% common_sample &
      clinical$PAM50 != "Normal-like" &
      !clinical$Sample.ID %in% batch_2$Sample.ID,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  N_analysis = length(id_order)
)
sample_flow_summary
# Table 1의 표본 흐름이 맞아떨어지는지 확인 (PAM50 결측·clinical 중복이 있으면 여기서 걸린다)
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(clinical$Sample.ID),
  sample_flow_summary$N_common_all_three -
    sample_flow_summary$N_excluded_normal_like -
    sample_flow_summary$N_excluded_multi_TMT ==
    sample_flow_summary$N_analysis
)

complete_gene_summary <- tibble(
  Common_genes_before_filter = n_common_gene_before_filter,
  Complete_genes_after_filter = length(common_gene)
)

# MAD 기반 산포 필터 : RNA 단독 상위 50% (주분석, 2026-09-09 결정)
#   사전 근거 : mismatch는 "RNA로 설명되지 않는 protein 잔차"이므로 입력 유전자 선택도
#   RNA 분산만을 기준으로 한다. protein 분산을 함께 조건으로 걸면, protein 변동이 RNA로
#   설명되지 않는 유전자(= mismatch가 큰 유전자)가 선택 단계에서 이미 우대·배제될 수 있어
#   결과와 무관해야 할 필터가 mismatch 크기에 의존하게 된다.
#   대안 설정(양쪽 상위 50% 교집합 / 필터 없음 / 양쪽 상위 2,000 교집합)은 섹션 10-8 민감도로 확인.
#   rna_mad_value / protein_mad_value 는 완전 유전자 전체(common_gene = complete_gene)에 대해
#   계산된 벡터이며 섹션 10-3·10-8·12에서 대안 유전자 집합을 만들 때 재사용된다.
n_gene_before_mad_filter <- length(common_gene)
rna_mad_value <- apply(rna_mat, 1, mad)
protein_mad_value <- apply(proteome_mat, 1, mad)
keep_mad_gene <- rna_mad_value >= median(rna_mad_value)
common_gene <- rownames(rna_mat)[keep_mad_gene]
proteome_mat <- proteome_mat[common_gene, , drop = FALSE]
rna_mat <- rna_mat[common_gene, , drop = FALSE]

mad_filter_summary <- tibble(
  Genes_before_MAD_filter = n_gene_before_mad_filter,
  Genes_after_MAD_filter = length(common_gene)
)
mad_filter_summary

stopifnot(
  identical(id_order, colnames(proteome_mat)),
  identical(id_order, colnames(rna_mat)),
  !anyDuplicated(id_order),
  !anyNA(clinical_data$PAM50),
  !anyNA(clinical_data$TMT.experiment)
)

analysis_batch <- clinical_data %>%
  count(TMT.experiment, name = "N") %>%
  arrange(N, TMT.experiment)

if (any(analysis_batch$N < 3)) {
  stop(
    "5-fold outer/3-fold inner TMT-safe CV에 표본이 부족한 batch가 있습니다: ",
    paste(analysis_batch$TMT.experiment[analysis_batch$N < 3], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# 제외 사유별 인원
excluded_sample_summary <- tibble(
  Reason = c(
    "Normal-like subtype",
    "Multiple TMT experiments or no unique TMT assignment"
  ),
  N = c(
    sample_flow_summary$N_excluded_normal_like,
    sample_flow_summary$N_excluded_multi_TMT
  )
)

table1_subtype <- clinical_data %>%
  count(PAM50, name = "N") %>%
  mutate(Percent = 100 * N / sum(N))

table1_covariate <- clinical_data %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    TumorPurity_missing = sum(!is.finite(ESTIMATE.TumorPurity)),
    TumorPurity_median = median(ESTIMATE.TumorPurity, na.rm = TRUE),
    TumorPurity_IQR = IQR(ESTIMATE.TumorPurity, na.rm = TRUE),
    TumorPurity_min = min(ESTIMATE.TumorPurity, na.rm = TRUE),
    TumorPurity_max = max(ESTIMATE.TumorPurity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Necrosis_missing = sum(!is.finite(Necrosis)),
    Necrosis_median = median(Necrosis, na.rm = TRUE),
    Necrosis_IQR = IQR(Necrosis, na.rm = TRUE),
    Necrosis_min = min(Necrosis, na.rm = TRUE),
    Necrosis_max = max(Necrosis, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

table1_subtype
table1_covariate
analysis_batch
excluded_sample_summary
complete_gene_summary

# Table1 : 위 5개 표(subtype 분포·공변량·TMT 배치·제외 사유·유전자 필터)
# 모두 코호트 특성을 설명하는 표라서 하나로 결합
table1_cohort <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Category = "Subtype (PAM50)",
    Item = unname(subtype_label[as.character(table1_subtype$PAM50)]),
    Value = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", table1_subtype$N, table1_subtype$Percent)
  ),
  tibble(
    Category = "Covariate",
    Item = c(
      "N",
      "Tumor purity, median (IQR) [range]",
      "Tumor purity, missing (n)",
      "Necrosis, median (IQR) [range]",
      "Necrosis, missing (n)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(table1_covariate$N),
      sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f) [%.3f–%.3f]",
        table1_covariate$TumorPurity_median,
        table1_covariate$TumorPurity_IQR,
        table1_covariate$TumorPurity_min,
        table1_covariate$TumorPurity_max
      ),
      as.character(table1_covariate$TumorPurity_missing),
      sprintf(
        "%.0f (%.0f) [%.0f–%.0f]",
        table1_covariate$Necrosis_median,
        table1_covariate$Necrosis_IQR,
        table1_covariate$Necrosis_min,
        table1_covariate$Necrosis_max
      ),
      as.character(table1_covariate$Necrosis_missing)
    )
  ),
  tibble(
    Category = "Excluded samples",
    Item = excluded_sample_summary$Reason,
    Value = as.character(excluded_sample_summary$N)
  ),
  tibble(
    Category = "Gene filter",
    Item = c(
      "Common genes (RNA and Protein) before filter",
      "Complete genes after 100% filter",
      "Genes after RNA MAD top-50% filter (analysis set)"
    ),
    Value = as.character(c(
      complete_gene_summary$Common_genes_before_filter,
      complete_gene_summary$Complete_genes_after_filter,
      mad_filter_summary$Genes_after_MAD_filter
    ))
  )
)
save_table_fun(
  table1_cohort,
  "Table1_Cohort_Characteristics.docx",
  caption = "Table 1. Cohort characteristics of the analysis sample."
)
```


## 3. Leakage-free 전처리 함수
```{r}
minimum_residual_df <- 10

as_numeric_matrix <- function(x) {
  matrix(
    as.numeric(x),
    nrow = nrow(x),
    ncol = ncol(x),
    dimnames = dimnames(x)
  )
}

# 각 split의 training 환자만으로 공변량 대체값·회귀계수·유전자 QC를 정함
# validation에는 그 규칙만 적용
mismatch_split_fun <- function(
    train_id,
    valid_id,
    min_df = minimum_residual_df,
    compute_r_squared = FALSE
) {
  train_index <- match(train_id, id_order)
  valid_index <- match(valid_id, id_order)
  if (anyNA(train_index) || anyNA(valid_index)) {
    stop("분석 대상에서 일부 train/validation ID를 찾을 수 없습니다.")
  }

  train_clinical <- clinical_data[train_index, , drop = FALSE]
  valid_clinical <- clinical_data[valid_index, , drop = FALSE]

  # 공변량 결측 -> training 중앙값으로 대체 (규칙은 training에서만 결정)
  purity_median <- median(train_clinical$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity, na.rm = TRUE)
  necrosis_median <- median(train_clinical$Necrosis, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(purity_median) || !is.finite(necrosis_median)) {
    stop("training에서 공변량 중앙값을 계산할 수 없습니다.")
  }
  train_clinical$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity[
    !is.finite(train_clinical$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity)
  ] <- purity_median
  valid_clinical$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity[
    !is.finite(valid_clinical$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity)
  ] <- purity_median
  train_clinical$Necrosis[!is.finite(train_clinical$Necrosis)] <- necrosis_median
  valid_clinical$Necrosis[!is.finite(valid_clinical$Necrosis)] <- necrosis_median

  # TMT 수준은 training 기준 (TMT-safe fold가 validation의 미관측 수준을 방지)
  tmt_levels <- unique(as.character(train_clinical$TMT.experiment))
  unseen_tmt <- setdiff(
    unique(as.character(valid_clinical$TMT.experiment)),
    tmt_levels
  )
  if (length(unseen_tmt) > 0) {
    stop(
      "training에 없는 TMT.experiment가 validation에 있습니다: ",
      paste(unseen_tmt, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  train_clinical$TMT.experiment <- factor(
    as.character(train_clinical$TMT.experiment), levels = tmt_levels
  )
  valid_clinical$TMT.experiment <- factor(
    as.character(valid_clinical$TMT.experiment), levels = tmt_levels
  )

  # 모든 유전자가 공유하는 공변량 설계행렬 Z
  covariate_terms <- character(0)
  if (nlevels(droplevels(train_clinical$TMT.experiment)) >= 2) {
    covariate_terms <- c(covariate_terms, "TMT.experiment")
  }
  if (n_distinct(train_clinical$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity) >= 2) {
    covariate_terms <- c(covariate_terms, "ESTIMATE.TumorPurity")
  }
  if (n_distinct(train_clinical$Necrosis) >= 2) {
    covariate_terms <- c(covariate_terms, "Necrosis")
  }
  z_formula <- if (length(covariate_terms)) reformulate(covariate_terms) else ~1
  z_train <- model.matrix(z_formula, data = train_clinical)
  z_valid <- model.matrix(z_formula, data = valid_clinical)[
    , colnames(z_train), drop = FALSE
  ]

  # 발현행렬 (표본 x 유전자)
  # 완전 유전자만 사용하므로 결측 대체가 없음
  protein_train <- t(proteome_mat[common_gene, train_id, drop = FALSE])
  rna_train <- t(rna_mat[common_gene, train_id, drop = FALSE])
  protein_valid <- t(proteome_mat[common_gene, valid_id, drop = FALSE])
  rna_valid <- t(rna_mat[common_gene, valid_id, drop = FALSE])

  qr_z <- qr(z_train)
  residual_df <- length(train_id) - qr_z$rank - 1L
  if (residual_df < min_df) {
    stop("mismatch 회귀의 잔차 자유도가 부족합니다 (residual df < ", min_df, ").")
  }

  # FWL: Z에 대해 protein·rna를 partial-out 후 유전자별 rna 기울기(beta) 계산
  protein_resid_train <- qr.resid(qr_z, protein_train)
  rna_resid_train <- qr.resid(qr_z, rna_train)
  protein_coef <- qr.coef(qr_z, protein_train)
  rna_coef <- qr.coef(qr_z, rna_train)
  protein_coef[is.na(protein_coef)] <- 0
  rna_coef[is.na(rna_coef)] <- 0
  protein_resid_valid <- protein_valid - z_valid %*% protein_coef
  rna_resid_valid <- rna_valid - z_valid %*% rna_coef

  rna_ss <- colSums(rna_resid_train^2)
  beta <- colSums(rna_resid_train * protein_resid_train) / rna_ss
  mismatch_train <- protein_resid_train - sweep(rna_resid_train, 2, beta, `*`)
  mismatch_valid <- protein_resid_valid - sweep(rna_resid_valid, 2, beta, `*`)

  # RNA(+공변량)가 protein 변동을 얼마나 설명하는지(R^2, 유전자별) 확인
  if (compute_r_squared) {
    protein_ss_after_covariate <- colSums(protein_resid_train^2)
    mismatch_ss_all <- colSums(mismatch_train^2)
    r_squared_all <- 1 - mismatch_ss_all / protein_ss_after_covariate
  }

  # 유전자 QC: rna가 공변량과 공선(rna_ss==0)/비유한/분산 0 이면 제외
  # 선택 규칙(keep)은 training 행렬만으로 정한다. validation은 규칙 적용 후 유한성만 검증.
  mismatch_center <- sweep(mismatch_train, 2, colMeans(mismatch_train))
  mismatch_sd <- sqrt(colSums(mismatch_center^2) / (length(train_id) - 1))
  collinear <- !(is.finite(rna_ss) & rna_ss > 0) | !is.finite(beta)
  nonfinite <- colSums(!is.finite(mismatch_train)) > 0
  zero_var <- is.finite(mismatch_sd) & mismatch_sd == 0
  keep <- !(collinear | nonfinite | zero_var)
  if (!any(keep)) {
    stop("training에서 QC를 통과한 mismatch 유전자가 없습니다.")
  }

  x_train <- mismatch_train[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  x_valid <- mismatch_valid[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  if (!all(is.finite(x_valid))) {
    stop("validation mismatch 행렬에 비유한값이 있습니다 (training 규칙 적용 후).")
  }
  colnames(x_train) <- common_gene[keep]
  colnames(x_valid) <- common_gene[keep]
  rownames(x_train) <- train_id
  rownames(x_valid) <- valid_id
  storage.mode(x_train) <- "double"
  storage.mode(x_valid) <- "double"

  list(
    x_train = x_train,
    x_valid = x_valid,
    selected_gene = common_gene[keep],
    r_squared = if (compute_r_squared) r_squared_all[keep] else NULL
  )
}

# RNA와 protein 원 발현값을 선택 유전자·표본으로 잘라 반환
# 완전 유전자 필터를 통과한 유전자만 쓰므로 결측 대체는 없음 (finite 여부만 확인)
expression_split_fun <- function(
    expression_mat,
    train_id,
    valid_id,
    selected_gene
) {
  train_gene <- as_numeric_matrix(
    expression_mat[selected_gene, train_id, drop = FALSE]
  )
  valid_gene <- as_numeric_matrix(
    expression_mat[selected_gene, valid_id, drop = FALSE]
  )
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(train_gene)), all(is.finite(valid_gene)))

  x_train <- t(train_gene)
  x_valid <- t(valid_gene)
  rownames(x_train) <- train_id
  rownames(x_valid) <- valid_id
  list(x_train = x_train, x_valid = x_valid)
}

prefix_split_fun <- function(split, prefix) {
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(split$x_train), colnames(split$x_valid)))
  new_name <- paste0(prefix, "__", colnames(split$x_train))
  colnames(split$x_train) <- new_name
  colnames(split$x_valid) <- new_name
  split
}

combine_split_fun <- function(split_list) {
  train_id <- rownames(split_list[[1]]$x_train)
  valid_id <- rownames(split_list[[1]]$x_valid)
  stopifnot(
    all(vapply(
      split_list,
      function(x) identical(rownames(x$x_train), train_id),
      logical(1)
    )),
    all(vapply(
      split_list,
      function(x) identical(rownames(x$x_valid), valid_id),
      logical(1)
    ))
  )
  list(
    x_train = do.call(cbind, lapply(split_list, `[[`, "x_train")),
    x_valid = do.call(cbind, lapply(split_list, `[[`, "x_valid"))
  )
}

# 같은 split에서 mismatch QC를 통과한 같은 유전자와 같은 환자로 3개 단일 모델과 4개 결합 모델의 입력 생성
all_modality_split_fun <- function(train_id, valid_id) {
  mismatch <- mismatch_split_fun(train_id, valid_id)
  selected_gene <- mismatch$selected_gene
  if (!length(selected_gene) || anyDuplicated(selected_gene)) {
    stop("선택 유전자가 없거나 중복되어 있습니다.")
  }

  rna_split <- expression_split_fun(
    rna_mat,
    train_id,
    valid_id,
    selected_gene
  )
  protein_split <- expression_split_fun(
    proteome_mat,
    train_id,
    valid_id,
    selected_gene
  )
  mismatch_split <- list(
    x_train = mismatch$x_train,
    x_valid = mismatch$x_valid
  )

  rna_prefixed <- prefix_split_fun(rna_split, "RNA")
  protein_prefixed <- prefix_split_fun(protein_split, "Protein")
  mismatch_prefixed <- prefix_split_fun(mismatch_split, "Mismatch")

  modality <- list(
    `RNA-only` = rna_split,
    `Protein-only` = protein_split,
    `Mismatch-only` = mismatch_split,
    `RNA-Mismatch` = combine_split_fun(
      list(rna_prefixed, mismatch_prefixed)
    ),
    `Protein-Mismatch` = combine_split_fun(
      list(protein_prefixed, mismatch_prefixed)
    ),
    `RNA-Protein` = combine_split_fun(
      list(rna_prefixed, protein_prefixed)
    ),
    `RNA-Protein-Mismatch` = combine_split_fun(
      list(rna_prefixed, protein_prefixed, mismatch_prefixed)
    )
  )

  expected_n <- length(selected_gene) * c(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
  observed_n <- vapply(modality, function(x) ncol(x$x_train), integer(1))
  stopifnot(all(observed_n == expected_n))

  list(
    modalities = modality,
    selected_gene = selected_gene
  )
}
```


## 4. 평가 지표와 TMT-safe fold
```{r}
subtype_levels <- c("Basal", "Her2", "LumA", "LumB")
subtype_by_id <- factor(clinical_data$PAM50, levels = subtype_levels)
names(subtype_by_id) <- id_order

batch_by_id <- setNames(
  as.character(clinical_data$TMT.experiment),
  id_order
)

model_names <- c(
  "RNA-only",
  "Protein-only",
  "Mismatch-only",
  "RNA-Mismatch",
  "Protein-Mismatch",
  "RNA-Protein",
  "RNA-Protein-Mismatch"
)
mtry_rule <- c(0.5, 1, 2)
outer_fold_number <- 5
inner_fold_number <- 3
random_forest_trees <- 500
bootstrap_repetitions <- 2000

rule_to_mtry_fun <- function(rule, p) {
  max(1, min(p, as.integer(round(rule * sqrt(p)))))
}


rule_mode_smallest_fun <- function(x) {
  frequency <- table(x)
  min(as.numeric(names(frequency)[frequency == max(frequency)]))
}

fit_random_forest_fun <- function(
    x,
    y,
    mtry,
    seed,
    importance = FALSE
) {
  set.seed(seed)
  randomForest(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    ntree = random_forest_trees,
    mtry = mtry,
    importance = importance
  )
}

classification_metrics_fun <- function(observed, predicted) {
  observed <- factor(observed, levels = subtype_levels)
  predicted <- factor(predicted, levels = subtype_levels)
  cm <- table(Observed = observed, Predicted = predicted)

  n_total <- sum(cm)
  true_positive <- diag(cm)
  observed_n <- rowSums(cm)
  predicted_n <- colSums(cm)
  sensitivity <- true_positive / observed_n
  specificity <-
    (n_total - observed_n - predicted_n + true_positive) /
    (n_total - observed_n)
  balanced_accuracy <- (sensitivity + specificity) / 2

  if (any(!is.finite(balanced_accuracy))) {
    stop("일부 subtype의 Balanced Accuracy를 계산할 수 없습니다.")
  }

  # 2026-11-02 (교수님 지시) : 주 지표를 macro F1으로 변경.
  # Precision = TP / (예측 n). 어떤 subtype을 한 번도 예측하지 않으면 0/0이 되므로
  # zero-division 규칙으로 0을 부여한다 (sklearn zero_division = 0 과 동일).
  # F1 = 2TP / (관측 n + 예측 n) 으로 계산하면 관측 n > 0 이므로 항상 정의되고,
  # 예측이 0건인 subtype의 F1은 자동으로 0이 된다 (precision 규칙과 일관).
  # Balanced accuracy는 그런 subtype에 0.5(specificity = 1)를 주어 실패를 가리는 반면,
  # F1은 0으로 드러낸다는 점이 지표 변경의 이유이다.
  precision <- ifelse(predicted_n > 0, true_positive / predicted_n, 0)
  f1 <- 2 * true_positive / (observed_n + predicted_n)

  accuracy <- sum(true_positive) / n_total
  expected_accuracy <- sum(observed_n * predicted_n) / n_total^2
  kappa <- (accuracy - expected_accuracy) / (1 - expected_accuracy)

  list(
    Overall = c(
      Macro_F1 = mean(f1),
      Macro_Balanced_Accuracy = mean(balanced_accuracy),
      Accuracy = accuracy,
      Kappa = kappa
    ),
    ByClass = tibble(
      Subtype = subtype_levels,
      Precision = as.numeric(precision),
      Recall = as.numeric(sensitivity),
      F1 = as.numeric(f1),
      Sensitivity = as.numeric(sensitivity),
      Specificity = as.numeric(specificity),
      Balanced_Accuracy = as.numeric(balanced_accuracy)
    ),
    Confusion_Matrix = cm
  )
}

metric_vector_fun <- function(observed, predicted) {
  classification_metrics_fun(observed, predicted)$Overall
}

# 주 지표 (2026-11-02 변경 : Macro_Balanced_Accuracy -> Macro_F1).
# inner-fold mtry 선택, 모든 사전 지정 paired 비교, 민감도 분석, 예산 스윕이 이 변수를 참조한다.
# MBA·Accuracy·Kappa는 보조 지표로 Table 2에 함께 보고하고, 마커 수준 one-vs-rest AUC(섹션 18~20)는 그대로 유지한다.
primary_metric <- "Macro_F1"
primary_metric_label <- "macro F1"
secondary_metrics <- c("Macro_Balanced_Accuracy", "Accuracy", "Kappa")

# 무정보 분류기 기준값 : MBA는 어떤 무정보 분류기든 0.5지만 macro F1은 그렇지 않으므로,
# 가장 흔한 subtype(Luminal A)만 예측하는 상수 분류기의 값을 참조 기준으로 함께 보고한다.
constant_majority_reference_fun <- function(observed) {
  observed <- factor(observed, levels = subtype_levels)
  majority <- names(which.max(table(observed)))
  metric_vector_fun(observed, factor(rep(majority, length(observed)), levels = subtype_levels))
}
constant_majority_reference <- constant_majority_reference_fun(subtype_by_id)
constant_majority_reference

# 한 batch의 표본을 fold에 가능한 한 고르게 분배
# subtype 수 균형화
create_tmt_safe_folds <- function(
    sample_id,
    k,
    min_training_per_batch = 1,
    seed = NULL
) {
  sample_id <- as.character(sample_id)
  k <- as.integer(k)
  min_training_per_batch <- as.integer(min_training_per_batch)
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  if (anyDuplicated(sample_id) || k < 2 || k > length(sample_id)) {
    stop("fold 생성용 ID 또는 k가 올바르지 않습니다.")
  }

  subtype <- as.character(subtype_by_id[sample_id])
  batch <- as.character(batch_by_id[sample_id])
  if (anyNA(subtype) || anyNA(batch)) {
    stop("fold 생성용 subtype 또는 TMT.experiment에 결측치가 있습니다.")
  }

  batch_n <- table(batch)
  feasible <- batch_n - ceiling(as.integer(batch_n) / k)
  if (any(feasible < min_training_per_batch)) {
    stop(
      "TMT-safe fold를 만들 수 없는 batch가 있습니다: ",
      paste(names(batch_n)[feasible < min_training_per_batch], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  safe_sample <- function(x) {
    if (length(x) <= 1) x else sample(x, length(x))
  }

  fold <- integer(length(sample_id))
  fold_n <- integer(k)
  subtype_in_split <- unique(subtype)
  fold_subtype_n <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = k,
    ncol = length(subtype_in_split),
    dimnames = list(NULL, subtype_in_split)
  )

  # split()은 크기(정수)를 factor로 변환하므로 이미 오름차순으로 반환된다
  batch_group <- split(names(batch_n), as.integer(batch_n))
  batch_order <- unlist(lapply(batch_group, safe_sample), use.names = FALSE)

  for (current_batch in batch_order) {
    batch_index <- which(batch == current_batch)
    subtype_n <- table(subtype[batch_index])
    # 위와 같은 이유로 split() 결과가 이미 오름차순이다
    subtype_group <- split(names(subtype_n), as.integer(subtype_n))
    subtype_order <- unlist(
      lapply(subtype_group, safe_sample),
      use.names = FALSE
    )
    ordered_index <- unlist(
      lapply(
        subtype_order,
        function(current_subtype) {
          safe_sample(batch_index[subtype[batch_index] == current_subtype])
        }
      ),
      use.names = FALSE
    )

    capacity <- rep(length(batch_index) %/% k, k)
    remainder <- length(batch_index) %% k
    if (remainder > 0) {
      extra_fold <- order(fold_n, runif(k))[seq_len(remainder)]
      capacity[extra_fold] <- capacity[extra_fold] + 1
    }

    for (current_index in ordered_index) {
      available <- which(capacity > 0)
      current_subtype <- subtype[current_index]
      candidate <- available[
        fold_subtype_n[available, current_subtype] ==
          min(fold_subtype_n[available, current_subtype])
      ]
      candidate <- candidate[fold_n[candidate] == min(fold_n[candidate])]
      selected_fold <- safe_sample(candidate)[1]

      fold[current_index] <- selected_fold
      fold_n[selected_fold] <- fold_n[selected_fold] + 1
      fold_subtype_n[selected_fold, current_subtype] <-
        fold_subtype_n[selected_fold, current_subtype] + 1
      capacity[selected_fold] <- capacity[selected_fold] - 1
    }
  }

  folds <- lapply(seq_len(k), function(i) which(fold == i))
  names(folds) <- paste0("Fold", seq_len(k))
  if (!identical(
        sort(unlist(folds, use.names = FALSE)),
        seq_along(sample_id)
      ) ||
      any(lengths(folds) == 0)) {
    stop("fold에 누락·중복 표본 또는 빈 validation fold가 있습니다.")
  }

  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    valid_index <- folds[[i]]
    train_batch_n <- table(
      factor(batch[-valid_index], levels = unique(batch))
    )
    train_subtype_n <- table(
      factor(subtype[-valid_index], levels = subtype_levels)
    )
    valid_subtype_n <- table(
      factor(subtype[valid_index], levels = subtype_levels)
    )
    if (any(train_batch_n < min_training_per_batch)) {
      stop("training의 TMT.experiment 최소 인원 조건을 위반했습니다.")
    }
    if (any(train_subtype_n == 0) || any(valid_subtype_n == 0)) {
      stop("일부 fold의 training 또는 validation에 없는 subtype이 있습니다.")
    }
  }

  folds
}

assert_tmt_safe <- function(train_id, valid_id, label) {
  unseen <- setdiff(
    unique(batch_by_id[valid_id]),
    unique(batch_by_id[train_id])
  )
  if (length(unseen) > 0) {
    stop(label, ": training에 없는 TMT.experiment가 validation에 있습니다.")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```


## 5. Leakage-free nested cross-validation
```{r}
# 공정한 비교를 위해 7개 모델은 같은 환자와 같은 outer/inner fold를 사용
outer_folds <- create_tmt_safe_folds(
  sample_id = id_order,
  k = outer_fold_number,
  min_training_per_batch = 2,
  seed = 123
)

# 7개 modality 모델의 nested CV 본체.
# 섹션 10-8(입력 유전자 필터)·11-8(나무 수)도 전역 설정만 임시로 바꾼 뒤 이 함수를 그대로 호출
# => 세 분석의 fold·seed 규약이 구조적으로 동일
run_modality_nested_cv_fun <- function(label = NULL) {
  outer_result <- list()
  outer_prediction <- list()
  result_index <- 0

  for (i in seq_along(outer_folds)) {
    message(if (is.null(label)) "" else paste0(label, ": "),
            "Outer fold ", i, "/", length(outer_folds))

    outer_valid_index <- outer_folds[[i]]
    outer_train_id <- id_order[-outer_valid_index]
    outer_valid_id <- id_order[outer_valid_index]

    inner_folds <- create_tmt_safe_folds(
      sample_id = outer_train_id,
      k = inner_fold_number,
      min_training_per_batch = 1,
      seed = 1000 + i
    )
    inner_score <- setNames(
      lapply(
        model_names,
        function(x) {
          matrix(
            NA_real_,
            nrow = length(inner_folds),
            ncol = length(mtry_rule),
            dimnames = list(NULL, as.character(mtry_rule))
          )
        }
      ),
      model_names
    )

    for (j in seq_along(inner_folds)) {
      inner_valid_index <- inner_folds[[j]]
      inner_train_id <- outer_train_id[-inner_valid_index]
      inner_valid_id <- outer_train_id[inner_valid_index]
      assert_tmt_safe(
        inner_train_id,
        inner_valid_id,
        paste0("Outer ", i, " / Inner ", j)
      )

      inner_data <- all_modality_split_fun(
        train_id = inner_train_id,
        valid_id = inner_valid_id
      )

      for (model_index in seq_along(model_names)) {
        model_name <- model_names[model_index]
        x_train <- inner_data$modalities[[model_name]]$x_train
        x_valid <- inner_data$modalities[[model_name]]$x_valid

        for (rule_index in seq_along(mtry_rule)) {
          current_mtry <- rule_to_mtry_fun(
            mtry_rule[rule_index],
            ncol(x_train)
          )
          fit <- fit_random_forest_fun(
            x_train,
            subtype_by_id[inner_train_id],
            current_mtry,
            seed =
              100000 + i * 1000 + j * 100 + model_index * 10 + rule_index,
            importance = FALSE
          )
          predicted <- predict(fit, newdata = x_valid)
          inner_score[[model_name]][j, rule_index] <-
            metric_vector_fun(
              subtype_by_id[inner_valid_id],
              predicted
            )[[primary_metric]]
        }
      }
    }

    best_rule <- setNames(numeric(length(model_names)), model_names)
    for (model_name in model_names) {
      mean_score <- colMeans(inner_score[[model_name]])
      best_rule[model_name] <- mtry_rule[which.max(mean_score)]
    }

    assert_tmt_safe(
      outer_train_id,
      outer_valid_id,
      paste0("Outer ", i)
    )
    outer_data <- all_modality_split_fun(
      train_id = outer_train_id,
      valid_id = outer_valid_id
    )
    for (model_index in seq_along(model_names)) {
      model_name <- model_names[model_index]
      x_train <- outer_data$modalities[[model_name]]$x_train
      x_valid <- outer_data$modalities[[model_name]]$x_valid
      current_mtry <- rule_to_mtry_fun(
        best_rule[[model_name]],
        ncol(x_train)
      )

      fit <- fit_random_forest_fun(
        x_train,
        subtype_by_id[outer_train_id],
        current_mtry,
        seed = 200000 + i * 100 + model_index,
        importance = FALSE
      )
      predicted <- predict(fit, newdata = x_valid)
      metric <- classification_metrics_fun(
        subtype_by_id[outer_valid_id],
        predicted
      )

      result_index <- result_index + 1
      outer_result[[result_index]] <- tibble(
        Model = model_name,
        Outer_Fold = i,
        N_Train = length(outer_train_id),
        N_Validation = length(outer_valid_id),
        N_Selected_Genes = length(outer_data$selected_gene),
        N_Predictors = ncol(x_train),
        Best_Mtry_Rule = best_rule[[model_name]],
        Best_mtry = current_mtry,
        Macro_F1 = metric$Overall[["Macro_F1"]],
        Macro_Balanced_Accuracy =
          metric$Overall[["Macro_Balanced_Accuracy"]],
        Accuracy = metric$Overall[["Accuracy"]],
        Kappa = metric$Overall[["Kappa"]]
      )
      outer_prediction[[result_index]] <- tibble(
        Model = model_name,
        Outer_Fold = i,
        Sample.ID = outer_valid_id,
        Observed = factor(
          subtype_by_id[outer_valid_id],
          levels = subtype_levels
        ),
        Predicted = factor(predicted, levels = subtype_levels)
      )
    }
  }

  list(
    results = bind_rows(outer_result) %>% arrange(Model, Outer_Fold),
    predictions = bind_rows(outer_prediction) %>% arrange(Model, Sample.ID)
  )
}

main_nested_cv <- run_modality_nested_cv_fun()
nested_cv_results <- main_nested_cv$results
nested_cv_predictions <- main_nested_cv$predictions

# 환자 x 모델 조합이 정확히 한 번씩만 예측되었는지
stopifnot(all(count(nested_cv_predictions, Model, Sample.ID)$n == 1))

nested_cv_results
```

## 6. Pooled 성능과 paired bootstrap 95% CI
```{r}
# outer-fold 예측을 모델별로 합친 confusion matrix

pooled_confusion_matrices

# 예측 long -> wide (섹션 10-8·11-8의 민감도 예측도 같은 함수로 정리)
prediction_wide_fun <- function(predictions) {
  wide <- predictions %>%
    transmute(
      Sample.ID,
      Observed = as.character(Observed),
      Model,
      Predicted = as.character(Predicted)
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = Predicted) %>%
    arrange(match(Sample.ID, id_order))
  stopifnot(
    identical(wide$Sample.ID, id_order),
    all(model_names %in% colnames(wide)),
    !anyNA(wide[, model_names, drop = FALSE])
  )
  wide
}

prediction_wide <- prediction_wide_fun(nested_cv_predictions)

bootstrap_observed <- factor(prediction_wide$Observed, levels = subtype_levels)
bootstrap_strata <- split(seq_along(bootstrap_observed), bootstrap_observed)

set.seed(260)
bootstrap_index <- replicate(
  bootstrap_repetitions,
  unlist(
    lapply(
      bootstrap_strata,
      function(index) sample(index, length(index), replace = TRUE)
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  ),
  simplify = FALSE
)

metric_names <- c(primary_metric, secondary_metrics)  # Macro_F1(주), MBA·Accuracy·Kappa(보조)

# 예측(wide) -> 모델별 point 지표 + bootstrap 지표 배열.
# 섹션 6·9·9B·10-8이 모두 아래 세 함수로 CI와 paired 차이를 만든다
# (bootstrap_index를 공유하므로 모든 비교가 동일 재표집 위에서 이뤄진다).
boot_metric_fun <- function(wide, models) {
  point <- t(vapply(
    models,
    function(m) metric_vector_fun(bootstrap_observed, wide[[m]]),
    setNames(numeric(length(metric_names)), metric_names)
  ))
  boot <- array(
    NA_real_,
    c(length(bootstrap_index), length(models), length(metric_names)),
    dimnames = list(NULL, models, metric_names)
  )
  for (b in seq_along(bootstrap_index)) {
    index <- bootstrap_index[[b]]
    for (m in models) {
      boot[b, m, ] <- metric_vector_fun(
        bootstrap_observed[index], wide[[m]][index]
      )
    }
  }
  list(point = point, boot = boot)
}

# 모델별 지표의 95% 백분위 CI
metric_ci_fun <- function(pm, models = rownames(pm$point),
                          metrics = metric_names) {
  map_dfr(models, function(m) map_dfr(metrics, function(met) tibble(
    Model = m, Metric = met,
    Estimate = pm$point[m, met],
    CI_Lower = quantile(pm$boot[, m, met], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
    CI_Upper = quantile(pm$boot[, m, met], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  )))
}

# 같은 재표집에서 짝지은 두 모델의 차이 + CI
paired_diff_fun <- function(pm, enhanced, baseline, metrics = metric_names) {
  map_dfr(metrics, function(met) {
    difference <- pm$boot[, enhanced, met] - pm$boot[, baseline, met]
    tibble(
      Comparison = paste(enhanced, baseline, sep = " - "),
      Metric = met,
      Estimate_Enhanced = pm$point[enhanced, met],
      Estimate_Baseline = pm$point[baseline, met],
      Difference = pm$point[enhanced, met] - pm$point[baseline, met],
      CI_Lower = quantile(difference, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
      CI_Upper = quantile(difference, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
    )
  })
}

main_metric <- boot_metric_fun(prediction_wide, model_names)

model_comparison_results <- metric_ci_fun(main_metric) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Metric,
    values_from = c(Estimate, CI_Lower, CI_Upper),
    names_glue = "{Metric}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = model_names)) %>%
  arrange(Model)
```

```{r}
# PCA => 시각화용 (mismatch 행렬을 유전자별 표준화한 뒤 적합: prcomp(scale. = TRUE))
# Mismatch Random Forest와 유전자 검정은 변수 중요도 및 후보 탐색용
# 고정효과 회귀식에 없던 새로운 TMT experiment의 외부 환자에 대한 일반화 성능은 이 내부검증으로 평가되지 않음

# 유전자별 R^2 = 공변량(TMT 배치·종양순도·괴사율)을 먼저 제거한 뒤,
#   남은 protein 변동을 RNA가 얼마나 설명하는지(= RNA의 부분 R^2)이다.
#   분모가 공변량 보정 후 protein 제곱합이므로 "RNA+공변량의 전체 R^2"가 아니다.
r_squared_by_gene <- full_mismatch$r_squared

  N_Genes = length(r_squared_by_gene),
  Median_R2 = median(r_squared_by_gene),
  Mean_R2 = mean(r_squared_by_gene),
  Pct_Genes_R2_below_0.1 = 100 * mean(r_squared_by_gene < 0.1),
  Pct_Genes_R2_above_0.5 = 100 * mean(r_squared_by_gene > 0.5)
)

) +

    xintercept = r_squared_summary$Median_R2,
    linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Partial R-squared of RNA (covariate-adjusted protein), per gene",
    y = "Number of genes",

  )

# PCA와 PC별 subtype 전체 차이 검정
pca_fit <- prcomp(mismatch_t, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_variance <- 100 * pca_fit$sdev^2 / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2)
names(pca_variance) <- paste0("PC", seq_along(pca_variance))
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample.ID") %>%
  mutate(Subtype = subtype_by_id[Sample.ID])

pca_tests <- map_dfr(
  c("PC1", "PC2"),
  function(component) {
    formula <- reformulate("Subtype", response = component)
    anova_table <- summary(aov(formula, data = pca_scores))[[1]]
    kruskal <- kruskal.test(formula, data = pca_scores)
    tibble(
      Component = component,
      Explained_Variance_Percent = pca_variance[
        match(component, names(pca_variance))
      ],
      ANOVA_F = anova_table[["F value"]][1],
      ANOVA_p = anova_table[["Pr(>F)"]][1],
      Kruskal_ChiSq = unname(kruskal$statistic),
      Kruskal_p = kruskal$p.value
    )
  }
)

pca_plot <- ggplot(
  pca_scores,
  aes(PC1, PC2, color = Subtype)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_discrete(labels = subtype_label) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pca_variance[1]),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pca_variance[2]),
    title = "Exploratory PCA of RNA–protein mismatch"
  )

# Figure1 : PCA 산점도
figure1_caption <- sprintf(
  paste(
    "Figure S4. Exploratory PCA of RNA-protein mismatch, colored by",
    "PAM50 subtype (PC1 %.1f%% variance, ANOVA p = %.2e;",
    "PC2 %.1f%% variance, ANOVA p = %.2e)."
  ),
  pca_tests$Explained_Variance_Percent[pca_tests$Component == "PC1"],
  pca_tests$ANOVA_p[pca_tests$Component == "PC1"],
  pca_tests$Explained_Variance_Percent[pca_tests$Component == "PC2"],
  pca_tests$ANOVA_p[pca_tests$Component == "PC2"]
)
save_figure_fun(
  pca_plot,
  "FigureS4_PCA_Mismatch.docx",
  figure1_caption,
  width = 7, height = 5.5
)
```

```{r}
# 중요도와 subtype 검정은 같은 전체자료를 사용하므로 확증적 biomarker가 아님
# subtype 검정과 BH 보정은 중요도 상위 유전자에 한정하지 않고 QC를 통과한 전체 mismatch 유전자에 적용
importance_result <- randomForest::importance(

  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene")

  stop("Mismatch-only Random Forest의 중요도 열을 찾을 수 없습니다.")
}

gene_anova_fun <- function(x, group) {
  group <- droplevels(factor(group, levels = subtype_levels))
  n_group <- table(group)
  group_mean <- tapply(x, group, mean)
  grand_mean <- mean(x)
  ss_between <- sum(as.numeric(n_group) * (group_mean - grand_mean)^2)
  ss_within <- sum((x - group_mean[as.character(group)])^2)
  df_between <- nlevels(group) - 1
  df_within <- length(x) - nlevels(group)
  ms_within <- ss_within / df_within
  f_value <- (ss_between / df_between) / ms_within
  p_value <- pf(f_value, df_between, df_within, lower.tail = FALSE)
  eta_squared <- ss_between / (ss_between + ss_within)
  c(
    F_value = f_value,
    p_value = p_value,
    Eta_squared = eta_squared
  )
}

anova_matrix <- t(vapply(
  seq_len(ncol(mismatch_t)),
  function(gene_index) {
    gene_anova_fun(
      mismatch_t[, gene_index],
      subtype_by_id[rownames(mismatch_t)]
    )
  },
  c(F_value = 0, p_value = 0, Eta_squared = 0)
))
rownames(anova_matrix) <- colnames(mismatch_t)

  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

  dplyr::select(Gene, MeanDecreaseAccuracy) %>%

# 7개 모델 전체표본 변수 중요도 비교 
# mismatch feature가 다른 modality와 함께 있을 때에도 분류에 사용되는지 보기 위함
# 7개 modality 모델 각각을 전체 표본에 1회 적합(나무 500그루, mtry=√p, seed = 300000 + model_index)

# rf_mismatch는 nested CV의 최빈 규칙(final_mtry_rule)을, 여기서는 modality 간 비교를 위해

  paste(
    "Figure S5. Top 10 features by random forest importance",
    "(MDA; ntree = 500, mtry = sqrt(p), scale = FALSE) in each modality model."
  ),
  width = 6.5, height = 8.5
)
# 모델별 상위 10개 feature의 subtype별 분포 boxplot
for (mi in seq_along(model_names)) {
  m <- model_names[mi]
  top_features <- model_importance_top10$Feature[
    model_importance_top10$Model == m
  ]
  x_top <- full_modality_data$modalities[[m]]$x_train[
    , top_features, drop = FALSE
  ]
  feature_labels <- str_replace(
    top_features, "^(RNA|Protein|Mismatch)__", "\\1: "
  )
  top_feature_long <- as.data.frame(x_top) %>%
    mutate(Subtype = subtype_by_id[id_order]) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Subtype, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Label = factor(
        str_replace(Feature, "^(RNA|Protein|Mismatch)__", "\\1: "),
        levels = feature_labels
      )

  top_feature_plot <- ggplot(
    top_feature_long,
    aes(Subtype, Value, fill = Subtype)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, outlier.size = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = subtype_label) +
    facet_wrap(~Label, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11)
    ) +
    labs(title = m, x = "Subtype", y = "Feature value")
if (keep_removed_figures)   save_figure_fun(
    top_feature_plot,
    sprintf(
      "FigureR1_%d_%s_Top10_Boxplot.docx", mi, gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "_", m)
    ),
    sprintf(
      paste(
        "Figure R1 (%d/7; removed from the manuscript 2026-10-20). Subtype-specific distributions of the top 10",
        "most important features in the %s model."

  )
}
```
