## 9. 통일 희소 선택(sPLS-DA/DIABLO) -> RF와 mismatch 기여 분석
```{r}
library(mixOmics)

# 9-0. 공통 설정
# 조합의 블록 수와 무관하게 총 feature 수를 30으로 고정한다(공정 비교의 전제).
#   [A] 균등 배분(주분석) : 30 / 15+15 / 10+10+10
#   [B] 데이터 주도(보조) : 블록 무관 상위 30개 (섹션 9B)
# ncomp = 3 : PAM50이 4-class이므로 판별축은 최대 K-1 = 3개.
sparse_ncomp          <- 3
sparse_total_keepx    <- 30      # [A][B] 조합당 총 feature 수 (블록 수와 무관)
sparse_pool_keepx     <- 30      # [B] 풀링 전 블록당·성분당 후보 수(블록 간 동일)
# 9B가 단일 블록 조합에 [A] 결과를 재사용하는 전제("수학적으로 동일")는 두 값이 같을 때만 성립
stopifnot(sparse_pool_keepx == sparse_total_keepx)
sparse_design_offdiag <- 0.1     # 판별 우선(X-Y 가중치 1 대비 1/10)
sparse_score_type     <- "cor"   # 성분 합집합 절단 시 순위 기준

sparse_block_key <- c(
  RNA = "RNA-only", Protein = "Protein-only", Mismatch = "Mismatch-only"
)
sparse_block_levels <- c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch")

sparse_combos <- list(
  "RNA-only(s)"              = "RNA",
  "Protein-only(s)"          = "Protein",
  "Mismatch-only(s)"         = "Mismatch",
  "RNA-Mismatch(s)"          = c("RNA", "Mismatch"),
  "Protein-Mismatch(s)"      = c("Protein", "Mismatch"),
  "RNA-Protein(s)"           = c("RNA", "Protein"),
  "RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s)"  = c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch")
)

# 9-1. 총예산을 블록에 균등 배분
#   나머지가 생기면 sparse_block_levels 순서로 1개씩 더 준다(결정적).
#   총 30 / 블록 1,2,3 => 30 / 15+15 / 10+10+10 (나머지 없음)
allocate_budget_fun <- function(total_keepx, block_names) {
  n_block <- length(block_names)
  per_block <- rep(total_keepx %/% n_block, n_block)
  remainder <- total_keepx %% n_block
  if (remainder > 0) {
    per_block[seq_len(remainder)] <- per_block[seq_len(remainder)] + 1L
  }
  stopifnot(sum(per_block) == total_keepx)
  setNames(as.integer(per_block), block_names)
}

# 9-2. 블록별 train/valid 행렬 준비
sparse_block_data_fun <- function(train_id, valid_id, block_names) {
  dat <- all_modality_split_fun(train_id, valid_id)
  list(
    x_train = setNames(lapply(
      block_names,
      function(b) dat$modalities[[sparse_block_key[[b]]]]$x_train
    ), block_names),
    x_valid = setNames(lapply(
      block_names,
      function(b) dat$modalities[[sparse_block_key[[b]]]]$x_valid
    ), block_names)
  )
}

# 9-3. 희소 적합 : 단일 블록 sPLS-DA / 다중 블록 DIABLO
#   keepx_by_block : 블록별 성분당 keepX (이름 있는 정수 벡터)
sparse_fit_fun <- function(block_train, y_train, keepx_by_block,
                           ncomp, design_offdiag) {
  block_names <- names(block_train)
  if (length(block_names) == 1L) {
    fit <- splsda(
      block_train[[1]], y_train,
      ncomp = ncomp, keepX = rep(keepx_by_block[[1]], ncomp)
    )
    return(list(
      loadings = setNames(list(fit$loadings$X), block_names),
      variates = setNames(list(fit$variates$X), block_names)
    ))
  }
  sparse_design <- matrix(
    design_offdiag, length(block_names), length(block_names),
    dimnames = list(block_names, block_names)
  )
  diag(sparse_design) <- 0
  fit <- block.splsda(
    X = block_train, Y = y_train, ncomp = ncomp,
    keepX = setNames(
      lapply(block_names, function(b) rep(keepx_by_block[[b]], ncomp)),
      block_names
    ),
    design = sparse_design
  )
  list(
    loadings = fit$loadings[block_names],
    variates = fit$variates[block_names]
  )
}

# 9-4. feature 중요도 점수
#   후보 = 성분 3개 중 하나라도 loading이 0이 아닌 feature(= 희소 선택 통과)
#   score_type = "loading" : 성분별 |loading|의 최댓값
#   score_type = "cor"     : |cor(원본 feature, 블록 성분 점수)|의 최댓값
#
#   block.splsda의 loading은 블록별로 성분당 L2 norm이 1로 정규화되므로,
#   블록마다 0이 아닌 개수가 다르면 |loading| 크기가 체계적으로 달라진다.
#   "cor"는 그 정규화와 무관한 스케일 자유 지표라 블록 간 비교에 안전하다.
sparse_feature_score_fun <- function(loading_matrix, x_block, variate_matrix,
                                     score_type = sparse_score_type) {
  candidate <- rownames(loading_matrix)[rowSums(loading_matrix != 0) > 0]
  if (!length(candidate)) return(numeric(0))
  if (identical(score_type, "loading")) {
    score <- apply(
      abs(loading_matrix[candidate, , drop = FALSE]), 1, max
    )
  } else if (identical(score_type, "cor")) {
    cor_matrix <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(
      x_block[, candidate, drop = FALSE], variate_matrix
    ))
    cor_matrix[!is.finite(cor_matrix)] <- 0
    score <- apply(abs(cor_matrix), 1, max)
  } else {
    stop("score_type은 'cor' 또는 'loading'이어야 합니다.")
  }
  setNames(as.numeric(score), candidate)
}

# 점수 내림차순 + 이름 오름차순으로 결정적 정렬 후 상위 n개
sparse_top_n_fun <- function(score, n) {
  if (!length(score)) return(character(0))
  names(score)[order(-score, names(score))][seq_len(min(n, length(score)))]
}

# 선택 결과를 RF 입력 행렬로 조립 (열 이름 = "Block__feature")
sparse_build_matrix_fun <- function(block_data, selected_by_block) {
  x_train_list <- list(); x_valid_list <- list()
  for (b in names(selected_by_block)) {
    selected <- selected_by_block[[b]]
    if (!length(selected)) next
    x_train <- block_data$x_train[[b]][, selected, drop = FALSE]
    x_valid <- block_data$x_valid[[b]][, selected, drop = FALSE]
    colnames(x_train) <- paste0(b, "__", selected)
    colnames(x_valid) <- paste0(b, "__", selected)
    x_train_list[[b]] <- x_train
    x_valid_list[[b]] <- x_valid
  }
  list(
    x_train = do.call(cbind, x_train_list),
    x_valid = do.call(cbind, x_valid_list)
  )
}

# 열 이름 접두사로 블록 구성 집계
sparse_composition_fun <- function(feature_name) {
  as.integer(table(factor(
    sub("__.*$", "", feature_name), levels = sparse_block_levels
  )))
}

# 9-5. [A] 균등 배분 선택기
#   블록당 예산 = 총 30 / 블록 수.
#   성분 3개의 합집합이 예산을 넘으면 점수 상위 예산개만 남긴다.
#   => 모든 조합에서 총 feature 수가 정확히 30.
sparse_select_fun <- function(train_id, valid_id, block_names,
                              ncomp = sparse_ncomp,
                              total_keepx = sparse_total_keepx,
                              design_offdiag = sparse_design_offdiag,
                              score_type = sparse_score_type) {
  block_data <- sparse_block_data_fun(train_id, valid_id, block_names)
  y_train <- subtype_by_id[train_id]
  per_block <- allocate_budget_fun(total_keepx, block_names)

  fit <- sparse_fit_fun(
    block_data$x_train, y_train, per_block, ncomp, design_offdiag
  )
  selected_by_block <- setNames(lapply(block_names, function(b) {
    score <- sparse_feature_score_fun(
      fit$loadings[[b]], block_data$x_train[[b]], fit$variates[[b]], score_type
    )
    sparse_top_n_fun(score, per_block[[b]])
  }), block_names)

  out <- sparse_build_matrix_fun(block_data, selected_by_block)
  stopifnot(ncol(out$x_train) == total_keepx)
  out
}

# 9-6. nested CV 러너 (섹션 5와 동일 구조·동일 fold·동일 seed 규약)
#   select_fun(train_id, valid_id) -> list(x_train, x_valid)
run_sparse_nested_cv_fun <- function(select_fun, model_index,
                                     seed_inner_base = 100000L,
                                     seed_outer_base = 200000L) {
  fold_list <- list(); pred_list <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(outer_folds)) {
    outer_valid_index <- outer_folds[[i]]
    outer_train_id <- id_order[-outer_valid_index]
    outer_valid_id <- id_order[outer_valid_index]
    inner_folds <- create_tmt_safe_folds(
      sample_id = outer_train_id, k = inner_fold_number,
      min_training_per_batch = 1, seed = 1000 + i
    )
    inner_score <- matrix(NA_real_, length(inner_folds), length(mtry_rule))
    for (j in seq_along(inner_folds)) {
      inner_valid_index <- inner_folds[[j]]
      inner_train_id <- outer_train_id[-inner_valid_index]
      inner_valid_id <- outer_train_id[inner_valid_index]
      assert_tmt_safe(inner_train_id, inner_valid_id,
                      paste0("Sparse outer ", i, " / inner ", j))
      d <- select_fun(inner_train_id, inner_valid_id)
      for (rule_index in seq_along(mtry_rule)) {
        inner_fit <- fit_random_forest_fun(
          d$x_train, subtype_by_id[inner_train_id],
          rule_to_mtry_fun(mtry_rule[rule_index], ncol(d$x_train)),
          seed = seed_inner_base + i * 1000 + j * 100 +
            model_index * 10 + rule_index
        )
        inner_score[j, rule_index] <- metric_vector_fun(
          subtype_by_id[inner_valid_id],
          predict(inner_fit, newdata = d$x_valid)
        )[[primary_metric]]
      }
    }
    best_rule <- mtry_rule[which.max(colMeans(inner_score))]
    assert_tmt_safe(outer_train_id, outer_valid_id, paste0("Sparse outer ", i))
    d <- select_fun(outer_train_id, outer_valid_id)
    outer_fit <- fit_random_forest_fun(
      d$x_train, subtype_by_id[outer_train_id],
      rule_to_mtry_fun(best_rule, ncol(d$x_train)),
      seed = seed_outer_base + i * 100 + model_index
    )
    outer_pred <- predict(outer_fit, newdata = d$x_valid)
    block_n <- sparse_composition_fun(colnames(d$x_train))
    fold_list[[i]] <- tibble(
      Outer_Fold = i,
      N_Predictors = ncol(d$x_train),
      N_RNA = block_n[1], N_Protein = block_n[2], N_Mismatch = block_n[3],
      Best_Mtry_Rule = best_rule,
      Macro_F1 = metric_vector_fun(
        subtype_by_id[outer_valid_id], outer_pred
      )[[primary_metric]]
    )
    pred_list[[i]] <- tibble(
      Outer_Fold = i, Sample.ID = outer_valid_id,
      Observed = factor(subtype_by_id[outer_valid_id], levels = subtype_levels),
      Predicted = factor(outer_pred, levels = subtype_levels)
    )
  }
  list(folds = bind_rows(fold_list), predictions = bind_rows(pred_list))
}

# 9-7. [A] 7개 조합 실행
sparse_pred_list <- list(); sparse_fold_list <- list()
for (combo_index in seq_along(sparse_combos)) {
  combo_name <- names(sparse_combos)[combo_index]
  combo_blocks <- sparse_combos[[combo_index]]
  run <- run_sparse_nested_cv_fun(
    select_fun = function(train_id, valid_id) {
      sparse_select_fun(train_id, valid_id, combo_blocks)
    },
    model_index = 10L + combo_index
  )
  sparse_fold_list[[combo_name]] <- run$folds %>% mutate(Model = combo_name)
  sparse_pred_list[[combo_name]] <- run$predictions %>% mutate(Model = combo_name)
  cat("[A] done:", combo_name, "\n")
}
sparse_predictions <- bind_rows(sparse_pred_list) %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, dplyr::everything())
sparse_fold_results <- bind_rows(sparse_fold_list) %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, dplyr::everything())

# 모든 조합에서 총 feature 수가 30으로 동일한지 확인
stopifnot(all(sparse_fold_results$N_Predictors == sparse_total_keepx))
sparse_fold_results


# bootstrap : 섹션 6의 bootstrap_index
sparse_prediction_wide <- prediction_wide
for (combo_name in names(sparse_combos)) {
  combo_pred <- sparse_predictions %>%
    filter(Model == combo_name) %>%
    transmute(Sample.ID, Predicted = as.character(Predicted))
  sparse_prediction_wide[[combo_name]] <-
    combo_pred$Predicted[match(sparse_prediction_wide$Sample.ID, combo_pred$Sample.ID)]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(sparse_prediction_wide[[combo_name]]))
}
sparse_model_names <- names(sparse_combos)
sparse_metric <- boot_metric_fun(sparse_prediction_wide, sparse_model_names)
sparse_model_comparison <- metric_ci_fun(sparse_metric)

# 사전 지정 3쌍 : mismatch 추가 효과 2개 + 핵심 비교 재현 1개
sparse_prespecified_pairs <- list(
  c("RNA-Mismatch(s)", "RNA-only(s)"),
  c("RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s)", "RNA-Protein(s)"),
  c("RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s)", "RNA-only(s)")
)
sparse_paired_comparisons <- purrr::map_dfr(
  sparse_prespecified_pairs,
  function(pair) paired_diff_fun(sparse_metric, pair[1], pair[2]) %>%
    dplyr::select(Comparison, Metric, Difference, CI_Lower, CI_Upper)
)

sparse_model_comparison %>% filter(Metric == primary_metric)
sparse_paired_comparisons %>% filter(Metric == primary_metric)

sparse_mtry_rule_by_fold <- sparse_fold_results %>%
  filter(Model == "RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s)") %>%
  arrange(Outer_Fold) %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, Outer_Fold, N_Predictors, Best_Mtry_Rule)
sparse_mtry_rule_by_fold
tibble(
  Model = "RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s)",
  Mtry_rule_by_outer_fold = paste(
    sparse_mtry_rule_by_fold$Best_Mtry_Rule, collapse = ", "
  ),
  N_distinct_rules = n_distinct(sparse_mtry_rule_by_fold$Best_Mtry_Rule)
)

save_table_fun(
  sparse_model_comparison %>%
    filter(Metric == primary_metric) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Metric),
  "Table5_Sparse_Model_Comparison.docx",
  paste(
    "Table 5. Classification performance (macro F1, primary metric) of the seven",
    "modality combinations under unified fold-internal sparse feature selection",
    "(single block: sPLS-DA; multi-block: DIABLO). The total number of selected",
    "features is fixed at 30 for every combination and split equally across",
    "blocks (30; 15+15; 10+10+10), so all seven models enter the random forest",
    "with an identical predictor count. 95% CIs from 2,000 stratified bootstrap",
    "resamples."
  )
)
save_table_fun(
  sparse_paired_comparisons %>%
    filter(Metric == primary_metric) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Metric),
  "Table6_Sparse_Paired_Comparisons.docx",
  paste(
    "Table 6. Pre-specified paired comparisons under unified sparse selection",
    "with a fixed total budget of 30 features per combination.",
    "Differences and 95% CIs from paired bootstrap on shared resample indices."
  )
)

# mismatch 기여: 전체 표본 최종 3-block 모형의 RF importance
# MDA(permutation importance)의 순위 안정성을 위해 ntree = 2000.
final_sparse <- sparse_select_fun(id_order, id_order, c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch"))
# mtry는 다른 전체표본 모델(Figure S5)과 같은 규약 rule = 1 (= round(sqrt(p)))로 명시한다.
# p = 30 이면 5로, randomForest 기본값 floor(sqrt(p))와 같지만 규약을 코드로 고정해 둔다.
final_sparse_mtry <- rule_to_mtry_fun(1, ncol(final_sparse$x_train))
set.seed(777)
final_sparse_rf <- randomForest(
  x = final_sparse$x_train,
  y = factor(subtype_by_id[id_order], levels = subtype_levels),
  ntree = 2000, mtry = final_sparse_mtry, importance = TRUE
)
sparse_importance <- as.data.frame(importance(final_sparse_rf))
sparse_importance$Feature <- rownames(sparse_importance)
sparse_importance$Block <- sub("__.*$", "", sparse_importance$Feature)
sparse_importance_table <- as_tibble(sparse_importance) %>%
  dplyr::select(Feature, Block, MDA = MeanDecreaseAccuracy) %>%
  arrange(desc(MDA))

sparse_block_importance <- sparse_importance_table %>%
  group_by(Block) %>%
  summarise(
    N_selected = dplyr::n(),
    Selected_share = dplyr::n() / nrow(sparse_importance_table),
    Mean_MDA = mean(MDA), Median_MDA = median(MDA),
    N_in_top10 = sum(Feature %in% head(sparse_importance_table$Feature, 10)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_MDA))
sparse_block_importance
sparse_importance_table

save_table_fun(
  sparse_block_importance,
  "Table7_Mismatch_Importance.docx",
  paste(
    "Table 7. Modality-level summary of random-forest permutation importance",
    sprintf("(mean decrease in accuracy, ntree = 2,000, mtry = %d = round(sqrt(p)))",
            final_sparse_mtry),
    "in the final full-sample three-block DIABLO-selected model with a fixed",
    "total budget of 30 features (10 per block). Selection counts are fixed by design; the",
    "data-driven allocation is reported separately in Table 8. MDA values are",
    "scaled by their standard errors (randomForest::importance() default,",
    "scale = TRUE) and are therefore unitless; Table S17 and the exploratory",
    "importance analyses report unscaled values (scale = FALSE)."
  )
)

# 선택된 feature 개별 목록과 중요도 (Table 7의 근거 자료)
# Table 7은 이 표를 블록 단위로 요약한 것이다.
sparse_feature_importance_table <- sparse_importance_table %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    Gene = sub("^.*__", "", Feature)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Rank, Gene, Block, MDA)
sparse_feature_importance_table

save_table_fun(
  sparse_feature_importance_table,
  "TableS10_Final_Model_Feature_Importance.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S10. All features selected by the final full-sample three-block",
    "DIABLO model, ranked by random-forest permutation importance (mean",
    sprintf("decrease in accuracy, ntree = 2,000, mtry = %d, scale = TRUE and therefore",
            final_sparse_mtry),
    "unitless). Table 7 summarises the same values by modality block."
  ),
  digits = 3,
  fontsize_pt = 8
)
```


## 9B. 데이터 주도 배분(블록 무관 상위 30개) : mismatch가 실제로 선택되는가
```{r}
# [A]는 블록별 개수를 설계로 고정하므로 기여도의 증거가 되지 못한다(Table 7 한계).
# 여기서는 블록당 keepX를 30으로 동일하게 맞춰 적합한 뒤, 세 블록 후보를 한 줄로
# 세워 상위 30개만 남긴다 => 살아남은 mismatch 개수가 기여도의 직접 증거.
# 순위 기준은 cor·loading 둘 다 계산(결론이 기준에 좌우되지 않는지 확인).
# 단일 블록 조합은 [A]와 수학적으로 동일하므로 섹션 9 결과를 재사용.
sparse_score_types <- c("cor", "loading")
sparse_multiblock_combos <- sparse_combos[lengths(sparse_combos) >= 2L]

# 한 번의 적합에서 여러 순위 기준의 선택 결과를 동시에 산출
sparse_pooled_core_fun <- function(train_id, valid_id, block_names,
                                   score_types = sparse_score_types,
                                   ncomp = sparse_ncomp,
                                   total_keepx = sparse_total_keepx,
                                   pool_keepx = sparse_pool_keepx,
                                   design_offdiag = sparse_design_offdiag) {
  stopifnot(length(block_names) >= 2L)
  block_data <- sparse_block_data_fun(train_id, valid_id, block_names)
  y_train <- subtype_by_id[train_id]
  keepx_by_block <- setNames(rep(pool_keepx, length(block_names)), block_names)

  fit <- sparse_fit_fun(
    block_data$x_train, y_train, keepx_by_block, ncomp, design_offdiag
  )

  setNames(lapply(score_types, function(st) {
    score_table <- purrr::map_dfr(block_names, function(b) {
      score <- sparse_feature_score_fun(
        fit$loadings[[b]], block_data$x_train[[b]], fit$variates[[b]], st
      )
      tibble(Block = b, Feature = names(score), Score = as.numeric(score))
    })
    top_table <- score_table %>%
      arrange(desc(Score), Block, Feature) %>%
      head(total_keepx)
    stopifnot(nrow(top_table) == total_keepx)
    selected_by_block <- split(top_table$Feature, top_table$Block)
    out <- sparse_build_matrix_fun(block_data, selected_by_block)
    out$selected <- top_table
    out
  }), score_types)
}

# 러너에 넘길 단일 기준 선택기
sparse_select_pooled_fun <- function(train_id, valid_id, block_names, score_type) {
  sparse_pooled_core_fun(
    train_id, valid_id, block_names, score_types = score_type
  )[[score_type]]
}

# 데이터 주도 배분 모형 이름 : "(s)"(균등 배분) -> "(p)"(pooled, 데이터 주도)
pooled_name_fun <- function(x) paste0(sub("\\(s\\)$", "", x), "(p)")

# 9B-1. 다중 블록 4개 조합 x 순위 기준 2개 nested CV
#   seed base를 섹션 5·7·8·9[A]와 겹치지 않는 대역(300000/400000)으로 옮긴다.
#   (참고: 섹션 9[A]는 섹션 5와 같은 base 100000을 쓰므로 inner-fold seed가 부분적으로
#    겹친다. 입력 행렬이 달라 같은 모델이 만들어지지는 않으며 결과 타당성과 무관하지만,
#    완전 분리하려면 seed 자릿수를 바꿔야 하고 그러면 섹션 9~10B 수치가 모두 바뀐다.)
pooled_fold_list <- list(); pooled_pred_list <- list()
for (score_type in sparse_score_types) {
  for (combo_index in seq_along(sparse_multiblock_combos)) {
    combo_name <- names(sparse_multiblock_combos)[combo_index]
    combo_blocks <- sparse_multiblock_combos[[combo_index]]
    model_index <- 20L + combo_index +
      10L * (match(score_type, sparse_score_types) - 1L)
    run <- run_sparse_nested_cv_fun(
      select_fun = function(train_id, valid_id) {
        sparse_select_pooled_fun(train_id, valid_id, combo_blocks, score_type)
      },
      model_index = model_index,
      seed_inner_base = 300000L, seed_outer_base = 400000L
    )
    key <- paste(combo_name, score_type)
    pooled_fold_list[[key]] <- run$folds %>%
      mutate(Model = combo_name, Score_Criterion = score_type)
    pooled_pred_list[[key]] <- run$predictions %>%
      mutate(Model = combo_name, Score_Criterion = score_type)
    cat("[B] done:", combo_name, "/", score_type, "\n")
  }
}
pooled_fold_results <- bind_rows(pooled_fold_list) %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, Score_Criterion, dplyr::everything())
pooled_predictions <- bind_rows(pooled_pred_list) %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, Score_Criterion, dplyr::everything())
stopifnot(all(pooled_fold_results$N_Predictors == sparse_total_keepx))
pooled_fold_results

# 9B-2. 핵심 결과 : outer fold별 블록 구성
#   "총 30개를 자유롭게 쓰게 했을 때 mismatch가 몇 개 선택되는가"
combo_block_table <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(sparse_multiblock_combos),
  function(m) tibble(Model = m, Block = sparse_multiblock_combos[[m]])
)

pooled_composition_summary <- pooled_fold_results %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(N_RNA, N_Protein, N_Mismatch),
    names_to = "Block", values_to = "N_selected"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Block = sub("^N_", "", Block)) %>%
  inner_join(combo_block_table, by = c("Model", "Block")) %>%
  group_by(Model, Score_Criterion, Block) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_N = mean(N_selected), Min_N = min(N_selected), Max_N = max(N_selected),
    Mean_share = mean(N_selected) / sparse_total_keepx,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Model, Score_Criterion, desc(Mean_N)) %>%
  mutate(Model = pooled_name_fun(Model))   # 데이터 주도 배분이므로 (p)
pooled_composition_summary

save_table_fun(
  pooled_composition_summary,
  "Table8_Pooled_Block_Composition.docx",
  paste(
    "Table 8. Data-driven allocation of a fixed 30-feature budget across",
    "modality blocks. For each multi-block combination, sparse selection was",
    "fitted with an identical per-block keepX and the 30 highest-scoring",
    "features were then retained irrespective of block, separately in each",
    "outer-fold training set. Values are the mean (and range) number of",
    "features contributed by each block across the five outer folds; the",
    "mismatch column is the direct evidence of mismatch contribution, since",
    "it is estimated rather than fixed by design. Two ranking criteria are",
    "reported: 'cor' = maximum absolute correlation between the feature and",
    "the block components, 'loading' = maximum absolute sparse loading."
  )
)

# 9B-3. [B] 조건의 성능과 사전 지정 paired 비교
#   단일 블록 조합은 [A]와 동일하므로 섹션 9의 예측을 그대로 재사용.
pooled_model_names <- c(
  "RNA-only(s)", "Protein-only(s)", "Mismatch-only(s)",
  pooled_name_fun(names(sparse_multiblock_combos))
)
pooled_prediction_wide <- prediction_wide
for (m in c("RNA-only(s)", "Protein-only(s)", "Mismatch-only(s)")) {
  pooled_prediction_wide[[m]] <- sparse_prediction_wide[[m]]
}

pooled_metric_by_criterion <- list()
for (score_type in sparse_score_types) {
  wide <- pooled_prediction_wide
  for (combo_name in names(sparse_multiblock_combos)) {
    pooled_name <- pooled_name_fun(combo_name)
    combo_pred <- pooled_predictions %>%
      filter(Model == combo_name, Score_Criterion == score_type) %>%
      transmute(Sample.ID, Predicted = as.character(Predicted))
    wide[[pooled_name]] <-
      combo_pred$Predicted[match(wide$Sample.ID, combo_pred$Sample.ID)]
    stopifnot(!anyNA(wide[[pooled_name]]))
  }
  pooled_metric_by_criterion[[score_type]] <-
    boot_metric_fun(wide, pooled_model_names)
}

pooled_model_comparison <- purrr::map_dfr(sparse_score_types, function(st) {
  metric_ci_fun(
    pooled_metric_by_criterion[[st]], pooled_model_names,
    primary_metric
  ) %>%
    transmute(Score_Criterion = st, Model, Estimate, CI_Lower, CI_Upper)
})
pooled_model_comparison

pooled_prespecified_pairs <- list(
  c("RNA-Mismatch(p)", "RNA-only(s)"),
  c("RNA-Protein-Mismatch(p)", "RNA-Protein(p)"),
  c("RNA-Protein-Mismatch(p)", "RNA-only(s)")
)
stopifnot(all(unlist(pooled_prespecified_pairs) %in% pooled_model_names))
pooled_paired_comparisons <- purrr::map_dfr(sparse_score_types, function(st) {
  purrr::map_dfr(pooled_prespecified_pairs, function(pair) {
    paired_diff_fun(
      pooled_metric_by_criterion[[st]], pair[1], pair[2],
      primary_metric
    ) %>%
      transmute(Score_Criterion = st, Comparison, Difference, CI_Lower, CI_Upper)
  })
})
pooled_paired_comparisons

save_table_fun(
  pooled_model_comparison,
  "TableS5_Pooled_Model_Comparison.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S5. Classification performance under a data-driven allocation of a",
    "fixed 30-feature budget (suffix '(p)'), compared with the equal-split",
    "results for the single-block models (suffix '(s)'), which are identical",
    "under both allocation rules. 95% CIs from 2,000 stratified bootstrap",
    "resamples on the same resample indices used throughout."
  )
)
save_table_fun(
  pooled_paired_comparisons,
  "TableS6_Pooled_Paired_Comparisons.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S6. Pre-specified paired comparisons under the data-driven",
    "allocation of a fixed 30-feature budget. Differences and 95% CIs from",
    "paired bootstrap on shared resample indices."
  )
)

# 9B-4. 두 순위 기준의 일치도
#   같은 적합에서 선택된 상위 30개가 기준에 따라 얼마나 겹치는지.
pooled_agreement <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(sparse_multiblock_combos), function(combo_name) {
    combo_blocks <- sparse_multiblock_combos[[combo_name]]
    purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(outer_folds), function(i) {
      outer_train_id <- id_order[-outer_folds[[i]]]
      both <- sparse_pooled_core_fun(
        outer_train_id, outer_train_id, combo_blocks
      )
      key_fun <- function(x) paste(x$selected$Block, x$selected$Feature)
      set_cor <- key_fun(both[["cor"]]); set_loading <- key_fun(both[["loading"]])
      tibble(
        Model = combo_name, Outer_Fold = i,
        N_overlap = length(intersect(set_cor, set_loading)),
        Jaccard = length(intersect(set_cor, set_loading)) /
          length(union(set_cor, set_loading))
      )
    })
  }
)
pooled_agreement_summary <- pooled_agreement %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_N_overlap = mean(N_overlap), Min_N_overlap = min(N_overlap),
    Mean_Jaccard = mean(Jaccard), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Model = pooled_name_fun(Model))   # 데이터 주도 배분이므로 (p)
pooled_agreement_summary

save_table_fun(
  pooled_agreement_summary,
  "TableS7_Pooled_Score_Agreement.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S7. Agreement between the two ranking criteria used to allocate the",
    "fixed 30-feature budget across blocks. For each outer-fold training set,",
    "the top-30 sets obtained by maximum absolute correlation and by maximum",
    "absolute sparse loading were compared (overlap count out of 30 and",
    "Jaccard index), fitted once per fold so that both criteria are derived",
    "from the identical sparse model."
  )
)
```
## 10. 희소 선택 초모수·입력 필터 민감도 분석
```{r}

# 비교 대상 : 3-block(RNA-Protein-Mismatch) 모형
# 기준선 : [섹션 9]"RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s)" (총예산 30 = 10+10+10, design 0.1, RNA MAD 상위 50% 입력)
# RF seed 규약(model_index = 17)도 기준선과 동일하게 설정
# => 설정 간에 달라지는 것이 희소 선택 초모수(또는 입력 유전자 집합) 하나뿐이 되도록 통제

# 10-1. (정리) 별도 함수 없이 섹션 9의 sparse_select_fun을 초모수 인자와 함께 재사용한다.

# 10-2. 설정 하나를 nested CV로 돌려 outer-fold 예측을 얻는 함수 
# gene_set을 주면 그 유전자 집합으로 common_gene을 잠시 바꿔 실행
# 함수가 끝날 때 on.exit로 원래 값으로 돌아가도록 설정
run_sparse_sensitivity_fun <- function(setting_label,
                                       total_keepx = sparse_total_keepx,
                                       design_offdiag = sparse_design_offdiag,
                                       gene_set = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(gene_set)) {
    gene_backup <- get("common_gene", envir = globalenv())
    assign("common_gene", gene_set, envir = globalenv())
    on.exit(assign("common_gene", gene_backup, envir = globalenv()), add = TRUE)
  }
  cv <- run_sparse_nested_cv_fun(
    select_fun = function(train_id, valid_id) {
      sparse_select_fun(
        train_id, valid_id, c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch"),
        total_keepx = total_keepx, design_offdiag = design_offdiag
      )
    },
    model_index = 17L  # 섹션 9의 3-block과 동일한 RF seed 규약
  )
  predicted_vector <- as.character(cv$predictions$Predicted)[
    match(prediction_wide$Sample.ID, cv$predictions$Sample.ID)
  ]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(predicted_vector))
  cat("sensitivity done:", setting_label, "\n")
  list(Setting = setting_label, Predicted = predicted_vector)
}

# 10-3. 입력 필터 민감도용 대안 유전자 집합
# rna_mad_value / protein_mad_value는 섹션 2에서 MAD 필터를 적용하기 "전"의
# 완전 유전자 전체(5,940개)에 대해 계산된 벡터 => 그대로 재사용 가능
#   (a) 양쪽 MAD 상위 50% 교집합(구 주분석 설정) : RNA 상위 50%의 부분집합
#   (b) 양쪽 상위 2,000개 교집합 : RNA 상위 2,000개가 상위 50%(2,970개)의 부분집합이므로 역시 부분집합
# 두 집합 모두 섹션 2의 필터 통과 유전자(common_gene) 안에 포함되므로 발현 행렬 교체 없이
# common_gene만 바꿔 sparse 민감도(10-4)를 돌릴 수 있다.
both_mad_gene <- names(rna_mad_value)[
  rna_mad_value >= median(rna_mad_value) &
    protein_mad_value >= median(protein_mad_value)
]
top2000_rna_gene <- names(rna_mad_value)[
  rank(-rna_mad_value, ties.method = "first") <= 2000
]
top2000_protein_gene <- names(protein_mad_value)[
  rank(-protein_mad_value, ties.method = "first") <= 2000
]
top2000_gene <- intersect(top2000_rna_gene, top2000_protein_gene)
stopifnot(
  length(both_mad_gene) > 0, all(both_mad_gene %in% common_gene),
  length(top2000_gene) > 0, all(top2000_gene %in% common_gene)
)

gene_filter_set_summary <- tibble(
  Genes_RNA_MAD_top50 = length(common_gene),
  Genes_both_MAD_top50 = length(both_mad_gene),
  Genes_top2000_RNA = length(top2000_rna_gene),
  Genes_top2000_Protein = length(top2000_protein_gene),
  Genes_top2000_intersection = length(top2000_gene)
)
gene_filter_set_summary

# 10-4. 여섯 개 설정 실행
sparse_sensitivity_settings <- list(
  list(label = "design 0.5",        total_keepx = 30, design = 0.5, genes = NULL),
  list(label = "design 1.0",        total_keepx = 30, design = 1.0, genes = NULL),
  list(label = "Total budget 15",   total_keepx = 15, design = 0.1, genes = NULL),
  list(label = "Total budget 60",   total_keepx = 60, design = 0.1, genes = NULL),
  list(label = "Both-modality MAD top-50% filter",
       total_keepx = 30, design = 0.1, genes = both_mad_gene),
  list(label = "Top-2000 intersection filter",
       total_keepx = 30, design = 0.1, genes = top2000_gene)
)

sparse_sensitivity_runs <- lapply(sparse_sensitivity_settings, function(s) {
  run_sparse_sensitivity_fun(
    s$label, total_keepx = s$total_keepx, design_offdiag = s$design,
    gene_set = s$genes
  )
})

# gene_set 임시 교체가 제대로 복원되었는지 확인
stopifnot(length(common_gene) == mad_filter_summary$Genes_after_MAD_filter)

# 10-5. 기준선 대비 paired bootstrap 비교
# 섹션 6의 bootstrap_index를 그대로 써서 기준선과 짝지어 비교
sparse_sensitivity_metric_fun <- function(predicted_vector) {
  point_value <- metric_vector_fun(
    bootstrap_observed, predicted_vector
  )[[primary_metric]]
  bootstrap_value <- vapply(
    bootstrap_index,
    function(index) metric_vector_fun(
      bootstrap_observed[index], predicted_vector[index]
    )[[primary_metric]],
    numeric(1)
  )
  list(point = point_value, bootstrap = bootstrap_value)
}

sparse_baseline_metric <- sparse_sensitivity_metric_fun(
  sparse_prediction_wide[["RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s)"]]
)

sparse_sensitivity_summary <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Setting = "Baseline (total budget 30 = 10+10+10, design 0.1, RNA MAD top 50%)",
    Macro_F1 = sparse_baseline_metric$point,
    CI_Lower = quantile(sparse_baseline_metric$bootstrap, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    CI_Upper = quantile(sparse_baseline_metric$bootstrap, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    Difference = NA_real_,
    Difference_CI_Lower = NA_real_,
    Difference_CI_Upper = NA_real_
  ),
  purrr::map_dfr(sparse_sensitivity_runs, function(run) {
    setting_metric <- sparse_sensitivity_metric_fun(run$Predicted)
    difference_bootstrap <- setting_metric$bootstrap - sparse_baseline_metric$bootstrap
    tibble(
      Setting = run$Setting,
      Macro_F1 = setting_metric$point,
      CI_Lower = quantile(setting_metric$bootstrap, 0.025, names = FALSE),
      CI_Upper = quantile(setting_metric$bootstrap, 0.975, names = FALSE),
      Difference = setting_metric$point - sparse_baseline_metric$point,
      Difference_CI_Lower = quantile(difference_bootstrap, 0.025, names = FALSE),
      Difference_CI_Upper = quantile(difference_bootstrap, 0.975, names = FALSE)
    )
  })
)
sparse_sensitivity_summary

save_table_fun(
  sparse_sensitivity_summary,
  "TableS1_Sparse_Sensitivity.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S1. Sensitivity of the three-block sparse model (RNA-Protein-Mismatch)",
    "to the sparse-selection hyperparameters and to the input gene filter.",
    "Macro_F1 = macro F1 (primary metric); differences are versus the pre-specified",
    "baseline (total budget of 30 features split equally across the three",
    "blocks, design off-diagonal = 0.1, RNA MAD top-50% input),",
    "computed on the bootstrap resample indices shared with Table 2."
  )
)

# 10-6. RNA 단일 블록 sPLS-DA 대조군
# 이 대조군은 섹션 9의 "RNA-only(s)"와 완전히 같은 추정량(RNA 한 블록에 sPLS-DA로 총 30개 선택 후 RF)
sparse_model_comparison %>%
  filter(Metric == primary_metric, Model == "RNA-only(s)")
sparse_paired_comparisons %>%
  filter(
    Metric == primary_metric,
    Comparison == "RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s) - RNA-only(s)"
  )

# 10-7. 최종 해석 모형의 mtry 민감도
# 성능이 아니라 "해석"(블록별 MDA)의 안정성을 보는 부분 
# 섹션 9에서 이미 선택된 feature 행렬(final_sparse$x_train)을 그대로 쓰고 mtry만 바꿔 재적합
mtry_sensitivity_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(c(0.5, 1, 2), function(rule) {
  mtry_value <- rule_to_mtry_fun(rule, ncol(final_sparse$x_train))
  set.seed(777)
  mtry_fit <- randomForest(
    x = final_sparse$x_train,
    y = factor(subtype_by_id[id_order], levels = subtype_levels),
    ntree = 2000, mtry = mtry_value, importance = TRUE
  )
  mtry_importance <- as.data.frame(importance(mtry_fit))
  mtry_importance$Feature <- rownames(mtry_importance)
  mtry_importance$Block <- sub("__.*$", "", mtry_importance$Feature)
  mtry_importance <- mtry_importance[order(-mtry_importance$MeanDecreaseAccuracy), ]
  # 모형의 feature가 정확히 30개이므로 "상위 30개"는 전체 집합과 같아 정보가 없다.
  # Table 7과 같은 기준(상위 10개 안의 블록별 개수)을 쓴다.
  top10_feature <- head(mtry_importance$Feature, 10)
  tibble(
    Mtry_Rule = rule,
    Mtry = as.integer(mtry_value),
    Block = mtry_importance$Block,
    MDA = mtry_importance$MeanDecreaseAccuracy,
    In_Top10 = mtry_importance$Feature %in% top10_feature
  ) %>%
    group_by(Mtry_Rule, Mtry, Block) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_MDA = mean(MDA),
      N_in_top10 = sum(In_Top10),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
})
mtry_sensitivity_summary

# 캡션 "Rule = 1 corresponds to Table 7" 을 코드로 보증 : rule 1 행이 Table 7의 Mean_MDA·top10 개수와 동일해야 함
mtry_rule1_check <- mtry_sensitivity_summary %>%
  filter(Mtry_Rule == 1) %>%
  arrange(Block)
table8_check <- sparse_block_importance %>%
  dplyr::select(Block, Mean_MDA, N_in_top10) %>%
  arrange(Block)
stopifnot(
  identical(mtry_rule1_check$Block, table8_check$Block),
  isTRUE(all.equal(mtry_rule1_check$Mean_MDA, table8_check$Mean_MDA)),
  identical(mtry_rule1_check$N_in_top10, table8_check$N_in_top10)
)

# mismatch 블록의 평균 MDA가 세 설정 모두에서 최하위인지 확인 (본문 서술의 근거 → in-text 표에 기록)
mtry_sensitivity_rank <- mtry_sensitivity_summary %>%
  group_by(Mtry_Rule) %>%
  mutate(Rank_By_Mean_MDA = rank(-Mean_MDA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Mtry_Rule, Rank_By_Mean_MDA)
mtry_sensitivity_rank
mismatch_lowest_in_all_mtry <- all(
  mtry_sensitivity_rank$Rank_By_Mean_MDA[mtry_sensitivity_rank$Block == "Mismatch"] ==
    length(unique(mtry_sensitivity_rank$Block))
)

save_table_fun(
  mtry_sensitivity_summary,
  "TableS2_Mtry_Sensitivity.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S2. Sensitivity of the modality-level permutation importance in the",
    "final full-sample three-block model to the random-forest mtry setting",
    "(0.5x, 1x and 2x the square root of the number of predictors).",
    "Rule = 1 corresponds to the setting reported in Table 7, and N_in_top10 is",
    "the number of features from each block among the ten most important",
    "features, as in Table 7. MDA values are",
    "scaled by their standard errors (randomForest::importance() default,",
    "scale = TRUE) and are therefore unitless."
  )
)

# 10-8. 주분석(전체 feature) 입력 유전자 필터 민감도
# "필터 없음 / 양쪽 MAD 상위 50% 교집합 / 양쪽 상위 2,000개 교집합"에서도
# mismatch 추가 효과의 주 결론이 유지되는지 표(Table S18)로 확인
# 섹션 5와 동일한 outer/inner fold·RF seed·bootstrap 재표집을 사용하고,
# 달라지는 것은 입력 유전자 집합 하나뿐이 되도록 통제
# 섹션 2에서 발현 행렬이 MAD 통과 유전자로 축소되었으므로, 완전 유전자(complete_gene)
# 수준의 행렬을 원자료에서 다시 만들어 전역 행렬을 임시 교체(on.exit로 복원)한다.

proteome_full_mat <- proteome %>%
  filter(IDX %in% complete_gene) %>%
  arrange(match(IDX, complete_gene)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("IDX") %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(id_order)) %>%
  as.matrix()
rna_full_mat <- rna %>%
  filter(IDX %in% complete_gene) %>%
  arrange(match(IDX, complete_gene)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("IDX") %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(id_order)) %>%
  as.matrix()
stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(proteome_full_mat), complete_gene),
  identical(colnames(proteome_full_mat), id_order),
  all(is.finite(proteome_full_mat)), all(is.finite(rna_full_mat))
)

# rna_mad_value/protein_mad_value는 섹션 2에서 완전 유전자 전체에 대해 계산된 벡터
gene_filter_settings <- list(
  list(
    label = "No variance filter (all complete genes)",
    genes = complete_gene
  ),
  list(
    label = "MAD top 50% in both RNA and protein",
    genes = both_mad_gene
  ),
  list(
    label = "Top-2000 intersection",
    genes = top2000_gene
  )
)

# 한 유전자 집합으로 섹션 5와 동일한 nested CV를 돌려 outer-fold 예측(wide)을 반환
run_gene_filter_cv_fun <- function(setting_label, gene_set) {
  gene_backup <- get("common_gene", envir = globalenv())
  proteome_backup <- get("proteome_mat", envir = globalenv())
  rna_backup <- get("rna_mat", envir = globalenv())
  assign("common_gene", gene_set, envir = globalenv())
  assign("proteome_mat", proteome_full_mat, envir = globalenv())
  assign("rna_mat", rna_full_mat, envir = globalenv())
  on.exit({
    assign("common_gene", gene_backup, envir = globalenv())
    assign("proteome_mat", proteome_backup, envir = globalenv())
    assign("rna_mat", rna_backup, envir = globalenv())
  }, add = TRUE)

  prediction_wide_fun(run_modality_nested_cv_fun(setting_label)$predictions)
}

# 예측(wide)에서 사전 지정 3쌍의 paired macro F1 차이와 bootstrap CI 계산
# (섹션 6의 bootstrap_index·bootstrap_observed 재사용 → 주분석과 동일 재표집)
gene_filter_paired_fun <- function(setting_wide, setting_label, n_genes) {
  pm <- boot_metric_fun(setting_wide, model_names)
  map2_dfr(
    comparison_specification$Enhanced_Model,
    comparison_specification$Baseline_Model,
    function(enhanced, baseline) {
      paired_diff_fun(pm, enhanced, baseline, primary_metric) %>%
        transmute(
          Setting = setting_label, N_input_genes = n_genes, Comparison,
          F1_Enhanced = Estimate_Enhanced, F1_Baseline = Estimate_Baseline,
          Difference, CI_Lower, CI_Upper
        )
    }
  )
}

# 주분석(RNA MAD 상위 50%)은 섹션 5의 prediction_wide를 그대로 사용 (Table 3과 동일 원자료)
gene_filter_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  gene_filter_paired_fun(
    prediction_wide, "Main (RNA-only MAD top 50%)", length(common_gene)
  ),
  map_dfr(gene_filter_settings, function(s) {
    setting_wide <- run_gene_filter_cv_fun(s$label, s$genes)
    gene_filter_paired_fun(setting_wide, s$label, length(s$genes))
  })
)
gene_filter_sensitivity

gene_filter_baseline_f1 <- gene_filter_sensitivity %>%
  filter(Comparison == "RNA-Mismatch - RNA-only") %>%
  transmute(Setting, N_input_genes, RNA_only_F1 = F1_Baseline) %>%
  arrange(RNA_only_F1)
gene_filter_baseline_f1
tibble(
  RNA_only_F1_min = min(gene_filter_baseline_f1$RNA_only_F1),
  RNA_only_F1_max = max(gene_filter_baseline_f1$RNA_only_F1)
)

# gene_set/행렬 임시 교체가 제대로 복원되었는지 확인
stopifnot(
  length(common_gene) == mad_filter_summary$Genes_after_MAD_filter,
  nrow(proteome_mat) == mad_filter_summary$Genes_after_MAD_filter
)

# Table10 : 입력 유전자 필터별 mismatch 추가 효과 
save_table_fun(
  gene_filter_sensitivity,
  "TableS18_Gene_Filter_Sensitivity.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S18. Sensitivity of the mismatch-addition effect (paired bootstrap",
    "difference in macro F1) to the input gene filter. All",
    "settings use the same outer/inner folds, random-forest seeds and 2,000",
    "stratified bootstrap resamples as the main analysis; only the input gene",
    "set differs. The main-analysis row reproduces Table 3."
  ),
  digits = 4,   # Table 3과 같은 자릿수
  landscape = TRUE,
  fontsize_pt = 8
)
```


## 10B. 총예산 스윕 : 일곱 조합 전부를 예산별로 재실행
```{r}
# 섹션 10은 3-block 모형 하나만 예산을 바꿔 돌린다(Table S1).
# 여기서는 같은 코드 경로로 섹션 9의 7조합 전체를 예산별로 반복한다.
#   - fold 할당·RF seed 규약(model_index = 10 + combo_index)·bootstrap_index를
#     섹션 9와 그대로 공유하므로, 설정 간에 달라지는 것은 총예산 하나뿐이다.
#   - 예산 30은 섹션 9와 코드 경로·fold·seed가 문자 그대로 같으므로 다시 돌리지 않고
#     섹션 9의 결과(sparse_metric)를 그대로 쓴다. 새로 도는 것은 60/90/150 세 예산.
# 주의 : 3개 예산 x 7조합 nested CV이므로 이 청크만 15~25분 걸린다.
sweep_budget_list <- c(30, 60, 90, 150)
sweep_new_budget_list <- setdiff(sweep_budget_list, sparse_total_keepx)
stopifnot(sparse_total_keepx %in% sweep_budget_list)

# 10B-1. 예산 하나로 7조합 nested CV를 돌려 pooled 예측(wide)을 반환
run_budget_sweep_fun <- function(total_keepx) {
  sweep_wide <- prediction_wide
  for (combo_index in seq_along(sparse_combos)) {
    combo_name <- names(sparse_combos)[combo_index]
    combo_blocks <- sparse_combos[[combo_index]]
    run <- run_sparse_nested_cv_fun(
      select_fun = function(train_id, valid_id) {
        sparse_select_fun(
          train_id, valid_id, combo_blocks, total_keepx = total_keepx
        )
      },
      model_index = 10L + combo_index
    )
    # 조합의 블록 수와 무관하게 예측변수 수가 총예산과 같은지 확인
    stopifnot(all(run$folds$N_Predictors == total_keepx))
    combo_pred <- run$predictions %>%
      transmute(Sample.ID, Predicted = as.character(Predicted))
    sweep_wide[[combo_name]] <-
      combo_pred$Predicted[match(sweep_wide$Sample.ID, combo_pred$Sample.ID)]
    stopifnot(!anyNA(sweep_wide[[combo_name]]))
    cat("[sweep] budget", total_keepx, "done:", combo_name, "\n")
  }
  sweep_wide
}

# 10B-2. 예산별 실행 (bootstrap_index를 공유하므로 설정 간 paired 비교가 가능)
#   예산 30(= sparse_total_keepx)은 섹션 9의 sparse_metric 재사용
sweep_metric_list <- setNames(
  lapply(sweep_budget_list, function(b) {
    if (b == sparse_total_keepx) {
      sparse_metric
    } else {
      boot_metric_fun(run_budget_sweep_fun(b), sparse_model_names)
    }
  }),
  as.character(sweep_budget_list)
)

# 10B-3. 희소 선택 미적용 조건에서 각 조합이 실제로 쓴 예측변수 수
#   (섹션 5의 outer fold 기록. mismatch QC로 fold마다 조금씩 달라 중앙값을 쓴다)
sweep_feature_count <- nested_cv_results %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(N_Features_No_Selection = median(N_Predictors), .groups = "drop")

# 10B-4. Table S8 : 미적용 대비 예산별 macro F1
sweep_f1_by_budget <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(sweep_metric_list),
  function(b) metric_ci_fun(sweep_metric_list[[b]]) %>%
    filter(Metric == primary_metric) %>%
    transmute(
      Model = sub("\\(s\\)$", "", Model),
      Setting = paste0("Budget_", b),
      Macro_F1 = Estimate
    )
)

sweep_f1_no_selection <- metric_ci_fun(main_metric) %>%
  filter(Metric == primary_metric) %>%
  transmute(Model, Setting = "No_selection", Macro_F1 = Estimate)

sweep_performance_table <- bind_rows(sweep_f1_no_selection, sweep_f1_by_budget) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Setting, values_from = Macro_F1) %>%
  left_join(sweep_feature_count, by = "Model") %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = model_names)) %>%
  arrange(Model) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Model, N_Features_No_Selection, No_selection,
    dplyr::all_of(paste0("Budget_", sweep_budget_list))
  )
sweep_performance_table

save_table_fun(
  sweep_performance_table,
  "TableS8_Budget_Sweep_Performance.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S8. Macro F1 (primary metric) of every modality combination without",
    "sparse feature selection and under each total feature budget. The",
    "'No_selection' column reproduces Table 2, where each combination uses all",
    "features of its modalities; the remaining columns apply identical",
    "within-fold sparse selection at the stated total budget. All settings",
    "share the same folds, random-forest seed conventions and 2,000 bootstrap",
    "resamples, so the only thing that varies is the budget."
  ),
  digits = 3,
  landscape = TRUE,
  fontsize_pt = 8
)

# 10B-5. Table S9 : 사전 지정 짝지은 차이 (미적용 + 예산별)
#   섹션 9의 사전 지정 3쌍을 그대로 쓴다.
sweep_pair_specification <- lapply(sparse_prespecified_pairs, function(pair) {
  sub("\\(s\\)$", "", pair)
})

sweep_paired_by_budget <- purrr::map_dfr(names(sweep_metric_list), function(b) {
  purrr::map_dfr(sweep_pair_specification, function(pair) {
    paired_diff_fun(
      sweep_metric_list[[b]], paste0(pair[1], "(s)"), paste0(pair[2], "(s)")
    ) %>%
      filter(Metric == primary_metric) %>%
      transmute(
        Setting = paste0("Budget_", b),
        Comparison = paste(pair[1], pair[2], sep = " - "),
        Difference, CI_Lower, CI_Upper
      )
  })
})

# 미적용 조건에서는 섹션 6이 사전 지정한 쌍만 계산한다.
#   3-block 대 RNA-only는 희소 선택 하에서만 사전 지정된 비교이므로 여기서 제외하고,
#   표에서는 해당 칸이 비게 된다(사후 계산을 사전 지정 비교와 섞지 않기 위함).
sweep_pairs_in_main <- Filter(
  function(pair) any(
    comparison_specification$Enhanced_Model == pair[1] &
      comparison_specification$Baseline_Model == pair[2]
  ),
  sweep_pair_specification
)

sweep_paired_no_selection <- purrr::map_dfr(sweep_pairs_in_main, function(pair) {
  paired_diff_fun(main_metric, pair[1], pair[2]) %>%
    filter(Metric == primary_metric) %>%
    transmute(
      Setting = "No_selection",
      Comparison = paste(pair[1], pair[2], sep = " - "),
      Difference, CI_Lower, CI_Upper
    )
})

sweep_paired_table <- bind_rows(sweep_paired_no_selection, sweep_paired_by_budget) %>%
  mutate(Setting = factor(
    Setting, levels = c("No_selection", paste0("Budget_", sweep_budget_list))
  )) %>%
  arrange(Setting, Comparison)
sweep_paired_table

save_table_fun(
  sweep_paired_table,
  "TableS9_Budget_Sweep_Paired.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S9. Pre-specified paired differences in macro F1",
    "without sparse feature selection and under each total feature budget.",
    "Positive values would indicate improvement over the baseline. The",
    "RNA-Protein-Mismatch vs RNA-only comparison is pre-specified only under",
    "sparse selection and is therefore not reported for the no-selection",
    "setting. Differences and 95% CIs come from paired bootstrap on the shared",
    "resample indices."
  ),
  digits = 3,
  fontsize_pt = 8
)

# 10B-6. 내부 검증 : 예산 30 열이 섹션 9의 객체 그대로인지 (Table S8·S9의 Budget_30 = Table 5·6)
stopifnot(identical(sweep_metric_list[[as.character(sparse_total_keepx)]], sparse_metric))
```

```{r}
# 11-1. RNA·단백질 원자료의 결측률
common_gene_raw <- intersect(proteome$IDX, rna$IDX)

raw_missing_percent_fun <- function(expression_df, gene_set, sample_set) {
  expression_mat <- expression_df %>%
    filter(IDX %in% gene_set) %>%
    arrange(match(IDX, gene_set)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("IDX") %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(sample_set)) %>%

}

# 11-2. 유전자별 표준편차 최솟값

# 11-3. 공변량 보정 후 단백질 변동 대비 mismatch의 상대 크기
mismatch_relative_size <- tibble(
  N_Genes = length(r_squared_by_gene),
  Median_sqrt_1_minus_R2 = median(sqrt(1 - r_squared_by_gene)),
  Mean_sqrt_1_minus_R2 = mean(sqrt(1 - r_squared_by_gene)),
  Median_percent = 100 * median(sqrt(1 - r_squared_by_gene))
)
mismatch_relative_size

# 11-3b. R^2를 어떤 분모로 정의했는지 명확히 하기 위한 대조표
r2_gene <- colnames(mismatch_t)
protein_full_sample <- t(proteome_mat[r2_gene, id_order, drop = FALSE])
rna_full_sample <- t(rna_mat[r2_gene, id_order, drop = FALSE])
clinical_for_r2 <- clinical_data
clinical_for_r2$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity[
  !is.finite(clinical_for_r2$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity)
] <- median(clinical_for_r2$ESTIMATE.TumorPurity, na.rm = TRUE)
clinical_for_r2$Necrosis[!is.finite(clinical_for_r2$Necrosis)] <-
  median(clinical_for_r2$Necrosis, na.rm = TRUE)
z_for_r2 <- model.matrix(
  ~ TMT.experiment + ESTIMATE.TumorPurity + Necrosis, data = clinical_for_r2
)
qr_for_r2 <- qr(z_for_r2)
protein_resid_r2 <- qr.resid(qr_for_r2, protein_full_sample)
rna_resid_r2 <- qr.resid(qr_for_r2, rna_full_sample)
beta_r2 <- colSums(rna_resid_r2 * protein_resid_r2) / colSums(rna_resid_r2^2)
mismatch_r2 <- protein_resid_r2 - sweep(rna_resid_r2, 2, beta_r2, `*`)
ss_total_r2 <- colSums(sweep(protein_full_sample, 2, colMeans(protein_full_sample))^2)
ss_after_covariate_r2 <- colSums(protein_resid_r2^2)
ss_residual_r2 <- colSums(mismatch_r2^2)

r_squared_definitions <- tibble(
  Definition = c(
    "Partial R2 of RNA (covariate-adjusted protein) - used in Figure 1 and section 3.3",
    "Covariates only",
    "Full model (RNA + covariates)"
  ),
  Median = c(
    median(1 - ss_residual_r2 / ss_after_covariate_r2),
    median(1 - ss_after_covariate_r2 / ss_total_r2),
    median(1 - ss_residual_r2 / ss_total_r2)
  ),
  Mean = c(
    mean(1 - ss_residual_r2 / ss_after_covariate_r2),
    mean(1 - ss_after_covariate_r2 / ss_total_r2),
    mean(1 - ss_residual_r2 / ss_total_r2)
  ),
  Pct_below_0.1 = 100 * c(
    mean(1 - ss_residual_r2 / ss_after_covariate_r2 < 0.1),
    mean(1 - ss_after_covariate_r2 / ss_total_r2 < 0.1),
    mean(1 - ss_residual_r2 / ss_total_r2 < 0.1)
  )
)
r_squared_definitions
# 섹션 7의 r_squared_by_gene과 첫 행이 같은지 확인
stopifnot(
  max(abs((1 - ss_residual_r2 / ss_after_covariate_r2) - r_squared_by_gene)) < 1e-8
)


# 11-4. 사전 지정 3쌍 비교에서 차이가 정확히 0이 된 재표집 비율
zero_difference_share <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(comparison_specification)),
  function(k) {
    enhanced <- comparison_specification$Enhanced_Model[k]
    baseline <- comparison_specification$Baseline_Model[k]
    difference <- main_metric$boot[, enhanced, primary_metric] -
      main_metric$boot[, baseline, primary_metric]
    tibble(
      Comparison = paste(enhanced, "-", baseline),
      Pct_difference_exactly_zero = 100 * mean(difference == 0),
      Pct_difference_le_zero = 100 * mean(difference <= 0)
    )
  }
)

)


# 11-6. TMT 배치-subtype 교락 점검
# (A) 배치 x subtype 교차표와 독립성 검정
# (B) 배치 정보만으로 subtype을 예측했을 때의 성능(주분석과 동일한 outer fold)
batch_factor <- factor(batch_by_id[id_order])
subtype_factor <- factor(subtype_by_id[id_order], levels = subtype_levels)
batch_subtype_table <- table(Batch = batch_factor, Subtype = subtype_factor)

batch_chisq <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(batch_subtype_table))
batch_chisq_mc_B <- 20000L
set.seed(20260818)
batch_chisq_mc <- chisq.test(
  batch_subtype_table, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = batch_chisq_mc_B
)
batch_confounding_summary <- tibble(
  N_batches = nrow(batch_subtype_table),
  ChiSq = as.numeric(batch_chisq$statistic),
  df = as.numeric(batch_chisq$parameter),
  MC_p_value = batch_chisq_mc$p.value,
  Cramers_V = sqrt(
    as.numeric(batch_chisq$statistic) /
      (sum(batch_subtype_table) * (min(dim(batch_subtype_table)) - 1))
  ),
  Pct_expected_below_5 = 100 * mean(batch_chisq$expected < 5)
)
batch_confounding_summary

# (A) 논문 Table S3(A): 배치별 subtype 구성
count_matrix <- matrix(
  as.integer(batch_subtype_table),
  nrow = nrow(batch_subtype_table),
  dimnames = dimnames(batch_subtype_table)
)
batch_order_num <- order(
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rownames(count_matrix))),
  rownames(count_matrix)
)
count_matrix <- count_matrix[batch_order_num, , drop = FALSE]
colnames(count_matrix) <- unname(subtype_label[colnames(count_matrix)])

largest_share_text <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(count_matrix)),
  function(r) {
    row_count <- count_matrix[r, ]
    max_count <- max(row_count)
    label <- if (sum(row_count == max_count) > 1) {
      "Tie"
    } else {
      names(row_count)[which.max(row_count)]
    }
    sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", label, 100 * max_count / sum(row_count))
  },
  character(1)
)

overall_count <- colSums(count_matrix)
table_s3a_out <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Batch = rownames(count_matrix),
    N = as.character(rowSums(count_matrix))
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(
      as.data.frame(count_matrix) %>%
        mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
    ) %>%
    mutate(Largest_share = largest_share_text),
  tibble(
    Batch = "Total",
    N = as.character(sum(count_matrix))
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(
      as.data.frame(t(sprintf(
        "%d (%.1f%%)", overall_count, 100 * overall_count / sum(overall_count)
      )), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
        setNames(names(overall_count))
    ) %>%
    mutate(Largest_share = sprintf(
      "%s (%.1f%%)",
      names(overall_count)[which.max(overall_count)],
      100 * max(overall_count) / sum(overall_count)
    ))
)
table_s3a_out

# 캡션의 사실 문장은 하드코딩하지 않고 데이터에서 파생한다.
#  - 종양 표본이 하나도 없는 TMT 배치 : 원자료(batch)에는 있으나 batch_1(Tumor만)에 없는 배치
#  - 카이제곱 결론 : MC p-value를 실제 값으로 기재
tumor_free_batch <- setdiff(
  unique(as.character(batch$`TMT experiments`[!is.na(batch$`TMT experiments`)])),
  unique(batch_1$TMT.experiment)
)
tumor_free_batch <- tumor_free_batch[order(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tumor_free_batch)), tumor_free_batch)]
tumor_free_batch_text <- if (length(tumor_free_batch) == 0) {
  "Every TMT batch contributed at least one tumor sample."
} else {
  sprintf(
    "%s %s contained only adjacent-normal specimens and contribute%s no tumor samples.",
    if (length(tumor_free_batch) == 1) "Batch" else "Batches",
    paste(tumor_free_batch, collapse = " and "),
    if (length(tumor_free_batch) == 1) "s" else ""
  )
}
batch_chisq_text <- sprintf(
  "A Monte-Carlo chi-square test (%d resamples) gave p = %.3f%s,",
  batch_chisq_mc_B, batch_chisq_mc$p.value,
  if (batch_chisq_mc$p.value >= 0.05) ", consistent with batch-subtype independence" else
    ", indicating some batch-subtype association"
)

save_table_fun(
  table_s3a_out,
  "TableS3A_Batch_Subtype_Composition.docx",
  caption = paste(
    "Table S3 (A). PAM50 subtype composition of each TMT experiment batch.",
    "Tie = two or more subtypes with equal counts.",
    tumor_free_batch_text,
    batch_chisq_text,
    "although the expected cell counts are small and this test has limited",
    "power; panel (B) is the more direct assessment."
  ),
  digits = 0
)

# (B) 배치 정보만으로 subtype 예측: 최빈 subtype 규칙 + 배치 더미 RF
predicted_batch_majority <- character(length(id_order))
predicted_batch_forest <- character(length(id_order))
names(predicted_batch_majority) <- id_order
names(predicted_batch_forest) <- id_order

for (i in seq_along(outer_folds)) {
  valid_index <- outer_folds[[i]]
  train_id <- id_order[-valid_index]
  valid_id <- id_order[valid_index]
  train_subtype <- subtype_by_id[train_id]
  train_batch <- batch_by_id[train_id]
  overall_major <- names(sort(table(train_subtype), decreasing = TRUE))[1]

  for (s in valid_id) {
    same_batch_subtype <- train_subtype[train_batch == batch_by_id[[s]]]
    if (length(same_batch_subtype) == 0) {
      predicted_batch_majority[s] <- overall_major
    } else {
      batch_subtype_count <- table(factor(same_batch_subtype, levels = subtype_levels))
      top <- names(batch_subtype_count)[batch_subtype_count == max(batch_subtype_count)]
      predicted_batch_majority[s] <- if (length(top) == 1) {
        top
      } else {
        tie_break_count <- table(
          factor(train_subtype, levels = subtype_levels)
        )[top]
        names(tie_break_count)[which.max(tie_break_count)]
      }
    }
  }

  batch_levels <- unique(as.character(train_batch))
  dummy_fun <- function(batch_vector) {
    dummy <- outer(
      as.character(batch_vector), batch_levels,
      function(a, b) as.numeric(a == b)
    )
    colnames(dummy) <- paste0("Batch_", batch_levels)
    dummy
  }
  set.seed(400000 + i)
  batch_forest <- randomForest(
    x = dummy_fun(train_batch),
    y = factor(train_subtype, levels = subtype_levels),
    ntree = random_forest_trees
  )
  predicted_batch_forest[valid_id] <- as.character(
    predict(batch_forest, newdata = dummy_fun(batch_by_id[valid_id]))
  )
}

batch_only_performance <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Model = "Batch-majority rule",
    !!!as.list(metric_vector_fun(bootstrap_observed, predicted_batch_majority))
  ),
  tibble(
    Model = "Random forest on batch indicators only",
    !!!as.list(metric_vector_fun(bootstrap_observed, predicted_batch_forest))
  ),
  tibble(
    Model = "Reference: constant Luminal A prediction",
    !!!as.list(metric_vector_fun(
      bootstrap_observed, rep("LumA", length(id_order))
    ))
  )
)
batch_only_performance

# 캡션 결론을 데이터로 보증.
# macro F1에는 MBA의 0.5 같은 고정 chance level이 없으므로, 상수 Luminal A 예측(3행)을 참조 기준으로 비교한다.
# MBA 기준(0.5)의 결론도 함께 남긴다 (보조 지표).
batch_only_max_f1 <- max(batch_only_performance$Macro_F1[1:2])
batch_only_reference_f1 <- batch_only_performance$Macro_F1[3]
batch_only_max_mba <- max(batch_only_performance$Macro_Balanced_Accuracy[1:2])
batch_only_text <- paste(
  if (batch_only_max_f1 <= batch_only_reference_f1) {
    sprintf("Neither approach exceeds the macro F1 of the constant Luminal A reference (%.3f)", batch_only_reference_f1)
  } else {
    sprintf("The best batch-only approach reached a macro F1 of %.3f (constant Luminal A reference: %.3f)",
            batch_only_max_f1, batch_only_reference_f1)
  },
  if (batch_only_max_mba <= 0.5) {
    "and neither exceeds the chance level of 0.500 in macro balanced accuracy."
  } else {
    sprintf("and the best reached a macro balanced accuracy of %.3f.", batch_only_max_mba)
  }
)
save_table_fun(
  batch_only_performance,
  "TableS3B_Batch_Only_Prediction.docx",
  caption = paste(
    "Table S3 (B). Subtype prediction from TMT batch information alone,",
    "pooled over the same five outer folds as Table 2.",
    batch_only_text
  ),
  digits = 3
)


# 11-7. 중요도 순위의 나무 수 의존성 (500 vs 2,000 그루)
#   데이터·mtry·seed를 모두 고정하고 나무 수만 바꿔 중요도 순위를 비교
#   mtry는 Table S17와 같은 final_mtry(= final_mtry_rule x sqrt(p))를 사용
#   결합 모델 비교(아래 두 번째 블록)는 Figure S5과 같은 rule = 1을 사용
fit_forest_with_ntree <- function(x, y, mtry, seed, ntree) {
  set.seed(seed)
  randomForest(x = x, y = y, ntree = ntree, mtry = mtry, importance = TRUE)
}

# ntree = 500 은 섹션 7의 rf_mismatch(같은 데이터·mtry·seed 300003·ntree 500)와 동일 모델이므로
# 재적합하지 않고 importance_result(섹션 8)를 그대로 쓴다. 새로 적합하는 것은 2,000그루뿐.
stopifnot(random_forest_trees == 500)
mismatch_importance_by_ntree <- list(
  "500" = importance_result %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, MDA = MeanDecreaseAccuracy),
  "2000" = fit_forest_with_ntree(
    mismatch_t, subtype_by_id[id_order], final_mtry, 300003, 2000
  ) %>%
    randomForest::importance(scale = FALSE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, MDA = MeanDecreaseAccuracy)
)

ntree_importance_compare <- mismatch_importance_by_ntree[["500"]] %>%
  rename(MDA_500 = MDA) %>%
  left_join(
    mismatch_importance_by_ntree[["2000"]] %>% rename(MDA_2000 = MDA),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank_500 = rank(-MDA_500, ties.method = "first"),
    Rank_2000 = rank(-MDA_2000, ties.method = "first")
  )

top_gene_by_ntree <- function(rank_column, n) {
  ntree_importance_compare$Gene[
    order(ntree_importance_compare[[rank_column]])
  ][seq_len(n)]
}
ntree_importance_stability <- tibble(
  N_Genes = nrow(ntree_importance_compare),
  Spearman_rank_correlation = cor(
    ntree_importance_compare$MDA_500,
    ntree_importance_compare$MDA_2000,
    method = "spearman"
  ),
  Pearson_correlation = cor(
    ntree_importance_compare$MDA_500, ntree_importance_compare$MDA_2000
  ),
  Top10_overlap = length(intersect(
    top_gene_by_ntree("Rank_500", 10), top_gene_by_ntree("Rank_2000", 10)
  )),
  Top20_overlap = length(intersect(
    top_gene_by_ntree("Rank_500", 20), top_gene_by_ntree("Rank_2000", 20)
  ))
)
ntree_importance_stability

# 결합 모델 상위 10개에 mismatch feature가 포함되는지 (두 나무 수 모두)
#   ntree = 500 은 섹션 8의 Figure S5 모델(seed 300000 + model_index, rule 1, ntree 500)과
#   동일하므로 model_importance_top10 에서 세고, 2,000그루만 새로 적합한다.
combined_top10_mismatch_count <- bind_rows(
  model_importance_top10 %>%
    group_by(Model) %>%
    summarise(
      N_mismatch_in_top10 = sum(str_starts(Feature, "Mismatch__")),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Ntree = 500L, .before = 1) %>%
    arrange(match(Model, model_names)),
  purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_along(model_names),
    function(model_index) {
      model_name <- model_names[model_index]
      x_full <- full_modality_data$modalities[[model_name]]$x_train
      fit <- fit_forest_with_ntree(
        x_full, subtype_by_id[id_order],
        rule_to_mtry_fun(1, ncol(x_full)), 300000 + model_index, 2000
      )
      top_feature <- randomForest::importance(fit, scale = FALSE) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
        arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseAccuracy), Feature) %>%
        slice_head(n = 10) %>%
        pull(Feature)
      tibble(
        Ntree = 2000L,
        Model = model_name,
        N_mismatch_in_top10 = sum(str_starts(top_feature, "Mismatch__"))
      )
    }
  )
)
combined_top10_mismatch_count

# 11-8. 나무 수 1,000그루 민감도 분석
#   섹션 5와 동일한 fold·seed 규약으로 7개 모델 nested CV를 다시 돌리고,
#   섹션 6의 bootstrap 재표집으로 사전 지정 3쌍의 paired 차이를 계산
#   random_forest_trees를 임시로 바꾸고 on.exit로 복원
run_nested_cv_with_ntree_fun <- function(n_tree) {
  tree_backup <- get("random_forest_trees", envir = globalenv())
  assign("random_forest_trees", n_tree, envir = globalenv())
  on.exit(
    assign("random_forest_trees", tree_backup, envir = globalenv()),
    add = TRUE
  )
  prediction_wide_fun(
    run_modality_nested_cv_fun(paste0("ntree ", n_tree))$predictions
  )
}

prediction_wide_tree1000 <- run_nested_cv_with_ntree_fun(1000)
```

## 12. 전체 유전자 탐색 : mismatch 특이 subtype 신호와 순열 검정
```{r}
# 섹션 8·9는 "분류기가 mismatch feature를 쓰는가"를 묻는다. 여기서는 질문을 뒤집어,
# 어떤 유전자에서 subtype 신호가 RNA·protein보다 mismatch에서 더 큰가(= mismatch 특이 유전자)를
# 주분석 입력 유전자 전체에서 찾는다 (2026-09-09 미팅 지시, 9/15 메인 결과로 확정).
#   지표      : 유전자별 one-way ANOVA η²(subtype 4수준)를 RNA / Protein / Mismatch 값에 각각 계산
#   Eta_gain  : η²(Mismatch) − max(η²(RNA), η²(Protein))
#   특이 유전자: Eta_gain > 0 이고 mismatch ANOVA BH-FDR < 0.05 (섹션 8 anova_results와 같은 검정)
# 전체 표본(110명)에서 1회 계산하므로 탐색적이며, 라벨과의 관계가 우연 수준인지는 12-3 순열 검정으로 평가.
# 모든 행렬은 섹션 8의 전체표본 split(full_modality_data)을 그대로 쓴다.

# 12-1. 세 modality 행렬 (행 = 환자, 열 = 유전자, 열 순서 동일)
specific_subtype <- factor(subtype_by_id[id_order], levels = subtype_levels)
specific_mm <- full_modality_data$modalities[["Mismatch-only"]]$x_train
specific_gene <- colnames(specific_mm)
specific_rn <- full_modality_data$modalities[["RNA-only"]]$x_train[, specific_gene, drop = FALSE]
specific_pr <- full_modality_data$modalities[["Protein-only"]]$x_train[, specific_gene, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(specific_mm), id_order),
  isTRUE(all.equal(unname(specific_mm), unname(mismatch_t))),
  identical(specific_gene, anova_results$Gene),
  identical(specific_gene, colnames(mismatch_t))
)
specific_n <- nrow(specific_mm)
specific_k <- nlevels(specific_subtype)

# 12-2. η² (행렬 단위) : 열 중심화 후 그룹 평균의 가중 제곱합 / 총제곱합
#   중심화 행렬과 총제곱합은 라벨과 무관하므로 한 번만 계산해 순열에서 재사용한다.
specific_center_fun <- function(x) sweep(x, 2, colMeans(x))
specific_centered <- list(
  RNA = specific_center_fun(specific_rn),
  Protein = specific_center_fun(specific_pr),
  Mismatch = specific_center_fun(specific_mm)
)
specific_ss_total <- lapply(specific_centered, function(x) colSums(x^2))
specific_eta_fun <- function(x_centered, ss_total, label) {
  G <- model.matrix(~ label - 1)
  n_g <- colSums(G)
  group_mean <- crossprod(G, x_centered) / n_g
  colSums(group_mean^2 * n_g) / ss_total
}
specific_eta_given_fun <- function(label) {
  e <- setNames(lapply(names(specific_centered), function(k) {
    specific_eta_fun(specific_centered[[k]], specific_ss_total[[k]], label)
  }), names(specific_centered))
  e$gain <- e$Mismatch - pmax(e$RNA, e$Protein)
  e
}
specific_f_p_fun <- function(eta) {
  f <- (eta / (specific_k - 1)) / ((1 - eta) / (specific_n - specific_k))
  pf(f, specific_k - 1, specific_n - specific_k, lower.tail = FALSE)
}
specific_d_fun <- function(x, g1, g2) {
  a <- x[g1, , drop = FALSE]; b <- x[g2, , drop = FALSE]
  (colMeans(a) - colMeans(b)) / sqrt((apply(a, 2, var) + apply(b, 2, var)) / 2)
}

specific_obs <- specific_eta_given_fun(specific_subtype)
# 섹션 8의 gene_anova_fun(η²·p)과 일치하는지 (같은 검정임을 코드로 보증)
stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(unname(specific_obs$Mismatch), anova_results$Eta_squared)),
  isTRUE(all.equal(unname(specific_f_p_fun(specific_obs$Mismatch)), anova_results$p_value))
)

# Kruskal-Wallis FDR : 분포 가정에 대한 강건성 확인용(보조)
specific_kw_p <- apply(specific_mm, 2, function(v) kruskal.test(v ~ specific_subtype)$p.value)

specific_is_basal <- specific_subtype == "Basal"
specific_is_luma <- specific_subtype == "LumA"
specific_is_lumb <- specific_subtype == "LumB"
stopifnot(length(r_squared_by_gene) == length(specific_gene))

mismatch_specific_genes <- tibble(
  Gene = specific_gene,
  Eta_RNA = unname(specific_obs$RNA),
  Eta_Protein = unname(specific_obs$Protein),
  Eta_Mismatch = unname(specific_obs$Mismatch),
  Eta_gain = unname(specific_obs$gain),
  ANOVA_FDR_Mismatch = anova_results$FDR,
  KW_FDR_Mismatch = p.adjust(specific_kw_p, "BH"),
  d_Basal_RNA = unname(specific_d_fun(specific_rn, specific_is_basal, !specific_is_basal)),
  d_Basal_Protein = unname(specific_d_fun(specific_pr, specific_is_basal, !specific_is_basal)),
  d_Basal_Mismatch = unname(specific_d_fun(specific_mm, specific_is_basal, !specific_is_basal)),
  d_LumAB_RNA = unname(specific_d_fun(specific_rn, specific_is_luma, specific_is_lumb)),
  d_LumAB_Protein = unname(specific_d_fun(specific_pr, specific_is_luma, specific_is_lumb)),
  d_LumAB_Mismatch = unname(specific_d_fun(specific_mm, specific_is_luma, specific_is_lumb)),
  Partial_R2 = unname(r_squared_by_gene)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Opposite_direction_Basal = sign(d_Basal_RNA) != sign(d_Basal_Protein),
    Mismatch_specific = Eta_gain > 0 & ANOVA_FDR_Mismatch < 0.05,
    Mismatch_specific_KW = Eta_gain > 0 & KW_FDR_Mismatch < 0.05,
    Rank_Eta_gain = rank(-Eta_gain, ties.method = "min"),
    Rank_Eta_Mismatch = rank(-Eta_Mismatch, ties.method = "min")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Eta_gain))
specific_gene_set <- mismatch_specific_genes$Gene[mismatch_specific_genes$Mismatch_specific]
length(specific_gene_set)

# 12-3. 순열 검정 : subtype 라벨을 B회 섞어 "관계가 없을 때"의 Eta_gain 분포를 만든다.
#   (1) 전체 수준 : 특이 유전자 개수가 귀무 분포에서 어디에 있는가 (주 검정)
#   (2) 유전자 수준 : 유전자별 gain의 순열 p값·BH-FDR, 그리고 순열별 최대 gain 분포(maxT) 기반 family-wise p
#   순열 안에서도 관측과 같은 규칙(gain > 0 & ANOVA FDR < 0.05)으로 특이 유전자를 센다.
specific_perm_B <- 2000L
set.seed(20260910)
specific_perm_gain <- matrix(NA_real_, length(specific_gene), specific_perm_B)
specific_perm_n_gain_pos <- integer(specific_perm_B)
specific_perm_n_specific <- integer(specific_perm_B)
specific_perm_max_gain <- numeric(specific_perm_B)
for (b in seq_len(specific_perm_B)) {
  perm_label <- sample(specific_subtype)
  perm_eta <- specific_eta_given_fun(perm_label)
  specific_perm_gain[, b] <- perm_eta$gain
  specific_perm_n_gain_pos[b] <- sum(perm_eta$gain > 0)
  specific_perm_n_specific[b] <- sum(
    perm_eta$gain > 0 & p.adjust(specific_f_p_fun(perm_eta$Mismatch), "BH") < 0.05
  )
  specific_perm_max_gain[b] <- max(perm_eta$gain)
  if (b %% 500 == 0) message("permutation ", b, "/", specific_perm_B)
}
specific_perm_p <- (1 + rowSums(specific_perm_gain >= specific_obs$gain)) / (specific_perm_B + 1)
specific_perm_fdr <- p.adjust(specific_perm_p, "BH")
specific_maxT_p <- vapply(
  specific_obs$gain,
  function(g) (1 + sum(specific_perm_max_gain >= g)) / (specific_perm_B + 1),
  numeric(1)
)
mismatch_specific_genes <- mismatch_specific_genes %>%
  left_join(
    tibble(Gene = specific_gene, Perm_p_gain = specific_perm_p,
           Perm_FDR_gain = specific_perm_fdr, MaxT_p_gain = specific_maxT_p),
    by = "Gene"
  )
specific_observed_n <- length(specific_gene_set)
specific_perm_global_p <- (1 + sum(specific_perm_n_specific >= specific_observed_n)) /
  (specific_perm_B + 1)

# 12-4. Table 9 : 전체 요약 + 순열 검정
specific_spec <- mismatch_specific_genes %>% filter(Mismatch_specific)
mismatch_specific_summary <- tibble(
  Quantity = c(
    "Input genes (RNA MAD top 50%)",
    "Genes with eta2(Mismatch) > max(eta2(RNA), eta2(Protein))",
    "Mismatch-specific genes (gain > 0 and mismatch ANOVA FDR < 0.05)",
    "Mismatch-specific genes, % of input",
    "Mismatch-specific genes with Kruskal-Wallis FDR < 0.05 instead of ANOVA (robustness)",
    "Mismatch-specific genes with eta2(Mismatch) >= 0.2",
    "Median eta2(Mismatch) among mismatch-specific genes",
    "Median eta2(RNA) / eta2(Protein) among mismatch-specific genes",
    "% of mismatch-specific genes with opposite RNA vs protein direction (Basal vs rest)",
    "% of all input genes with opposite RNA vs protein direction (Basal vs rest)",
    "% of mismatch-specific genes with |d(LumA vs LumB)| larger in mismatch than in protein",
    "Median partial R2 of RNA, mismatch-specific genes / all genes",
    "Permutations (B)",
    "Mismatch-specific genes under permuted labels, mean",
    "Mismatch-specific genes under permuted labels, maximum",
    "Permutation p-value for the observed number of mismatch-specific genes",
    "Genes with permutation FDR < 0.05 / < 0.10 (gene-level gain test)",
    "Genes with maxT family-wise p < 0.05",
    "Genes with eta2 gain > 0 under permuted labels, mean (observed in parentheses)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    as.character(length(specific_gene)),
    as.character(sum(mismatch_specific_genes$Eta_gain > 0)),
    as.character(specific_observed_n),
    sprintf("%.1f", 100 * specific_observed_n / length(specific_gene)),
    as.character(sum(mismatch_specific_genes$Mismatch_specific_KW)),
    as.character(sum(specific_spec$Eta_Mismatch >= 0.2)),
    sprintf("%.3f", median(specific_spec$Eta_Mismatch)),
    sprintf("%.3f / %.3f", median(specific_spec$Eta_RNA), median(specific_spec$Eta_Protein)),
    sprintf("%.1f", 100 * mean(specific_spec$Opposite_direction_Basal)),
    sprintf("%.1f", 100 * mean(mismatch_specific_genes$Opposite_direction_Basal)),
    sprintf("%.1f", 100 * mean(abs(specific_spec$d_LumAB_Mismatch) > abs(specific_spec$d_LumAB_Protein))),
    sprintf("%.3f / %.3f", median(specific_spec$Partial_R2), median(mismatch_specific_genes$Partial_R2)),
    as.character(specific_perm_B),
    sprintf("%.2f", mean(specific_perm_n_specific)),
    as.character(max(specific_perm_n_specific)),
    sprintf("%.4f", specific_perm_global_p),
    sprintf("%d / %d", sum(specific_perm_fdr < 0.05), sum(specific_perm_fdr < 0.10)),
    as.character(sum(specific_maxT_p < 0.05)),
    sprintf("%.1f (%d)", mean(specific_perm_n_gain_pos), sum(mismatch_specific_genes$Eta_gain > 0))
  )
)
mismatch_specific_summary

save_table_fun(
  mismatch_specific_summary,
  "Table9_Mismatch_Specific_Summary.docx",
  paste(

    "one-way ANOVA across the four PAM50 subtypes) was computed separately for RNA,",
    "protein and mismatch values on the full sample; a gene is mismatch-specific",
    "when its mismatch eta-squared exceeds both its RNA and its protein eta-squared",
    "and the mismatch ANOVA is significant at BH-FDR < 0.05. The null distribution",
    "of the number of mismatch-specific genes was obtained by recomputing the same",
    "quantities under 2,000 random permutations of the subtype labels."
  ),
  fontsize_pt = 9
)

# 12-6. 그림 공통 함수 : 유전자 집합의 RNA / Protein / Mismatch subtype별 boxplot (행 = modality, 열 = 유전자)
modality_boxplot_fun <- function(genes, title) {
  stopifnot(all(genes %in% specific_gene))
  long <- purrr::map_dfr(c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch"), function(md) {
    x <- list(RNA = specific_rn, Protein = specific_pr, Mismatch = specific_mm)[[md]][, genes, drop = FALSE]
    as.data.frame(x) %>%
      mutate(Subtype = specific_subtype) %>%
      pivot_longer(-Subtype, names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Value") %>%
      mutate(Modality = md)
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      Gene = factor(Gene, levels = genes),
      Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch"))
    )
  ggplot(long, aes(Subtype, Value, fill = Subtype)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, outlier.size = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = subtype_label) +
    facet_grid(Modality ~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), plot.title = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Subtype",
         y = "Value (RNA / Protein: log expression; Mismatch: residual)")
}
# 가로 그림용 저장 (save_figure_fun은 세로 6.5인치 기준이라 10열 패널이 좁아짐)
save_wide_figure_fun <- function(plot, filename, caption, width = 9.5, height = 5) {
  doc <- read_docx()
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, caption, style = "heading 2")
  doc <- body_end_section_portrait(doc)
  doc <- body_add_gg(doc, value = plot, width = width, height = height)
  doc <- body_end_section_landscape(doc)
  print(doc, target = file.path("figure", filename))
}

# Figure 2 : mismatch 특이 유전자 상위 10개

    "and RNA-protein mismatch for the ten mismatch-specific genes with the largest",
    "gain in subtype effect (Table 10). Rows: modality; columns: genes ordered by gain."
```

## 13. 분류기가 실제로 고른 mismatch marker : 데이터 주도 DIABLO의 outer fold별 선택 (예산 30·60·90·150)
```{r}
# 섹션 9B(Table 8)는 예산 30에서 mismatch가 몇 개 선택되는지만 센다. 여기서는 같은 데이터 주도
# 배분(cor 기준, 3-block, pool_keepx = 예산)을 outer fold 5개에서 예산 4개로 반복해
#   (1) 예산별 블록 구성(Table 11), (2) 실제로 선택된 mismatch 유전자 목록과 그 η²(Supplementary Data 2),
#   (3) 선택된 marker의 RNA/Protein/Mismatch subtype 분포(Figure S1; fold 교집합 기준 본문 그림은 섹션 16)를 얻는다.
# 예산 30의 선택은 9B-1(nested CV의 outer 선택)과 코드 경로·fold·적합이 같으므로 결과가 일치해야 한다(아래 검증).
# 이 절은 선택 결과만 보며 RF 성능은 다시 추정하지 않는다(예산 30의 성능은 Table S5).
marker_budget_list <- c(30L, 60L, 90L, 150L)
marker_blocks <- c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch")

marker_fold_selection <- purrr::map_dfr(marker_budget_list, function(budget) {
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(outer_folds), function(i) {
    valid_index <- outer_folds[[i]]
    res <- sparse_pooled_core_fun(
      id_order[-valid_index], id_order[valid_index], marker_blocks,
      score_types = "cor", total_keepx = budget, pool_keepx = budget
    )[["cor"]]
    cat("[marker] budget", budget, "fold", i, "done\n")
    res$selected %>% mutate(Budget = budget, Outer_Fold = i)
  })
})

marker_composition <- marker_fold_selection %>%
  count(Budget, Outer_Fold, Block) %>%
  tidyr::complete(Budget, Outer_Fold = seq_along(outer_folds), Block = marker_blocks,
                  fill = list(n = 0L)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Block, values_from = n, values_fill = 0L) %>%
  arrange(Budget, Outer_Fold)
stopifnot(all(marker_composition$RNA + marker_composition$Protein + marker_composition$Mismatch ==
                marker_composition$Budget))

# 검증 : 예산 30의 fold별 블록 구성 = 섹션 9B-1의 3-block (cor) nested CV outer 선택
marker_check_30 <- marker_composition %>% filter(Budget == sparse_total_keepx) %>% arrange(Outer_Fold)
marker_ref_30 <- pooled_fold_results %>%
  filter(Model == "RNA-Protein-Mismatch(s)", Score_Criterion == "cor") %>%
  arrange(Outer_Fold)
stopifnot(
  identical(as.integer(marker_check_30$Mismatch), as.integer(marker_ref_30$N_Mismatch)),
  identical(as.integer(marker_check_30$RNA), as.integer(marker_ref_30$N_RNA)),
  identical(as.integer(marker_check_30$Protein), as.integer(marker_ref_30$N_Protein))
)

# 13-1. 선택된 mismatch marker 목록 (예산별 합집합) + 섹션 12의 η²·특이 여부
marker_mismatch_list <- marker_fold_selection %>%
  filter(Block == "Mismatch") %>%
  group_by(Budget, Gene = Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    N_folds_selected = dplyr::n(),
    Folds = paste(sort(Outer_Fold), collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    mismatch_specific_genes %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, Eta_RNA, Eta_Protein, Eta_Mismatch, Eta_gain, Mismatch_specific,
                    Rank_Eta_Mismatch, Rank_Eta_gain),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    In_Table5_top10 = Gene %in% table5_top_fdr$Gene,
    RNA_also_selected_any_fold = mapply(function(g, b) {
      any(marker_fold_selection$Feature == g & marker_fold_selection$Block == "RNA" &
            marker_fold_selection$Budget == b)
    }, Gene, Budget),
    Protein_also_selected_any_fold = mapply(function(g, b) {
      any(marker_fold_selection$Feature == g & marker_fold_selection$Block == "Protein" &
            marker_fold_selection$Budget == b)
    }, Gene, Budget)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Budget, desc(N_folds_selected), desc(Eta_Mismatch))
stopifnot(!anyNA(marker_mismatch_list$Eta_Mismatch))
marker_mismatch_list

# 13-2. Table 11 : 예산별 블록 구성과 mismatch marker 특성
marker_budget_summary <- marker_composition %>%
  group_by(Budget) %>%
  summarise(
    RNA_mean = mean(RNA), Protein_mean = mean(Protein),
    Mismatch_mean = mean(Mismatch), Mismatch_min = min(Mismatch), Mismatch_max = max(Mismatch),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Mismatch_share_pct = 100 * Mismatch_mean / Budget) %>%
  left_join(
    marker_mismatch_list %>%
      group_by(Budget) %>%
      summarise(
        N_union = dplyr::n(),
        N_selected_2plus_folds = sum(N_folds_selected >= 2),
        N_selected_all_5_folds = sum(N_folds_selected == 5),
        Median_Eta_Mismatch = median(Eta_Mismatch),
        Median_Eta_Protein = median(Eta_Protein),
        Median_Eta_RNA = median(Eta_RNA),
        Pct_Eta_gain_positive = 100 * mean(Eta_gain > 0),
        N_mismatch_specific = sum(Mismatch_specific),
        N_in_Table5_top10 = sum(In_Table5_top10),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "Budget"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(N_union, N_selected_2plus_folds, N_selected_all_5_folds,
                  N_mismatch_specific, N_in_Table5_top10), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)))
marker_budget_summary

save_table_fun(
  marker_budget_summary,
  "Table11_DIABLO_Mismatch_Markers_By_Budget.docx",
  paste(
    "Table 11. Mismatch features retained by the data-driven allocation (correlation",
    "criterion) in the three-block model at total budgets of 30, 60, 90 and 150",
    "features. Block counts are means over the five outer-fold training sets (range",
    "for mismatch); the budget-30 row reproduces the three-block 'cor' row of",
    "Table 8. N_union is the number of distinct mismatch genes retained in at least",
    "one fold; eta-squared values and the mismatch-specific flag come from the",
    "genome-wide screen of Table 9 (full sample), and N_mismatch_specific counts",
    "retained mismatch genes that belong to the mismatch-specific set."
  ),
  digits = 2, landscape = TRUE, fontsize_pt = 7
)

# Supplementary Data 2 : 예산별 mismatch marker 전체 목록
marker_list_table <- marker_mismatch_list %>%
  transmute(
    Budget, Gene, N_folds_selected, Folds,
    Eta_RNA, Eta_Protein, Eta_Mismatch, Eta_gain,
    Rank_Eta_Mismatch, Mismatch_specific, In_Table5_top10,
    RNA_also_selected_any_fold, Protein_also_selected_any_fold
  )
save_table_fun(
  marker_list_table,
  "SupplementaryData2_DIABLO_Mismatch_Marker_List.docx",
  paste(
    "Supplementary Data 2. Mismatch genes retained by the data-driven allocation (correlation",
    "criterion, three-block model) in at least one outer-fold training set, by total",
    "budget. Eta-squared values are from the full-sample screen of Table 9;",
    "Rank_Eta_Mismatch is the rank of the gene's mismatch eta-squared among all input",
    "genes (1 = largest); Mismatch_specific marks membership in the mismatch-specific",
    "set; the last two columns indicate whether the same gene was also retained as an",
    "RNA or a protein feature in any fold at that budget."
  ),
  digits = 3, landscape = TRUE, fontsize_pt = 7
)

# 13-3. (2026-10-16 정리) 합집합 marker의 modality별 boxplot(구 Figure S1, 예산 4개)은 fold 교집합 그림(섹션 16,
#       Figure 3·S3)과 중복이고 D1 지적(단일 fold 결과)대로 해석에 쓰지 않으므로 더 이상 저장하지 않는다. 목록은 Supplementary Data 2에 남는다.

# 섹션 12 특이 유전자와 Table S17 유전자 중 어느 예산에서도 선택되지 않은 것 (본문 인용용)
```
