## 14. 두 관점의 연결 : mismatch 특이 유전자가 희소 분류기의 mismatch 블록에서 차지한 순위
```{r}
# 섹션 12(전체 탐색)와 섹션 13(분류기 선택)이 서로 다른 유전자를 가리키는 이유를 직접 확인한다
# (2026-09-15 교수님 지시). mismatch 블록을 포함하는 네 희소 모형(Mismatch-only / Protein-Mismatch /
# RNA-Mismatch / RNA-Protein-Mismatch)을 전체 자료(Fold 0)와 outer fold 5개의 training set에 예산별로
# 적합하고, mismatch 블록 안에서 각 유전자의 순위를 매긴다.
#   Rank_cor       : 희소 적합의 mismatch 성분점수와 |cor| 최댓값 순위 (입력 유전자 전체 중; 본문 선택 기준 "cor")
#   Candidate      : 성분 3개 중 하나라도 loading이 0이 아니었는가 (희소 선택 통과)
#   Final_selected : 예산 절단 후 실제 RF 입력에 남았는가 (단일 블록 = 상위 예산개; 다중 블록 = 블록 무관 pooled 상위 예산개)
#   Rank_full_loading : 희소성 없이(keepX = 전체) 적합한 (block) PLS-DA의 max|loading| 순위 (예산 무관 보조 지표)
# 관심 유전자 집합 : (1) Figure 2의 mismatch 특이 상위 10개, (2) 예산 150에서 5/5 fold 선택된 marker(Supplementary Data 2),
#                    (3) Table S17의 FDR 상위 10개. 전체 특이 집합의 농축은 14-3에서 별도로 본다.
rank_models <- list(
  "Mismatch-only"        = "Mismatch",
  "Protein-Mismatch"     = c("Protein", "Mismatch"),
  "RNA-Mismatch"         = c("RNA", "Mismatch"),
  "RNA-Protein-Mismatch" = c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch")
)
rank_budget_list <- marker_budget_list
rank_gene_groups <- list(
  "Mismatch-specific top 10 (Figure 2)" = figure4_gene,
  "Retained in all 5 folds at budget 150 (Supplementary Data 2)" =
    marker_mismatch_list$Gene[marker_mismatch_list$Budget == 150L &
                                marker_mismatch_list$N_folds_selected == 5L],
  "Table S17 top 10 (FDR)" = figure_s2_gene
)
rank_gene_groups <- rank_gene_groups[lengths(rank_gene_groups) > 0]
rank_group_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(rank_gene_groups, function(g, nm) tibble(Gene = g, Group = nm))
stopifnot(all(rank_group_table$Gene %in% specific_gene))

rank_desc_fun <- function(v) rank(-v, ties.method = "min")
rank_score_all_fun <- function(x_block, variate_matrix) {
  cm <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(x_block, variate_matrix))
  cm[!is.finite(cm)] <- 0
  setNames(apply(abs(cm), 1, max), colnames(x_block))
}

rank_fold_sets <- c(list(NULL), outer_folds)   # index 1 = 전체 자료(Fold 0)
rank_one_fun <- function(model_name, blocks, fold_index) {
  valid_index <- rank_fold_sets[[fold_index]]
  train_id <- if (is.null(valid_index)) id_order else id_order[-valid_index]
  valid_id <- if (is.null(valid_index)) id_order else id_order[valid_index]
  fold_id <- fold_index - 1L
  block_data <- sparse_block_data_fun(train_id, valid_id, blocks)
  y_train <- subtype_by_id[train_id]
  x_mm <- block_data$x_train[["Mismatch"]]
  gene_mm <- colnames(x_mm)

  # (a) 비희소 적합 : keepX = 전체 -> max|loading| 순위 (예산 무관)
  fit_full <- sparse_fit_fun(
    block_data$x_train, y_train,
    setNames(vapply(block_data$x_train, ncol, integer(1)), blocks),
    sparse_ncomp, sparse_design_offdiag
  )
  rank_full_loading <- rank_desc_fun(apply(abs(fit_full$loadings[["Mismatch"]]), 1, max))[gene_mm]

  # (b) 예산별 희소 적합 (섹션 9/9B와 같은 함수·설정)
  purrr::map_dfr(rank_budget_list, function(budget) {
    keepx <- setNames(rep(budget, length(blocks)), blocks)
    fit <- sparse_fit_fun(block_data$x_train, y_train, keepx, sparse_ncomp, sparse_design_offdiag)
    score_all <- rank_score_all_fun(x_mm, fit$variates[["Mismatch"]])
    candidate <- rownames(fit$loadings[["Mismatch"]])[rowSums(fit$loadings[["Mismatch"]] != 0) > 0]
    if (length(blocks) == 1L) {
      score_c <- sparse_feature_score_fun(fit$loadings[["Mismatch"]], x_mm, fit$variates[["Mismatch"]], "cor")
      final_mm <- sparse_top_n_fun(score_c, budget)
    } else {
      score_table <- purrr::map_dfr(blocks, function(bl) {
        sc <- sparse_feature_score_fun(fit$loadings[[bl]], block_data$x_train[[bl]], fit$variates[[bl]], "cor")
        tibble(Block = bl, Feature = names(sc), Score = as.numeric(sc))
      })
      top_table <- score_table %>% arrange(desc(Score), Block, Feature) %>% head(budget)
      final_mm <- top_table$Feature[top_table$Block == "Mismatch"]
    }
    tibble(
      Model = model_name, Budget = budget, Outer_Fold = fold_id, Gene = gene_mm,
      Score_cor = as.numeric(score_all[gene_mm]),
      Rank_cor = as.integer(rank_desc_fun(score_all)[gene_mm]),
      Candidate = gene_mm %in% candidate,
      Final_selected = gene_mm %in% final_mm,
      N_final_mismatch = length(final_mm),
      Rank_full_loading = as.integer(rank_full_loading),
      P_mismatch_block = length(gene_mm)
    )
  })
}

rank_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(rank_models, function(blocks, nm) {
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(rank_fold_sets), function(fi) {
    out <- rank_one_fun(nm, blocks, fi)
    cat("[rank]", nm, "fold", fi - 1L, "done\n")
    out
  })
}) %>%
  left_join(
    mismatch_specific_genes %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, Eta_Mismatch, Eta_gain, Mismatch_specific, Rank_Eta_Mismatch, Rank_Eta_gain),
    by = "Gene"
  )
stopifnot(!anyNA(rank_all$Mismatch_specific))

# 검증 : 3-block 모형의 fold별 최종 mismatch 수 = 섹션 13의 구성 (같은 적합이어야 함)
rank_check_3block <- rank_all %>%
  filter(Model == "RNA-Protein-Mismatch", Outer_Fold > 0) %>%
  distinct(Budget, Outer_Fold, N_final_mismatch) %>%
  arrange(Budget, Outer_Fold)
stopifnot(identical(
  as.integer(rank_check_3block$N_final_mismatch),
  as.integer(marker_composition$Mismatch)
))
# 단일 블록 모형의 최종 선택 수 = 예산
stopifnot(all(rank_all$N_final_mismatch[rank_all$Model == "Mismatch-only"] ==
                rank_all$Budget[rank_all$Model == "Mismatch-only"]))
write.csv(
  rank_all %>% inner_join(rank_group_table, by = "Gene"),
  file.path("table", "Section14_gene_of_interest_rank_long.csv"), row.names = FALSE
)

# 14-1. 관심 유전자 요약 (outer fold 1–5) : 모형 x 예산별 순위 중앙값·범위, 최종 선택 fold 수 (+ 전체자료 순위)
rank_goi_summary <- rank_all %>%
  inner_join(rank_group_table, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(Outer_Fold > 0) %>%
  group_by(Group, Gene, Model, Budget) %>%
  summarise(
    Rank_cor_median = median(Rank_cor), Rank_cor_min = min(Rank_cor), Rank_cor_max = max(Rank_cor),
    N_folds_candidate = sum(Candidate), N_folds_final = sum(Final_selected),
    Rank_full_loading_median = median(Rank_full_loading),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    rank_all %>% filter(Outer_Fold == 0) %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, Model, Budget, Rank_cor_full_data = Rank_cor, Final_full_data = Final_selected),
    by = c("Gene", "Model", "Budget")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    mismatch_specific_genes %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, Eta_Mismatch, Eta_gain, Rank_Eta_Mismatch, Rank_Eta_gain, Mismatch_specific),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, names(rank_gene_groups)), match(Gene, rank_group_table$Gene),
          match(Model, names(rank_models)), Budget)
write.csv(rank_goi_summary, file.path("table", "Section14_gene_of_interest_rank_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 넓은 표 : 행 = 유전자, 열 = 모형 ; 셀 = "순위 중앙값 (최소–최대) [최종 선택 fold 수/5]"
rank_wide_fun <- function(budget, groups) {
  rank_goi_summary %>%
    filter(Budget == budget, Group %in% groups) %>%
    mutate(Cell = sprintf("%d (%d-%d) [%d/5]", as.integer(Rank_cor_median),
                          Rank_cor_min, Rank_cor_max, N_folds_final)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Group, Gene, Rank_Eta_gain, Rank_Eta_Mismatch, Model, Cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = Cell) %>%
    mutate(Budget = budget, .before = 1)
}

# 유전자별 순위 표 (mismatch 특이 상위 10개, 예산 30·150) — CSV만
rank_table_specific_top10 <- bind_rows(
  rank_wide_fun(30L, names(rank_gene_groups)[1]),
  rank_wide_fun(150L, names(rank_gene_groups)[1])
) %>% dplyr::select(-Group)
rank_table_specific_top10
write.csv(rank_table_specific_top10, file.path("table", "Section14_specific_top10_rank.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
# (2026-10-16 정리) 유전자별 순위 표(구 Table 12, Table S11)는 docx로 저장하지 않고 CSV(위 Section14_*)로만 남긴다;
# 논문에는 집합 수준 농축 요약(Table S11, 아래)만 싣는다.
rank_table_s13_comparison <- bind_rows(
  rank_wide_fun(30L, names(rank_gene_groups)[-1]),
  rank_wide_fun(150L, names(rank_gene_groups)[-1])
)
write.csv(rank_table_s13_comparison, file.path("table", "Section14_comparison_genes_rank.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 14-2. 지표 불일치 점검 : 희소 cor 순위와 비희소 loading 순위가 크게 다른 관심 유전자 (본문 각주용)
rank_metric_disagreement <- rank_goi_summary %>%
  filter(Budget == 30L) %>%
  group_by(Group, Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Rank_cor_median_across_models = median(Rank_cor_median),
    Rank_full_loading_median_across_models = median(Rank_full_loading_median),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Ratio = Rank_cor_median_across_models / pmax(1, Rank_full_loading_median_across_models)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Ratio))
rank_metric_disagreement

# 14-3. mismatch 특이 유전자 집합 전체의 농축 : 모형 x 예산별 순위 중앙값과 최종 선택 중 특이 유전자 비율
rank_specific_by_fold <- rank_all %>%
  filter(Outer_Fold > 0) %>%
  group_by(Model, Budget, Outer_Fold) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_rank_specific = median(Rank_cor[Mismatch_specific]),
    Median_rank_other = median(Rank_cor[!Mismatch_specific]),
    N_final = sum(Final_selected),
    N_final_specific = sum(Final_selected & Mismatch_specific),
    N_Figure4_top10_in_final = sum(Final_selected & Gene %in% figure4_gene),
    Best_rank_Figure4_top10 = min(Rank_cor[Gene %in% figure4_gene]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
rank_specific_summary <- rank_specific_by_fold %>%
  group_by(Model, Budget) %>%
  summarise(across(-Outer_Fold, mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Share_specific_in_final_pct = 100 * N_final_specific / pmax(N_final, 1e-9),
    Base_rate_pct = 100 * length(specific_gene_set) / length(specific_gene),
    Enrichment = Share_specific_in_final_pct / Base_rate_pct
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Model, names(rank_models)), Budget)
rank_specific_summary
write.csv(rank_specific_by_fold, file.path("table", "Section14_specific_enrichment_by_fold.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

save_table_fun(
  rank_specific_summary,
  "TableS11_Mismatch_Specific_Set_Enrichment.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S11. Enrichment of the mismatch-specific gene set (Table 9) among the",
    "mismatch features ranked and retained by the four sparse models, by total",
    "budget. Values are means over the five outer-fold training sets: the median",
    "within-block correlation rank of mismatch-specific and of all other genes,",
    "the number of mismatch features that entered the random forest (N_final) and",
    "how many of them were mismatch-specific, the resulting share, the base rate of",
    "mismatch-specific genes among all input genes, and their ratio (Enrichment)."
  ),
  digits = 1, landscape = TRUE, fontsize_pt = 7
)
```


## 16. fold 교집합 mismatch marker (>= 3/5 outer fold) : Figure 3 · Figure S1, subtype별 표준편차
```{r}
# 9/16 미팅 지시 A1. 섹션 13의 fold "합집합"(한 fold에서라도 선택) 목록은 예산 30·60에서 사실상 단일 fold
# 결과였으므로(D1), outer fold 5개 중 3개 이상(과반)에서 선택된 유전자만 "안정적 marker"로 다시 정의한다.
#   - 5/5 완전 교집합은 예산 90에서 1개, 150에서 4개뿐이라 그림으로 부족 -> >= 3/5 를 사전 기준으로 둔다.
#   - 예산 60·90의 교집합은 예산 150 교집합의 부분집합이므로 예산 150(16개)을 본문 Figure 3,
#     예산 60·90은 Figure S1(a·b)로 둔다.
# 2026-09-23 재실행(code/01_setup_and_select.R · 02_figureX6_boxplot.R)과 동일한 계산이다.
min_fold_intersection <- 3L
marker_fold_intersection <- marker_mismatch_list %>%
  filter(N_folds_selected >= min_fold_intersection) %>%
  arrange(Budget, desc(N_folds_selected), desc(Eta_Mismatch))
write.csv(marker_fold_intersection, file.path("table", "marker_fold_intersection.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
marker_fold_intersection %>% count(Budget, name = "N_intersection")
marker_fold_intersection %>% filter(N_folds_selected == 5L) %>% count(Budget, name = "N_all_5_folds")

# 예산 60·90 교집합이 예산 150 교집합의 부분집합인지 (본문 서술의 근거)
intersection_150 <- marker_fold_intersection$Gene[marker_fold_intersection$Budget == 150L]
intersection_nested <- marker_fold_intersection %>%
  filter(Budget != 150L) %>%
  group_by(Budget) %>%
  summarise(N = dplyr::n(), N_in_budget150 = sum(Gene %in% intersection_150), .groups = "drop")
intersection_nested

# Table 11에 교집합(>= 3/5) 개수 열을 더해 다시 저장
marker_budget_summary <- marker_budget_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("N_selected_3plus_folds")) %>%
  left_join(
    marker_fold_intersection %>% count(Budget, name = "N_selected_3plus_folds"),
    by = "Budget"
  ) %>%
  mutate(N_selected_3plus_folds = replace_na(N_selected_3plus_folds, 0L)) %>%
  relocate(N_selected_3plus_folds, .after = N_selected_2plus_folds)
marker_budget_summary
save_table_fun(
  marker_budget_summary,
  "Table11_DIABLO_Mismatch_Markers_By_Budget.docx",
  paste(
    "Table 11. Mismatch features retained by the data-driven allocation (correlation",
    "criterion) in the three-block model at total budgets of 30, 60, 90 and 150",
    "features. Block counts are means over the five outer-fold training sets (range",
    "for mismatch); the budget-30 row reproduces the three-block 'cor' row of",
    "Table 8. N_union is the number of distinct mismatch genes retained in at least",
    "one fold, N_selected_3plus_folds the number retained in at least three of the",
    "five folds (the fold-intersection markers of Figures 3 and S3), and",
    "N_selected_all_5_folds the number retained in every fold; eta-squared values",
    "and the mismatch-specific flag come from the genome-wide screen of Table 9",
    "(full sample)."
  ),
  digits = 2, landscape = TRUE, fontsize_pt = 7

# 16-1. 유전자 라벨에 fold 선택 횟수를 붙이는 boxplot (섹션 12-6 modality_boxplot_fun의 라벨 버전)
modality_boxplot_label_fun <- function(genes, gene_label, title) {
  stopifnot(all(genes %in% specific_gene), length(genes) == length(gene_label))
  long <- purrr::map_dfr(c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch"), function(md) {
    x <- list(RNA = specific_rn, Protein = specific_pr, Mismatch = specific_mm)[[md]][, genes, drop = FALSE]
    as.data.frame(x) %>%
      mutate(Subtype = specific_subtype) %>%
      pivot_longer(-Subtype, names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Value") %>%
      mutate(Modality = md)
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      Gene = factor(Gene, levels = genes, labels = gene_label),
      Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch"))
    )
  ggplot(long, aes(Subtype, Value, fill = Subtype)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, outlier.size = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = subtype_label) +
    facet_grid(Modality ~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), plot.title = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Subtype",
         y = "Value (RNA / Protein: log expression; Mismatch: residual)")
}

intersection_figure_fun <- function(budget, filename, figure_label) {
  g <- marker_fold_intersection %>% filter(Budget == budget)
  if (nrow(g) == 0) {
    message("budget ", budget, ": no fold-intersection marker; figure skipped")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  save_wide_figure_fun(
    modality_boxplot_label_fun(
      g$Gene, sprintf("%s (%d/5)", g$Gene, g$N_folds_selected),
      sprintf("Fold-intersection mismatch markers (>= %d/5 folds), budget %d (n = %d)",
              min_fold_intersection, budget, nrow(g))
    ),
    filename,
    sprintf(
      paste(
        "%s. Subtype-specific distributions of RNA expression, protein abundance and",
        "RNA-protein mismatch for the mismatch features retained in at least %d of the",
        "5 outer-fold training sets by the data-driven allocation (correlation criterion,",
        "three-block DIABLO, total budget %d). Column labels give the number of folds in",
        "which the gene was retained; genes are ordered by that number and then by",
        "mismatch eta-squared (full sample, n = 110)."
      ),
      figure_label, min_fold_intersection, budget
    ),
    width = max(5.5, 0.85 * nrow(g) + 1.5), height = 5
  )
}
intersection_figure_fun(150L, "Figure3_FoldIntersection_Budget150_Boxplot.docx", "Figure 3")
intersection_figure_fun(60L, "FigureS1_1_FoldIntersection_Budget60_Boxplot.docx", "Figure S1 (1/2)")
intersection_figure_fun(90L, "FigureS1_2_FoldIntersection_Budget90_Boxplot.docx", "Figure S1 (2/2)")

# 16-2. 교집합 16개(예산 150)의 subtype별 표준편차 : Protein 대비 Mismatch (잔차화에 따른 SD 축소가 LumB 고유인가)
subtype_sd_by_gene <- purrr::map_dfr(subtype_levels, function(s) {
  idx <- specific_subtype == s
  tibble(
    Subtype = s, N = sum(idx), Gene = intersection_150,
    SD_RNA = apply(specific_rn[idx, intersection_150, drop = FALSE], 2, sd),
    SD_Protein = apply(specific_pr[idx, intersection_150, drop = FALSE], 2, sd),
    SD_Mismatch = apply(specific_mm[idx, intersection_150, drop = FALSE], 2, sd),
    Mean_Protein = colMeans(specific_pr[idx, intersection_150, drop = FALSE]),
    Mean_Mismatch = colMeans(specific_mm[idx, intersection_150, drop = FALSE])
  )
}) %>% mutate(SD_ratio_M_over_P = SD_Mismatch / SD_Protein)
write.csv(subtype_sd_by_gene, file.path("table", "fold_intersection_subtype_sd_by_gene.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
subtype_sd_summary <- subtype_sd_by_gene %>%
  group_by(Subtype, N) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_SD_Protein = median(SD_Protein), Median_SD_Mismatch = median(SD_Mismatch),
    Median_SD_ratio = median(SD_ratio_M_over_P),
    Pct_ratio_below_0.8 = 100 * mean(SD_ratio_M_over_P < 0.8),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
subtype_sd_summary
write.csv(subtype_sd_summary, file.path("table", "fold_intersection_subtype_sd_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```


## 17. Luminal B : 분산 차이인가 위치 이동인가 — Levene · Welch t · Cohen d (Table 12), LumB 편차 분해 (Figure 4, Supplementary Data 3)
```{r}
# 9/16 미팅 지시 D2. Figure X5에서 LumB가 Protein 패널과 Mismatch 패널에서 "분산이 달라 보인" 관찰을 검정한다.
#   (1) 교집합 16개 유전자(예산 150)에서 LumB vs LumA(혼동되는 쌍)의 분산 차이(Brown-Forsythe/Levene,
#       중앙값 중심 = car::leveneTest 기본값 = scipy.stats.levene(center = "median"))와
#       위치 차이(Welch t, Cohen d)를 Protein·Mismatch 값 각각에서 계산한다.
#   (2) 같은 유전자에서 LumB 편차(LumB 평균 - 나머지 세 아형 평균)를 Protein = Fitted(RNA + 공변량) + Mismatch
#       로 분해해, protein 하향 중 RNA로 설명되는 몫과 mismatch에 남는 몫을 본다 (Figure 4).
# 전체 표본 110명 기준의 탐색적 분석이며(LumB n = 15), 검정력이 낮으므로 "분산 차이 없음"은
# "검출되지 않음"으로 읽는다(한계 단락).
is_lumb <- specific_subtype == "LumB"
is_luma <- specific_subtype == "LumA"

levene_p_fun <- function(x, g) {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g))
  group_median <- tapply(x, g, median)
  z <- abs(x - group_median[as.character(g)])
  summary(aov(z ~ g))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
}
cohen_d_fun <- function(a, b) (mean(a) - mean(b)) / sqrt((var(a) + var(b)) / 2)

lumb_variance_location <- purrr::map_dfr(intersection_150, function(g) {
  purrr::map_dfr(c("Protein", "Mismatch"), function(md) {
    x <- list(Protein = specific_pr, Mismatch = specific_mm)[[md]][, g]
    tibble(
      Gene = g, Modality = md,
      SD_LumB = sd(x[is_lumb]), SD_LumA = sd(x[is_luma]), SD_rest = sd(x[!is_lumb]),
      Levene_p_LumB_vs_LumA = levene_p_fun(x[is_lumb | is_luma], specific_subtype[is_lumb | is_luma]),
      Levene_p_LumB_vs_rest = levene_p_fun(x, is_lumb),
      Welch_t_p_LumB_vs_LumA = t.test(x[is_lumb], x[is_luma])$p.value,
      d_LumB_vs_LumA = cohen_d_fun(x[is_lumb], x[is_luma])
    )
  })
})
write.csv(lumb_variance_location,
          file.path("table", "fold_intersection150_LumB_variance_vs_location.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 16개 유전자 안에서의 다중검정 보정(BH) : 유전자 수가 작아 보조 지표로만 둔다 (2026-10-16 추가)
lumb_variance_location <- lumb_variance_location %>%
  group_by(Modality) %>%
  mutate(Levene_FDR_LumB_vs_LumA = p.adjust(Levene_p_LumB_vs_LumA, "BH"),
         Welch_FDR_LumB_vs_LumA = p.adjust(Welch_t_p_LumB_vs_LumA, "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
lumb_variance_location_summary <- lumb_variance_location %>%
  group_by(Modality) %>%
  summarise(
    N_genes = dplyr::n(),
    N_Levene_p_below_0.05_LumB_vs_LumA = sum(Levene_p_LumB_vs_LumA < 0.05),
    N_Levene_p_below_0.05_LumB_vs_rest = sum(Levene_p_LumB_vs_rest < 0.05),
    N_Welch_p_below_0.05 = sum(Welch_t_p_LumB_vs_LumA < 0.05),
    N_Welch_FDR_below_0.05 = sum(Welch_FDR_LumB_vs_LumA < 0.05),
    N_Levene_FDR_below_0.05 = sum(Levene_FDR_LumB_vs_LumA < 0.05),
    Median_abs_d = median(abs(d_LumB_vs_LumA)),
    Median_SD_LumB = median(SD_LumB), Median_SD_LumA = median(SD_LumA),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
lumb_variance_location_summary

# Table 12 : 유전자별 (Protein / Mismatch 나란히)
table14_lumb <- lumb_variance_location %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Modality, SD_LumB, SD_LumA, Levene_p_LumB_vs_LumA, Welch_t_p_LumB_vs_LumA, Welch_FDR_LumB_vs_LumA, d_LumB_vs_LumA) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Modality,
    values_from = c(SD_LumB, SD_LumA, Levene_p_LumB_vs_LumA, Welch_t_p_LumB_vs_LumA, Welch_FDR_LumB_vs_LumA, d_LumB_vs_LumA),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Modality}"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    marker_fold_intersection %>% filter(Budget == 150L) %>% dplyr::select(Gene, N_folds_selected),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_folds_selected), Gene) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gene, N_folds_selected,
    Levene_p_LumB_vs_LumA_Protein, Welch_t_p_LumB_vs_LumA_Protein, Welch_FDR_LumB_vs_LumA_Protein, d_LumB_vs_LumA_Protein,
    Levene_p_LumB_vs_LumA_Mismatch, Welch_t_p_LumB_vs_LumA_Mismatch, Welch_FDR_LumB_vs_LumA_Mismatch, d_LumB_vs_LumA_Mismatch
  )
table14_lumb
save_table_fun(
  table14_lumb,
  "Table12_LumB_Variance_vs_Location.docx",
  paste(
    "Table 12. Variance versus location differences between Luminal B (n = 15) and",
    "Luminal A (n = 54) for the sixteen fold-intersection mismatch markers at budget",
    "150, computed separately on protein abundance and on RNA-protein mismatch (full",
    "sample). Levene p: Brown-Forsythe (median-centred) test of equal variances;",
    "Welch p: Welch two-sample t test of equal means, with its Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over the",
    "sixteen genes (Welch FDR); d: Cohen's d (Luminal B minus Luminal A). N_folds_selected: number",
    "of outer folds (of 5) in which the gene was retained as a mismatch feature."
  ),

)

# 17-1b. 기질 분율 대안 가설의 점검용 : 아형별 종양 순도 (ESTIMATE) — LumB와 LumA의 차이 (2026-10-16 추가)
#   mismatch는 순도를 공변량으로 잔차화한 값이므로 순도와의 선형 상관은 정의상 0이다. 여기서는 LumB가 LumA보다
#   순도가 낮은지(기질이 많은지)만 확인해 콜라겐 접힘 모듈 하향의 조직 조성 설명이 성립할 여지를 본다.
purity_by_subtype <- clinical_data %>%

)
purity_lumB_vs_lumA_summary

fitted_full <- specific_pr - specific_mm   # 정의상 fitted = protein - residual
```

## 18. Luminal B Shapley value (R : randomForest + 순열 표집 Shapley) — Figure 5 · S2, Table 13 · Supplementary Data 4
```{r}
# 9/16 미팅 지시 A2·A3. 분류기가 LumB를 가를 때 각 marker의 "값의 위치"를 쓰는지(단조 dependence),
# 아니면 분산 같은 비단조 정보를 쓰는지(U자형)를 Shapley value로 본다.
#   모형   : 4-class randomForest (ntree 500 (주 분석과 동일; 2026-10-12 통일), mtry = sqrt(p)), 유전자 집합 = 섹션 13/16의 fold 합집합(예산 4개)
#            과 fold 교집합(예산 60·90·150), 입력 = 같은 유전자의 RNA / Protein / Mismatch / Protein+Mismatch.
#   SHAP   : 논문의 outer fold 5개를 그대로 써서 out-of-fold로 계산(4 fold 적합 -> 나머지 fold 표본의
#            LumB 확률에 대한 SHAP). 전체표본 적합의 in-sample SHAP은 p가 작을 때 훈련 표본 암기 효과가
#            지배해 dependence plot에 부적합했다(2026-09-23 로그).
#   성능   : 같은 out-of-fold LumB 확률의 LumB-vs-rest AUC (비교용; 유전자 집합을 전체 fold 선택 결과로
#            정했으므로 nested CV 성능이 아니다). OOB recall은 전체표본 적합에서.
#   구현   : 외부 패키지 없이 순열 표집 Shapley(Strumbelj & Kononenko 2014)를 직접 구현한다(mc_shap_fun).
#            시뮬레이션마다 feature 순서 하나와 배경 표본(training에서 복원추출) 하나를 뽑아 순서대로 feature를
#            새 관측값으로 바꿔 가며 LumB 확률의 증분을 누적한다 -> 각 시뮬레이션에서 기여도 합 = f(x) - f(z) (efficiency).
#            nsim = shap_nsim 회 평균. 2026-09-23 재실행은 Python scikit-learn + shap TreeExplainer(정확 계산)였다
#            (code/03_shapley_lumB.py). R 재계산은 RF 구현·근사 차이로 수치가 소폭 다르나 결론(단조 dependence,
#            상위 유전자)은 같아야 한다.
shap_ntree <- 500L   # 주 분석(random_forest_trees = 500)과 통일, 2026-10-12
shap_nsim <- 100L
shap_seed <- 2026L
shap_modalities <- c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch", "Protein+Mismatch")
lumb_level <- "LumB"

# 18-1. 유전자 집합
shap_gene_sets <- list()
for (b in marker_budget_list) {
  u <- marker_mismatch_list %>% filter(Budget == b) %>% arrange(desc(N_folds_selected), desc(Eta_Mismatch))
  shap_gene_sets[[paste0("union_", b)]] <- list(set = "union", budget = b, genes = u$Gene)
  if (b != 30L) {
    shap_gene_sets[[paste0("intersection_", b)]] <- list(
      set = "intersection", budget = b,
      genes = u$Gene[u$N_folds_selected >= min_fold_intersection]
    )
  }
}
shap_gene_sets <- shap_gene_sets[vapply(shap_gene_sets, function(s) length(s$genes) >= 2L, logical(1))]

shap_build_x_fun <- function(genes, modality) {
  if (modality == "Protein+Mismatch") {
    x <- cbind(specific_pr[, genes, drop = FALSE], specific_mm[, genes, drop = FALSE])
    colnames(x) <- c(paste0("Protein__", genes), paste0("Mismatch__", genes))
  } else {
    x <- list(RNA = specific_rn, Protein = specific_pr, Mismatch = specific_mm)[[modality]][, genes, drop = FALSE]
  }
  as.data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE)
}
shap_pred_fun <- function(object, newdata) {
  predict(object, newdata = newdata, type = "prob")[, lumb_level]
}
# 순열 표집 Shapley : 한 단계(k)마다 nsim개 시뮬레이션의 현재 행렬을 세로로 쌓아 predict를 1회만 호출한다
mc_shap_fun <- function(model, x_train, x_new, pred_fun, nsim, seed) {
  p <- ncol(x_new); n_new <- nrow(x_new); n_tr <- nrow(x_train)
  set.seed(seed)
  perm <- t(replicate(nsim, sample.int(p)))                 # nsim x p : 시뮬레이션별 feature 순서
  if (p == 1L) perm <- matrix(perm, nsim, 1L)
  big <- x_train[sample.int(n_tr, nsim * n_new, replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]   # 배경 표본
  rownames(big) <- NULL
  sim_rows <- split(seq_len(nsim * n_new), rep(seq_len(nsim), each = n_new))
  shap <- matrix(0, n_new, p, dimnames = list(rownames(x_new), colnames(x_new)))
  pred_prev <- pred_fun(model, big)
  for (k in seq_len(p)) {
    for (s in seq_len(nsim)) {
      j <- perm[s, k]
      big[sim_rows[[s]], j] <- x_new[, j]
    }
    pred_now <- pred_fun(model, big)
    delta <- pred_now - pred_prev
    for (s in seq_len(nsim)) {
      j <- perm[s, k]
      shap[, j] <- shap[, j] + delta[sim_rows[[s]]]
    }
    pred_prev <- pred_now
  }
  shap / nsim
}
auc_fun <- function(score, positive) {   # Mann-Whitney AUC
  r <- rank(score); n1 <- sum(positive); n0 <- sum(!positive)
  (sum(r[positive]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}
y_full <- factor(subtype_by_id[id_order], levels = subtype_levels)
fold_of_sample <- integer(length(id_order))
for (i in seq_along(outer_folds)) fold_of_sample[outer_folds[[i]]] <- i
stopifnot(all(fold_of_sample %in% seq_along(outer_folds)))

# 18-2. 집합 x modality 반복 : OOB 성능(전체표본 적합) + out-of-fold SHAP·확률
shap_perf_list <- list(); shap_contrib_list <- list(); shap_value_list <- list()
for (set_name in names(shap_gene_sets)) {
  gs <- shap_gene_sets[[set_name]]
  for (md in shap_modalities) {
    x <- shap_build_x_fun(gs$genes, md)
    set.seed(shap_seed)
    rf_full <- randomForest(x = x, y = y_full, ntree = shap_ntree, mtry = max(1, floor(sqrt(ncol(x)))))
    oob_pred <- rf_full$predicted
    oob_prob <- rf_full$votes[, lumb_level]
    # out-of-fold SHAP
    shap_mat <- matrix(0, nrow(x), ncol(x), dimnames = list(id_order, colnames(x)))
    oof_prob <- numeric(nrow(x))
    for (k in seq_along(outer_folds)) {
      tr <- fold_of_sample != k; va <- !tr
      set.seed(shap_seed + k)
      rf_k <- randomForest(x = x[tr, , drop = FALSE], y = y_full[tr], ntree = shap_ntree,
                           mtry = max(1, floor(sqrt(ncol(x)))))
      oof_prob[va] <- shap_pred_fun(rf_k, x[va, , drop = FALSE])
      shap_mat[va, ] <- mc_shap_fun(
        rf_k, x_train = x[tr, , drop = FALSE], x_new = x[va, , drop = FALSE],
        pred_fun = shap_pred_fun, nsim = shap_nsim, seed = shap_seed + 100 + k
      )
    }
    shap_perf_list[[paste(set_name, md)]] <- tibble(
      Set = gs$set, Budget = gs$budget, Modality = md, N_genes = length(gs$genes), N_features = ncol(x),
      OOB_AUC_LumB_vs_rest = auc_fun(oob_prob, y_full == lumb_level),
      OOB_LumB_recall = mean(oob_pred[y_full == lumb_level] == lumb_level),
      OOB_LumB_precision = if (any(oob_pred == lumb_level)) mean(y_full[oob_pred == lumb_level] == lumb_level) else NA_real_,
      OOB_macro_BA = metric_vector_fun(y_full, oob_pred)[["Macro_Balanced_Accuracy"]],
      OOB_LumB_pred_as_LumA = sum(oob_pred == "LumA" & y_full == lumb_level),
      CV_AUC_LumB_vs_rest = auc_fun(oof_prob, y_full == lumb_level)
    )
    shap_contrib_list[[paste(set_name, md)]] <- purrr::map_dfr(colnames(x), function(f) {
      tibble(
        Set = gs$set, Budget = gs$budget, Modality = md, Feature = f,
        Gene = sub("^.*__", "", f),
        Block = if (grepl("__", f, fixed = TRUE)) sub("__.*$", "", f) else md,
        Mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(shap_mat[, f])),
        Mean_SHAP_in_LumB = mean(shap_mat[is_lumb, f]),
        Mean_SHAP_in_rest = mean(shap_mat[!is_lumb, f]),
        Corr_value_SHAP = suppressWarnings(cor(x[[f]], shap_mat[, f])),
        Spearman_value_SHAP = suppressWarnings(cor(x[[f]], shap_mat[, f], method = "spearman")),
        LumB_shift = mean(x[[f]][is_lumb]) - mean(x[[f]][!is_lumb])
      )
    }) %>% arrange(desc(Mean_abs_SHAP))
    shap_value_list[[paste(set_name, md)]] <- list(shap = shap_mat, x = x)
    cat(sprintf("[shap] %-18s %-17s p=%3d  CV-AUC=%.3f  OOB recall=%.2f\n",
                set_name, md, ncol(x), shap_perf_list[[paste(set_name, md)]]$CV_AUC_LumB_vs_rest,
                shap_perf_list[[paste(set_name, md)]]$OOB_LumB_recall))
  }
}

save_figure2_fun <- function(plot_a, plot_b, filename, caption, width_a = 7, height_a = 4, width_b = 7, height_b = 4.5) {
  doc <- read_docx()
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, caption, style = "heading 2")
  doc <- body_add_gg(doc, value = plot_a, width = width_a, height = height_a)
  doc <- body_add_gg(doc, value = plot_b, width = width_b, height = height_b)
  print(doc, target = file.path("figure", filename))
}
subtype_colour <- c(Basal = "#F8766D", Her2 = "#7CAE00", LumA = "#00BFC4", LumB = "#C77CFF")

shap_intersection_figure_fun <- function(budget, filename, figure_label) {
  key <- paste0("intersection_", budget)
  if (is.null(shap_gene_sets[[key]])) return(invisible(NULL))
  genes <- shap_gene_sets[[key]]$genes
  n_fold <- marker_fold_intersection %>% filter(Budget == budget) %>% dplyr::select(Gene, N_folds_selected)
  bars <- shap_contributions %>%
    filter(Set == "intersection", Budget == budget, Modality %in% c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch")) %>%
    left_join(n_fold, by = "Gene") %>%
    mutate(Label = sprintf("%s (%d/5)", Gene, N_folds_selected))
  order_gene <- bars %>% filter(Modality == "Mismatch") %>% arrange(Mean_abs_SHAP) %>% pull(Label)
  bars <- bars %>% mutate(Label = factor(Label, levels = order_gene),
                          Modality = factor(Modality, levels = c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch")))
  perf <- shap_performance %>% filter(Set == "intersection", Budget == budget)
  auc_text <- paste(sprintf("%s %.2f", perf$Modality, perf$CV_AUC_LumB_vs_rest), collapse = " / ")
  plot_a <- ggplot(bars, aes(Mean_abs_SHAP, Label, fill = Modality)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(RNA = "#00BFC4", Protein = "#F8766D", Mismatch = "#7CAE00"), name = "Input") +
    theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7), plot.title = element_text(size = 9),
                       plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8)) +
    labs(x = "out-of-fold mean |SHAP| for Luminal B", y = NULL,
         title = sprintf("Fold-intersection markers (>= %d/5 folds), budget %d (n = %d genes)",
                         min_fold_intersection, budget, length(genes)),
         subtitle = paste("5-fold out-of-fold LumB-vs-rest AUC:", auc_text))
  sv <- shap_value_list[[paste(key, "Mismatch")]]
  top_gene <- shap_contributions %>% filter(Set == "intersection", Budget == budget, Modality == "Mismatch") %>%
    arrange(desc(Mean_abs_SHAP)) %>% slice_head(n = 6) %>% pull(Gene)
  dep <- purrr::map_dfr(top_gene, function(g) tibble(
    Gene = g, Value = sv$x[[g]], SHAP = sv$shap[, g], Subtype = specific_subtype,
    r = suppressWarnings(cor(sv$x[[g]], sv$shap[, g]))
  )) %>% mutate(Panel = factor(sprintf("%s (r = %+.2f)", Gene, r),
                               levels = unique(sprintf("%s (r = %+.2f)", Gene, r))))
  plot_b <- ggplot(dep, aes(Value, SHAP, colour = Subtype)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = subtype_colour, labels = subtype_label) +
    facet_wrap(~Panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    theme_bw() + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7), axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
                       legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(x = "mismatch value", y = "SHAP (Luminal B), out-of-fold")
  save_figure2_fun(
    plot_a, plot_b, filename,
    sprintf(paste(
      "%s. Shapley (SHAP) contribution of the fold-intersection mismatch markers (retained in",
      ">= %d/5 outer folds, budget %d) to the Luminal B class in a four-class random forest",
      "(ntree = %d, mtry = sqrt(p)), for RNA, protein and mismatch inputs of the same genes.",
      "Top: out-of-fold mean |SHAP| computed over the five outer folds of the main analysis",
      "(permutation-sampling Monte Carlo estimate, nsim = %d); subtitle: 5-fold out-of-fold Luminal B-vs-rest",
      "AUC by input modality. Bottom: out-of-fold SHAP dependence on the mismatch value for the",
      "six markers with the largest mean |SHAP| in the mismatch model (r = Pearson correlation",
      "between value and SHAP)."), figure_label, min_fold_intersection, budget, shap_ntree, shap_nsim),
    width_a = 7, height_a = max(3, 0.25 * length(genes) + 1.5), width_b = 7, height_b = 4.5
  )
}
```

```{r}
# 따라가는 것으로 판단해 논문에서 제외했고, 아형별 AUC는 섹션 20의 Table S14에 CI와 함께 보고한다.

mod_mat <- list(RNA = specific_rn, Protein = specific_pr, Mismatch = specific_mm)
ms_build_x_fun <- function(genes, md) as.data.frame(mod_mat[[md]][, genes, drop = FALSE], check.names = FALSE)

# 섹션 18 mc_shap_fun 과 같은 난수 사용 순서 ; 차이 : 네 클래스 확률의 SHAP을 한꺼번에 누적
mc_shap_multi_fun <- function(model, x_train, x_new, nsim, seed) {
  p <- ncol(x_new); n_new <- nrow(x_new); n_tr <- nrow(x_train)
  set.seed(seed)
  perm <- t(replicate(nsim, sample.int(p)))
  if (p == 1L) perm <- matrix(perm, nsim, 1L)
  big <- x_train[sample.int(n_tr, nsim * n_new, replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(big) <- NULL
  sim_rows <- split(seq_len(nsim * n_new), rep(seq_len(nsim), each = n_new))
  shap <- array(0, c(n_new, p, length(subtype_levels)),
                dimnames = list(rownames(x_new), colnames(x_new), subtype_levels))
  pred_prev <- predict(model, newdata = big, type = "prob")[, subtype_levels]
  for (k in seq_len(p)) {
    for (s in seq_len(nsim)) { j <- perm[s, k]; big[sim_rows[[s]], j] <- x_new[, j] }
    pred_now <- predict(model, newdata = big, type = "prob")[, subtype_levels]
    delta <- pred_now - pred_prev
    for (s in seq_len(nsim)) {
      j <- perm[s, k]
      shap[, j, ] <- shap[, j, ] + delta[sim_rows[[s]], , drop = FALSE]
    }
    pred_prev <- pred_now
  }
  shap / nsim
}

ms_run_fun <- function(set_name, md) {
  gs <- ms_gene_sets[[set_name]]; x <- ms_build_x_fun(gs$genes, md)
  mtry <- max(1, floor(sqrt(ncol(x))))
  shap <- array(0, c(nrow(x), ncol(x), 4), dimnames = list(id_order, colnames(x), subtype_levels))
  prob <- matrix(0, nrow(x), 4, dimnames = list(id_order, subtype_levels))
  for (k in seq_along(outer_folds)) {
    tr <- fold_of_sample != k; va <- !tr
    set.seed(shap_seed + k)
    rf_k <- randomForest(x = x[tr, , drop = FALSE], y = y_full[tr], ntree = shap_ntree, mtry = mtry)
    prob[va, ] <- predict(rf_k, newdata = x[va, , drop = FALSE], type = "prob")[, subtype_levels]
    shap[va, , ] <- mc_shap_multi_fun(rf_k, x[tr, , drop = FALSE], x[va, , drop = FALSE], shap_nsim, shap_seed + 100 + k)
  }
  pred <- factor(subtype_levels[max.col(prob, ties.method = "first")], levels = subtype_levels)
  perf <- purrr::map_dfr(subtype_levels, function(cl) tibble(
    Class = cl, AUC_OvR = auc_fun(prob[, cl], y_full == cl), Recall = mean(pred[y_full == cl] == cl)
  )) %>% mutate(Set = set_name, Source = gs$source, Size = gs$size, N_genes = length(gs$genes), Modality = md,
                MBA = metric_vector_fun(y_full, pred)[["Macro_Balanced_Accuracy"]])
  contrib <- purrr::map_dfr(colnames(x), function(f) tibble(
    Class = "LumB", Gene = f, Mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(shap[, f, "LumB"])),
    Spearman_value_SHAP = suppressWarnings(cor(x[[f]], shap[, f, "LumB"], method = "spearman")),
    Class_shift = mean(x[[f]][y_full == "LumB"]) - mean(x[[f]][y_full != "LumB"])
  )) %>% mutate(Set = set_name, Source = gs$source, Size = gs$size, Modality = md)
  cat(sprintf("[marker source] %-14s %-8s p=%2d  LumB AUC=%.3f  MBA=%.3f\n", set_name, md, ncol(x),
              perf$AUC_OvR[perf$Class == "LumB"], perf$MBA[1]))
  list(perf = perf, contrib = contrib)
}
ms_jobs <- expand.grid(set = names(ms_gene_sets), md = c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ms_res <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ms_jobs)), function(i) ms_run_fun(ms_jobs$set[i], ms_jobs$md[i]))

  arrange(match(Set, ms_set_order)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Marker_set, N_genes, Input_RNA, Input_Protein, Input_Mismatch,
                MBA_RNA, MBA_Protein, MBA_Mismatch, Top5_LumB_SHAP_own_input)
table_s16_marker_source
save_table_fun(

    "Luminal B-vs-rest AUC (Luminal B recall in parentheses); MBA_: out-of-fold macro balanced accuracy.",
    "Top5_LumB_SHAP_own_input: genes with the largest out-of-fold mean |SHAP| for Luminal B when the set is",
```

## 20. mismatch 마커의 증분 가치와 아형별 one-vs-rest AUC (bootstrap CI) — Table S13 · S14 (Figure R6·R7 제거)
```{r}
# 2026-10-09 ~ 10-16 code/05·06·08 통합. 세 스크립트는 같은 RF(같은 seed)를 세 번 적합했으므로 여기서는 한 번만 적합한다.
# 가설 : RNA(또는 protein) 블록 마커 모델에 mismatch 마커 16개의 *mismatch 값*을 추가하면 LumB 판별이 오르고,
#        같은 16개 유전자의 *RNA 값* 또는 *protein 값*을 추가하면(대조군) 오르지 않아야 한다.
# 모델 11개 (모두 4-class RF, ntree 500, mtry = sqrt(p), fold k의 seed = 2026 + k)
#   MM16 x {RNA, Protein, Mismatch}        : 16개 마커를 세 modality 로 입력 (Table S14-A, 아형별 OvR AUC + 입력 간 CI)
#   RNA 베이스라인 (+ MM16 mismatch / RNA / protein 값), Protein 베이스라인 (+ 같은 3종) : Table S13 (증분), S18-B/C
# 지표 : 아형별 one-vs-rest AUC, macro AUC, LumB-vs-LumA AUC (LumA 54 + LumB 15 표본만; score = P(LumB)/[P(LumA)+P(LumB)]),
#        MBA. 차이의 95% CI 는 out-of-fold 예측의 표본 단위 paired bootstrap (B = 2,000, seed 20261009).
# Shapley 는 추가 블록의 기여를 보려는 목적이므로 추가 모델 6개에서만 계산한다 (LumB 확률).
iv_feat_block_fun <- function(genes, md, tag = "base") {
  x <- as.data.frame(mod_mat[[md]][, genes, drop = FALSE], check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(x) <- paste0(genes, "|", md, "|", tag)
  x
}
iv_models <- list(
  MM16_RNA      = list(group = "input", x = iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "RNA", "mm")),
  MM16_Protein  = list(group = "input", x = iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "Protein", "mm")),
  MM16_Mismatch = list(group = "input", x = iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "Mismatch", "mm")),
  RNAb          = list(group = "RNA", x = iv_feat_block_fun(g_rna_block, "RNA")),
  RNAb_MM16     = list(group = "RNA", x = cbind(iv_feat_block_fun(g_rna_block, "RNA"), iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "Mismatch", "added"))),
  RNAb_RNA16    = list(group = "RNA", x = cbind(iv_feat_block_fun(g_rna_block, "RNA"), iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "RNA", "added"))),
  RNAb_PR16     = list(group = "RNA", x = cbind(iv_feat_block_fun(g_rna_block, "RNA"), iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "Protein", "added"))),
  PRb           = list(group = "Protein", x = iv_feat_block_fun(g_pr_block, "Protein")),
  PRb_MM16      = list(group = "Protein", x = cbind(iv_feat_block_fun(g_pr_block, "Protein"), iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "Mismatch", "added"))),
  PRb_RNA16     = list(group = "Protein", x = cbind(iv_feat_block_fun(g_pr_block, "Protein"), iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "RNA", "added"))),
  PRb_PR16      = list(group = "Protein", x = cbind(iv_feat_block_fun(g_pr_block, "Protein"), iv_feat_block_fun(g_mm_block, "Protein", "added")))
)
for (m in names(iv_models)) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(colnames(iv_models[[m]]$x)))
iv_model_label <- c(
  MM16_RNA = sprintf("Mismatch markers (%d), RNA values", n_match),
  MM16_Protein = sprintf("Mismatch markers (%d), protein values", n_match),
  MM16_Mismatch = sprintf("Mismatch markers (%d), mismatch values", n_match),
  RNAb = sprintf("RNA-block markers (%d), RNA values", length(g_rna_block)),
  RNAb_MM16 = "RNA-block + mismatch markers (mismatch values)",
  RNAb_RNA16 = "RNA-block + mismatch markers (RNA values)",
  RNAb_PR16 = "RNA-block + mismatch markers (protein values)",
  PRb = sprintf("Protein-block markers (%d), protein values", length(g_pr_block)),
  PRb_MM16 = "Protein-block + mismatch markers (mismatch values)",
  PRb_RNA16 = "Protein-block + mismatch markers (RNA values)",
  PRb_PR16 = "Protein-block + mismatch markers (protein values)")
iv_ref_of <- c(MM16_RNA = NA, MM16_Protein = "MM16_RNA", MM16_Mismatch = "MM16_Protein",
               RNAb = NA, RNAb_MM16 = "RNAb", RNAb_RNA16 = "RNAb", RNAb_PR16 = "RNAb",
               PRb = NA, PRb_MM16 = "PRb", PRb_RNA16 = "PRb", PRb_PR16 = "PRb")
iv_added <- c(MM16_RNA = "none", MM16_Protein = "none", MM16_Mismatch = "none", RNAb = "none", RNAb_MM16 = "MM16",
              RNAb_RNA16 = "RNA16", RNAb_PR16 = "PR16", PRb = "none", PRb_MM16 = "MM16", PRb_RNA16 = "RNA16", PRb_PR16 = "PR16")
iv_add_label <- c(none = "baseline", MM16 = "+ mismatch markers (mismatch values)",
                  RNA16 = "+ mismatch markers (RNA values)", PR16 = "+ mismatch markers (protein values)")

iv_run_fun <- function(nm) {
  x <- iv_models[[nm]]$x
  mtry <- max(1, floor(sqrt(ncol(x))))
  prob <- matrix(0, nrow(x), 4, dimnames = list(id_order, subtype_levels))
  do_shap <- iv_added[[nm]] != "none"
  shap <- if (do_shap) array(0, c(nrow(x), ncol(x), 4), dimnames = list(id_order, colnames(x), subtype_levels)) else NULL
  for (k in seq_along(outer_folds)) {
    tr <- fold_of_sample != k; va <- !tr
    set.seed(shap_seed + k)
    rf_k <- randomForest(x = x[tr, , drop = FALSE], y = y_full[tr], ntree = shap_ntree, mtry = mtry)
    prob[va, ] <- predict(rf_k, newdata = x[va, , drop = FALSE], type = "prob")[, subtype_levels]
    if (do_shap) shap[va, , ] <- mc_shap_multi_fun(rf_k, x[tr, , drop = FALSE], x[va, , drop = FALSE], shap_nsim, shap_seed + 100 + k)
  }
  pred <- factor(subtype_levels[max.col(prob, ties.method = "first")], levels = subtype_levels)
  contrib <- NULL
  if (do_shap) {
    contrib <- purrr::map_dfr(colnames(x), function(f) tibble(Feature = f, Mean_abs_SHAP = mean(abs(shap[, f, "LumB"])))) %>%
      separate(Feature, into = c("Gene", "Modality", "Tag"), sep = "\\|", remove = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(Block = if_else(Tag == "added", "added", "baseline"), Model_key = nm)
  }
  cat(sprintf("[incremental] %-14s p=%3d  LumB AUC=%.3f  MBA=%.3f\n", nm, ncol(x),
              auc_fun(prob[, "LumB"], y_full == "LumB"), metric_vector_fun(y_full, pred)[["Macro_Balanced_Accuracy"]]))
  list(prob = prob, pred = pred, contrib = contrib)
}
iv_res <- lapply(names(iv_models), iv_run_fun); names(iv_res) <- names(iv_models)
iv_contrib <- bind_rows(lapply(iv_res, `[[`, "contrib"))
write.csv(iv_contrib, file.path("table", "incremental_value_shap_contrib.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 20-1. 지표 함수와 bootstrap
is_lum <- y_full %in% c("LumA", "LumB")
auc_ovr_fun <- function(prob, cl, ix = seq_along(y_full)) auc_fun(prob[ix, cl], y_full[ix] == cl)
auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun <- function(prob, ix = seq_along(y_full)) {
  ix <- ix[is_lum[ix]]
  s <- prob[ix, "LumB"] / (prob[ix, "LumA"] + prob[ix, "LumB"] + 1e-12)
  auc_fun(s, y_full[ix] == "LumB")
}
iv_boot_B <- 2000L
set.seed(20261009)
iv_boot_idx <- replicate(iv_boot_B, sample.int(length(id_order), replace = TRUE), simplify = FALSE)
iv_ci_fun <- function(f) {           # f(ix) -> 통계량 ; 관측값 + percentile CI
  obs <- f(seq_along(y_full))
  b <- vapply(iv_boot_idx, function(ix) tryCatch(f(ix), error = function(e) NA_real_), numeric(1))
  c(est = obs, lo = unname(quantile(b, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)), hi = unname(quantile(b, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)))
}
iv_valid_ix <- function(ix, cl) sum(y_full[ix] == cl) > 0 && sum(y_full[ix] != cl) > 0
iv_valid_lum <- function(ix) { ix <- ix[is_lum[ix]]; sum(y_full[ix] == "LumB") > 0 && sum(y_full[ix] == "LumA") > 0 }
fmt_ci_fun <- function(v) sprintf("%+.3f [%+.3f, %+.3f]", v["est"], v["lo"], v["hi"])
iv_prob <- lapply(iv_res, `[[`, "prob"); iv_pred <- lapply(iv_res, `[[`, "pred")

# 20-2. Table S13 : 증분 가치 (LumB AUC, Macro_F1, 차이 CI, 추가 feature의 SHAP 점유율)
iv_perf <- purrr::map_dfr(names(iv_models), function(nm) tibble(
  Model_key = nm, Group = iv_models[[nm]]$group, Added = iv_added[[nm]], N_features = ncol(iv_models[[nm]]$x),
  AUC_LumB = auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[nm]], "LumB"), Recall_LumB = mean(iv_pred[[nm]][y_full == "LumB"] == "LumB"),
  Macro_F1 = metric_vector_fun(y_full, iv_pred[[nm]])[[primary_metric]]
))
write.csv(iv_perf, file.path("table", "incremental_value_perf.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
iv_delta <- purrr::map_dfr(names(iv_models)[iv_added != "none"], function(nm) {
  ref <- iv_ref_of[[nm]]
  d_auc <- iv_ci_fun(function(ix) { if (!iv_valid_ix(ix, "LumB")) stop(); auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[nm]], "LumB", ix) - auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[ref]], "LumB", ix) })
  d_f1 <- iv_ci_fun(function(ix) metric_vector_fun(y_full[ix], iv_pred[[nm]][ix])[[primary_metric]] -
                       metric_vector_fun(y_full[ix], iv_pred[[ref]][ix])[[primary_metric]])
  tibble(Model_key = nm, dAUC_LumB = d_auc[["est"]], dAUC_lo = d_auc[["lo"]], dAUC_hi = d_auc[["hi"]],
         dF1 = d_f1[["est"]], dF1_lo = d_f1[["lo"]], dF1_hi = d_f1[["hi"]],
         dAUC_LumB_CI = fmt_ci_fun(d_auc), dF1_CI = fmt_ci_fun(d_f1))
})
write.csv(iv_delta, file.path("table", "incremental_value_bootstrap.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
iv_shap_share <- iv_contrib %>%
  group_by(Model_key) %>%
  summarise(Added_SHAP_share = sum(Mean_abs_SHAP[Block == "added"]) / sum(Mean_abs_SHAP),
            Top3_added = paste(head(Gene[Block == "added"][order(-Mean_abs_SHAP[Block == "added"])], 3), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop")
table_s17_incremental <- iv_perf %>%
  filter(Group != "input") %>%
  left_join(iv_delta %>% dplyr::select(Model_key, dAUC_LumB_CI, dF1_CI), by = "Model_key") %>%
  left_join(iv_shap_share, by = "Model_key") %>%
  mutate(Baseline = if_else(Group == "RNA", "RNA-block markers (RNA input)", "Protein-block markers (protein input)"),
         Model = unname(iv_add_label[Added]),
         LumB_AUC = sprintf("%.3f (%.2f)", AUC_LumB, Recall_LumB),
         dAUC_LumB_CI = replace_na(dAUC_LumB_CI, "—"), dF1_CI = replace_na(dF1_CI, "—"),
         Top3_added = replace_na(Top3_added, "—")) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, c("RNA", "Protein")), match(Added, names(iv_add_label))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Baseline, Model, N_features, LumB_AUC, Macro_F1, dAUC_LumB_CI, dF1_CI, Added_SHAP_share, Top3_added)
table_s17_incremental
save_table_fun(
  table_s17_incremental, "TableS13_Incremental_Value_Mismatch_Markers.docx",
  paste(
    sprintf("Table S13. Incremental value of the %d fold-intersection mismatch markers for Luminal B discrimination.", n_match),
    sprintf("Each baseline four-class random forest (ntree = %d, mtry = sqrt(p)) used the fold-intersection markers", shap_ntree),
    "(retained in at least 3 of 5 outer folds, budget 150) of the RNA block entered as RNA values, or of the protein",
    "block entered as protein values. The mismatch-block markers were then appended as mismatch values",
    "(hypothesis), or as RNA or protein values of the same genes (controls). LumB_AUC: 5-fold out-of-fold Luminal",
    "B-vs-rest AUC (Luminal B recall in parentheses); Macro_F1: out-of-fold macro F1 (primary metric). dAUC_LumB and dF1:",
    sprintf("change from the baseline with 95%% paired bootstrap CI over samples (B = %d) of the out-of-fold predictions.", iv_boot_B),
    "Added_SHAP_share: share of the summed out-of-fold mean |SHAP| for the Luminal B probability carried by the",
    "appended features; Top3_added: appended features with the largest mean |SHAP|. Gene sets were fixed from all",
    "folds' selections, so values are comparative, not nested cross-validation estimates."
  ),
  landscape = TRUE, fontsize_pt = 7
)

# 20-3. Table S14 : (A) 16개 마커의 아형별 OvR AUC와 입력 간 차이 CI ; (B) 모델 11개의 아형별 OvR AUC·macro·LumB-vs-LumA ;
#                   (C) 참조 모델 대비 아형별·macro·LumB-vs-LumA 차이 CI
iv_inputs <- c(RNA = "MM16_RNA", Protein = "MM16_Protein", Mismatch = "MM16_Mismatch")
table_s18a <- purrr::map_dfr(subtype_levels, function(cl) {
  a <- sapply(iv_inputs, function(m) auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[m]], cl))
  g <- function(m1, m2) iv_ci_fun(function(ix) { if (!iv_valid_ix(ix, cl)) stop(); auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[m1]], cl, ix) - auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[m2]], cl, ix) })
  d_mp <- g("MM16_Mismatch", "MM16_Protein"); d_mr <- g("MM16_Mismatch", "MM16_RNA"); d_pr <- g("MM16_Protein", "MM16_RNA")
  tibble(Subtype = unname(subtype_label[cl]), N = sum(y_full == cl),
         AUC_RNA = a[["RNA"]], AUC_Protein = a[["Protein"]], AUC_Mismatch = a[["Mismatch"]],
         `Mismatch - Protein` = fmt_ci_fun(d_mp), `Mismatch - RNA` = fmt_ci_fun(d_mr), `Protein - RNA` = fmt_ci_fun(d_pr),
         d_mp_est = d_mp[["est"]], d_mp_lo = d_mp[["lo"]], d_mp_hi = d_mp[["hi"]],
         d_mr_est = d_mr[["est"]], d_mr_lo = d_mr[["lo"]], d_mr_hi = d_mr[["hi"]])
})
table_s18b <- purrr::map_dfr(names(iv_models), function(nm) {
  a <- sapply(subtype_levels, function(cl) auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[nm]], cl))
  tibble(Model_key = nm, Model = iv_model_label[[nm]], N_features = ncol(iv_models[[nm]]$x),
         AUC_Basal = a[["Basal"]], AUC_HER2 = a[["Her2"]], AUC_LumA = a[["LumA"]], AUC_LumB = a[["LumB"]],
         Macro_AUC = mean(a), AUC_LumB_vs_LumA = auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun(iv_prob[[nm]]))
})
table_s18c <- purrr::map_dfr(names(iv_models)[!is.na(iv_ref_of)], function(nm) {
  ref <- iv_ref_of[[nm]]
  d <- lapply(subtype_levels, function(cl) iv_ci_fun(function(ix) {
    if (!iv_valid_ix(ix, cl)) stop(); auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[nm]], cl, ix) - auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[ref]], cl, ix) }))
  names(d) <- subtype_levels
  d_macro <- iv_ci_fun(function(ix) {
    if (!all(sapply(subtype_levels, iv_valid_ix, ix = ix))) stop()
    mean(sapply(subtype_levels, function(cl) auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[nm]], cl, ix))) -
      mean(sapply(subtype_levels, function(cl) auc_ovr_fun(iv_prob[[ref]], cl, ix))) })
  d_la <- iv_ci_fun(function(ix) { if (!iv_valid_lum(ix)) stop(); auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun(iv_prob[[nm]], ix) - auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun(iv_prob[[ref]], ix) })
  tibble(Model_key = nm, Model = iv_model_label[[nm]], Reference = iv_model_label[[ref]],
         dAUC_Basal = fmt_ci_fun(d$Basal), dAUC_HER2 = fmt_ci_fun(d$Her2), dAUC_LumA = fmt_ci_fun(d$LumA),
         dAUC_LumB = fmt_ci_fun(d$LumB), dMacro_AUC = fmt_ci_fun(d_macro), dAUC_LumB_vs_LumA = fmt_ci_fun(d_la),
         d_la_est = d_la[["est"]], d_la_lo = d_la[["lo"]], d_la_hi = d_la[["hi"]])
})
write.csv(table_s18a, file.path("table", "s18a_subtype_input_bootstrap.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table_s18b, file.path("table", "s18b_all_models_ovr_auc.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table_s18c, file.path("table", "s18c_all_models_delta_ci.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
table_s18a %>% dplyr::select(Subtype:`Protein - RNA`)
table_s18b %>% dplyr::select(-Model_key)
table_s18c %>% dplyr::select(Model, Reference, dAUC_LumB, dMacro_AUC, dAUC_LumB_vs_LumA)

iv_ft_fun <- function(df, left_cols = 1, size = 6.5) {
  flextable(df) %>% colformat_double(digits = 3) %>% theme_booktabs() %>% bold(part = "header") %>%
    align(align = "center", part = "all") %>% align(j = seq_len(left_cols), align = "left", part = "body") %>%
    fontsize(size = size, part = "all") %>% autofit() %>% fit_to_width(max_width = 9)
}
```

## 21. 중첩·반복 교차검증으로 본 Luminal B 비교 — Table S15 · S16 · Supplementary Data 5, Figure S3
```{r}
# 2026-10-13 code/07_nested_repeated_lumB.R 통합. 섹션 19·20(Table S12~S14)의 한계 네 가지 중 세 가지를 해소한다.
#   (1) 선택 누출 : 마커를 outer 학습 fold 안의 inner 5-fold DIABLO 안정성 선택(>= 60% inner fold)으로 fold별로 정한다
#   (3) 잔차 누출 : mismatch 값을 전체 표본이 아니라 학습 fold의 회귀(beta)로 계산해 검증 fold에 적용한다
#   (4) 대조군 비대칭 : RNA/Protein 베이스라인에서 그 fold의 mismatch 마커와 겹치는 유전자를 제거 → 세 추가 블록이 모두 "새 열"
#   (2) 분할 불확실성 : outer 5-fold 분할 seed 10개(123 + 9개)로 반복, seed 간 평균·범위와 주 분할(123)의 bootstrap CI를 함께 보고
# 모델 11개는 섹션 20과 같은 구성(4-class RF, ntree 500, mtry = sqrt(p)); Shapley는 계산하지 않는다. 약 40~60분.
nr_seeds <- c(123L, 2001L:2009L)
nr_k_outer <- 5L; nr_k_inner <- 5L
nr_budget <- 150L
nr_blocks <- c("RNA", "Protein", "Mismatch")
nr_model_names <- c("MM_RNA", "MM_Protein", "MM_Mismatch", "RNAb", "RNAb_MM", "RNAb_RNA", "RNAb_PR",
                    "PRb", "PRb_MM", "PRb_RNA", "PRb_PR")
nr_model_label <- c(
  MM_RNA = "Mismatch markers, RNA values", MM_Protein = "Mismatch markers, protein values",
  MM_Mismatch = "Mismatch markers, mismatch values",
  RNAb = "RNA-block markers (RNA values)", RNAb_MM = "RNA-block + mismatch markers (mismatch values)",
  RNAb_RNA = "RNA-block + mismatch markers (RNA values)", RNAb_PR = "RNA-block + mismatch markers (protein values)",
  PRb = "Protein-block markers excl. overlap (protein values)", PRb_MM = "Protein-block + mismatch markers (mismatch values)",
  PRb_RNA = "Protein-block + mismatch markers (RNA values)", PRb_PR = "Protein-block + mismatch markers (protein values)")
nr_ref_of <- c(MM_RNA = NA, MM_Protein = "MM_RNA", MM_Mismatch = "MM_Protein",
               RNAb = NA, RNAb_MM = "RNAb", RNAb_RNA = "RNAb", RNAb_PR = "RNAb",
               PRb = NA, PRb_MM = "PRb", PRb_RNA = "PRb", PRb_PR = "PRb")

# 섹션 9B의 데이터 주도 선택(cor 기준)을 블록·점수 표로 돌려주는 래퍼
nr_pooled_select_fun <- function(train_id, valid_id) {
  sparse_pooled_core_fun(train_id, valid_id, nr_blocks, score_types = "cor",
                         total_keepx = nr_budget, pool_keepx = nr_budget)[["cor"]]$selected
}
# 중첩 안정성 선택 : outer 학습 표본 안에서 inner k-fold DIABLO, >= 60%의 inner fold에서 선택된 유전자
nr_inner_stable_fun <- function(train_id, seed) {
  sel <- list()
  for (attempt in 0:2) {                       # inner fold가 3개 미만 성공하면 seed를 바꿔 재시도
    inner <- create_tmt_safe_folds(sample_id = train_id, k = nr_k_inner, seed = seed + attempt)
    sel <- list()
    for (j in seq_along(inner)) {
      v <- inner[[j]]
      res <- tryCatch(nr_pooled_select_fun(train_id[-v], train_id[v]), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(res)) next
      sel[[length(sel) + 1L]] <- res %>% mutate(Inner = j)
    }
    if (length(sel) >= 3L) break
  }
  n_ok <- length(sel)
  stopifnot(n_ok >= 3L)
  thr <- ceiling(0.6 * n_ok)
  tab <- bind_rows(sel) %>% group_by(Block, Feature) %>%
    summarise(N_inner = dplyr::n(), Mean_score = mean(Score), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(Block, desc(N_inner), desc(Mean_score))
  stable <- tab %>% filter(N_inner >= thr)
  sets <- lapply(nr_blocks, function(b) stable$Feature[stable$Block == b]); names(sets) <- nr_blocks
  list(sets = sets, n_ok = n_ok, thr = thr, table = tab)
}

nr_seed_results <- list(); nr_fold_log <- list(); nr_gene_log <- list()
nr_t_start <- Sys.time()
for (r in nr_seeds) {
  outer <- create_tmt_safe_folds(sample_id = id_order, k = nr_k_outer, min_training_per_batch = 2, seed = r)
  probs <- lapply(nr_model_names, function(m) matrix(NA_real_, length(id_order), 4, dimnames = list(id_order, subtype_levels)))
  names(probs) <- nr_model_names
  for (k in seq_along(outer)) {
    v <- outer[[k]]; train_id <- id_order[-v]; valid_id <- id_order[v]
    st <- nr_inner_stable_fun(train_id, seed = r * 100L + k)
    dat <- all_modality_split_fun(train_id, valid_id)        # fold별 잔차 : 학습 fold의 beta만 사용
    avail <- dat$selected_gene
    sets <- lapply(st$sets, intersect, avail)
    mm <- sets$Mismatch
    fallback <- FALSE
    if (length(mm) < 2L) {                                   # 안정 집합이 너무 작으면 inner 선택 횟수 상위 5개로 대체
      fallback <- TRUE
      mm <- st$table %>% filter(Block == "Mismatch", Feature %in% avail) %>% head(5) %>% pull(Feature)
    }
    rna_b <- setdiff(sets$RNA, mm); pr_b <- setdiff(sets$Protein, mm)   # 베이스라인에서 mismatch 마커와 겹치는 유전자 제거
    stopifnot(length(rna_b) >= 2L, length(pr_b) >= 2L)
    key <- c(RNA = "RNA-only", Protein = "Protein-only", Mismatch = "Mismatch-only")
    feat <- function(genes, md, tag) {
      tr <- dat$modalities[[key[[md]]]]$x_train[, genes, drop = FALSE]
      va <- dat$modalities[[key[[md]]]]$x_valid[, genes, drop = FALSE]
      colnames(tr) <- colnames(va) <- paste0(genes, "|", md, "|", tag)
      list(tr = as.data.frame(tr, check.names = FALSE), va = as.data.frame(va, check.names = FALSE))
    }
    cb <- function(a, b) list(tr = cbind(a$tr, b$tr), va = cbind(a$va, b$va))
    RNAb <- feat(rna_b, "RNA", "base"); PRb <- feat(pr_b, "Protein", "base")
    xs <- list(
      MM_RNA = feat(mm, "RNA", "mm"), MM_Protein = feat(mm, "Protein", "mm"), MM_Mismatch = feat(mm, "Mismatch", "mm"),
      RNAb = RNAb, RNAb_MM = cb(RNAb, feat(mm, "Mismatch", "add")), RNAb_RNA = cb(RNAb, feat(mm, "RNA", "add")),
      RNAb_PR = cb(RNAb, feat(mm, "Protein", "add")),
      PRb = PRb, PRb_MM = cb(PRb, feat(mm, "Mismatch", "add")), PRb_RNA = cb(PRb, feat(mm, "RNA", "add")),
      PRb_PR = cb(PRb, feat(mm, "Protein", "add")))
    y_tr <- factor(subtype_by_id[train_id], levels = subtype_levels)
    for (m in nr_model_names) {
      x <- xs[[m]]; stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(colnames(x$tr)))
      set.seed(2026L + r * 10L + k)
      rf <- randomForest(x = x$tr, y = y_tr, ntree = shap_ntree, mtry = max(1, floor(sqrt(ncol(x$tr)))))
      probs[[m]][valid_id, ] <- predict(rf, newdata = x$va, type = "prob")[, subtype_levels]
    }
    nr_fold_log[[length(nr_fold_log) + 1L]] <- tibble(Seed = r, Fold = k, N_inner_ok = st$n_ok, Threshold = st$thr,
      N_RNA_stable = length(sets$RNA), N_Protein_stable = length(sets$Protein), N_Mismatch_stable = length(sets$Mismatch),
      N_mm_used = length(mm), Fallback = fallback, N_RNA_base = length(rna_b), N_Protein_base = length(pr_b),
      Overlap_RNA = length(intersect(sets$RNA, mm)), Overlap_Protein = length(intersect(sets$Protein, mm)))
    nr_gene_log[[length(nr_gene_log) + 1L]] <- bind_rows(
      tibble(Seed = r, Fold = k, Block = "Mismatch", Gene = mm),
      tibble(Seed = r, Fold = k, Block = "RNA", Gene = sets$RNA),
      tibble(Seed = r, Fold = k, Block = "Protein", Gene = sets$Protein))
    cat(sprintf("[nested seed %4d fold %d] inner ok=%d thr=%d | mm=%2d%s rna_base=%2d pr_base=%2d | %s\n",
                r, k, st$n_ok, st$thr, length(mm), if (fallback) "*" else " ", length(rna_b), length(pr_b),
                format(round(difftime(Sys.time(), nr_t_start, units = "mins"), 1))))
  }
  stopifnot(all(sapply(probs, function(p) all(is.finite(p)))))
  nr_seed_results[[as.character(r)]] <- probs
}
nr_fold_log <- bind_rows(nr_fold_log); nr_gene_log <- bind_rows(nr_gene_log)
write.csv(nr_fold_log, file.path("table", "nested_fold_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(nr_gene_log, file.path("table", "nested_gene_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 21-1. seed별 지표
nr_per_seed_subtype <- purrr::map_dfr(names(nr_seed_results), function(s) {
  p <- nr_seed_results[[s]]
  purrr::map_dfr(subtype_levels, function(cl) tibble(
    Seed = as.integer(s), Class = cl,
    AUC_RNA = auc_ovr_fun(p$MM_RNA, cl), AUC_Protein = auc_ovr_fun(p$MM_Protein, cl), AUC_Mismatch = auc_ovr_fun(p$MM_Mismatch, cl)
  ) %>% mutate(d_MP = AUC_Mismatch - AUC_Protein, d_MR = AUC_Mismatch - AUC_RNA, d_PR = AUC_Protein - AUC_RNA))
})
nr_per_seed_model <- purrr::map_dfr(names(nr_seed_results), function(s) {
  p <- nr_seed_results[[s]]
  purrr::map_dfr(nr_model_names, function(m) {
    ref <- nr_ref_of[[m]]
    tibble(Seed = as.integer(s), Model_key = m,
           AUC_rest = auc_ovr_fun(p[[m]], "LumB"), AUC_LA = auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun(p[[m]]),
           d_rest = if (is.na(ref)) NA_real_ else auc_ovr_fun(p[[m]], "LumB") - auc_ovr_fun(p[[ref]], "LumB"),
           d_LA = if (is.na(ref)) NA_real_ else auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun(p[[m]]) - auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun(p[[ref]]))
  })
})
write.csv(nr_per_seed_subtype, file.path("table", "nested_per_seed_subtype.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(nr_per_seed_model, file.path("table", "nested_per_seed_model.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 21-2. 주 분할(seed 123)의 paired bootstrap CI
set.seed(20261013)
nr_boot_idx <- replicate(iv_boot_B, sample.int(length(id_order), replace = TRUE), simplify = FALSE)
nr_ci_fun <- function(f) {
  obs <- f(seq_along(y_full))
  b <- vapply(nr_boot_idx, function(ix) tryCatch(f(ix), error = function(e) NA_real_), numeric(1))
  c(est = obs, lo = unname(quantile(b, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)), hi = unname(quantile(b, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)))
}
nr_p0 <- nr_seed_results[["123"]]
nr_boot_subtype <- purrr::map_dfr(subtype_levels, function(cl) {
  g <- function(a, b) nr_ci_fun(function(ix) { if (!iv_valid_ix(ix, cl)) stop(); auc_ovr_fun(nr_p0[[a]], cl, ix) - auc_ovr_fun(nr_p0[[b]], cl, ix) })
  mp <- g("MM_Mismatch", "MM_Protein"); mr <- g("MM_Mismatch", "MM_RNA"); pr <- g("MM_Protein", "MM_RNA")
  tibble(Class = cl, CI_MP = sprintf("[%+.3f, %+.3f]", mp["lo"], mp["hi"]), CI_MR = sprintf("[%+.3f, %+.3f]", mr["lo"], mr["hi"]),
         CI_PR = sprintf("[%+.3f, %+.3f]", pr["lo"], pr["hi"]))
})
nr_boot_model <- purrr::map_dfr(nr_model_names, function(m) {
  ref <- nr_ref_of[[m]]
  if (is.na(ref)) return(tibble(Model_key = m, CI_rest = "—", CI_LA = "—"))
  dr <- nr_ci_fun(function(ix) { if (!iv_valid_ix(ix, "LumB")) stop(); auc_ovr_fun(nr_p0[[m]], "LumB", ix) - auc_ovr_fun(nr_p0[[ref]], "LumB", ix) })
  dl <- nr_ci_fun(function(ix) { if (!iv_valid_lum(ix)) stop(); auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun(nr_p0[[m]], ix) - auc_lumB_vs_lumA_fun(nr_p0[[ref]], ix) })
  tibble(Model_key = m, CI_rest = sprintf("[%+.3f, %+.3f]", dr["lo"], dr["hi"]), CI_LA = sprintf("[%+.3f, %+.3f]", dl["lo"], dl["hi"]))
})

# 21-3. Table S15 : 중첩·반복 버전의 Table S14-A
fmt_ms_fun <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(x), sd(x))
fmt_rng_fun <- function(x) sprintf("%+.3f [%+.3f, %+.3f]", mean(x), min(x), max(x))
nr_n_seed <- length(nr_seeds)
table_s19_nested_subtype <- nr_per_seed_subtype %>% group_by(Class) %>%
  summarise(AUC_RNA = fmt_ms_fun(AUC_RNA), AUC_Protein = fmt_ms_fun(AUC_Protein), AUC_Mismatch = fmt_ms_fun(AUC_Mismatch),
            `Mismatch - Protein` = fmt_rng_fun(d_MP), Seeds_MP_pos = sprintf("%d/%d", sum(d_MP > 0), nr_n_seed),
            `Mismatch - RNA` = fmt_rng_fun(d_MR), Seeds_MR_pos = sprintf("%d/%d", sum(d_MR > 0), nr_n_seed),
            `Protein - RNA` = fmt_rng_fun(d_PR), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(nr_boot_subtype, by = "Class") %>%
  mutate(Subtype = unname(subtype_label[Class]), N = as.integer(table(y_full)[Class])) %>%
  arrange(match(Class, subtype_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Subtype, N, AUC_RNA, AUC_Protein, AUC_Mismatch, `Mismatch - Protein`, Seeds_MP_pos, CI_MP,
                `Mismatch - RNA`, Seeds_MR_pos, CI_MR, `Protein - RNA`, CI_PR)
table_s19_nested_subtype
save_table_fun(
  table_s19_nested_subtype, "TableS15_Nested_Repeated_Mismatch_Marker_Subtype.docx",
  paste(
    "Table S15. Nested, repeated-cross-validation version of Table S14A. For each of", nr_n_seed, "outer 5-fold",
    "splits (seed 123 = main split, plus 9 further seeds), the mismatch-block markers of each outer fold were chosen",
    "by stability selection inside that fold's training set only (five inner folds of the three-block data-driven",
    "DIABLO at budget 150; genes retained in at least 60% of successful inner folds), mismatch values were residuals",
    sprintf("of the training-fold regression, and four-class random forests (ntree = %d, mtry = sqrt(p)) entered the same", shap_ntree),
    "fold-specific genes as RNA, protein or mismatch values. AUC_: out-of-fold one-vs-rest AUC per subtype, mean (SD)",
    "over seeds. Difference columns: mean [min, max] over seeds; Seeds_pos: number of seeds with a positive difference;",
    sprintf("CI_: 95%% paired bootstrap CI over samples (B = %d) for the main split (seed 123). Unlike Table S14, no", iv_boot_B),
    "validation sample influenced the gene set or the mismatch regression used for its own prediction."
  ),
  landscape = TRUE, fontsize_pt = 6.5
)

# 21-4. Table S16 : 중첩·반복 버전의 Table S13 / S18-B
nr_size_summary <- nr_fold_log %>% summarise(mm = mean(N_mm_used), rna = mean(N_RNA_base), pr = mean(N_Protein_base),
                                             fb = sum(Fallback), ov_pr = mean(Overlap_Protein), ov_rna = mean(Overlap_RNA))
nr_size_summary
```

## 21B. LumB 외 아형의 mismatch 특징과 클래스 균형 RF — Table S19 · Figure S6
```{r}
# 2026-10-19 code/09_subtype_mismatch_features.R 통합. 두 질문에 답한다.
#   (1) LumB 외 아형에도 mismatch 고유의 특징이 있는가? → 전체 2,970 유전자에서 아형별 one-vs-rest Welch t / Cohen's d를
#       RNA·Protein·Mismatch 값에 각각 계산하고, "mismatch 특이"(|d_mm| > max(|d_rna|, |d_pr|) & mismatch BH-FDR < 0.05)
#       유전자 수와 상위 10개를 아형별로 본다 (Table S19A·A2, Figure S6).
#   (2) Figure 3에서 LumB가 눈에 띈다는 인상이 수치로 맞는가? → 교집합 16개에서 아형별 |d|, 유의 개수, SD 비, RNA 설명 비율,
#       아형 중앙값이 나머지 IQR 밖인 유전자 수 (Table S19B).
#   (3) 표본 수 영향 : Mismatch/RNA/Protein-only 전체표본 RF를 클래스 균형 표집(sampsize = 최소 클래스 x 4)으로 재적합해
#       OOB recall을 기본 bootstrap과 비교 (Table S19C). 섹션 7·8의 전체표본 행렬(specific_*)과 fitted_full(섹션 17)을 그대로 쓴다.
sf_mats <- list(RNA = specific_rn, Protein = specific_pr, Mismatch = specific_mm)
sf_d_fun <- function(X, g) {                                 # g : logical (해당 아형)
  m1 <- colMeans(X[g, , drop = FALSE]); m0 <- colMeans(X[!g, , drop = FALSE])
  v1 <- apply(X[g, , drop = FALSE], 2, var); v0 <- apply(X[!g, , drop = FALSE], 2, var)
  n1 <- sum(g); n0 <- sum(!g); sp <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * v1 + (n0 - 1) * v0) / (n1 + n0 - 2))
  tstat <- (m1 - m0) / sqrt(v1 / n1 + v0 / n0)
  df <- (v1 / n1 + v0 / n0)^2 / ((v1 / n1)^2 / (n1 - 1) + (v0 / n0)^2 / (n0 - 1))
  tibble(Gene = colnames(X), d = (m1 - m0) / sp, shift = m1 - m0, p = 2 * pt(-abs(tstat), df))
}
sf_ovr <- purrr::map_dfr(subtype_levels, function(cl) purrr::map_dfr(names(sf_mats), function(md)
  sf_d_fun(sf_mats[[md]], y_full == cl) %>% mutate(Subtype = cl, Modality = md))) %>%
  group_by(Subtype, Modality) %>% mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup()
sf_wide <- sf_ovr %>% dplyr::select(Subtype, Gene, Modality, d, FDR) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Modality, values_from = c(d, FDR)) %>%
  mutate(gain = abs(d_Mismatch) - pmax(abs(d_RNA), abs(d_Protein)),
         mm_specific = gain > 0 & FDR_Mismatch < 0.05)
write.csv(sf_wide, file.path("table", "subtype_ovr_cohen_d_all_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# (A) 아형별 전체 유전자 요약
table_s22a <- sf_wide %>% group_by(Subtype) %>% summarise(
  N = sum(y_full == Subtype[1]),
  Sig_RNA = sum(FDR_RNA < 0.05), Sig_Protein = sum(FDR_Protein < 0.05), Sig_Mismatch = sum(FDR_Mismatch < 0.05),
  Mismatch_specific = sum(mm_specific), Share_specific = Mismatch_specific / dplyr::n(),
  Median_abs_d_RNA = median(abs(d_RNA)), Median_abs_d_Protein = median(abs(d_Protein)), Median_abs_d_Mismatch = median(abs(d_Mismatch)),
  Top100_mm_also_sig_protein = mean((FDR_Protein < 0.05)[order(-abs(d_Mismatch))[1:100]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Subtype = unname(subtype_label[Subtype]))
table_s22a

# (A2) 아형별 mismatch 상위 10개 (|d_mm| 순, FDR < 0.05)와 protein 편차 중 RNA(+공변량)가 설명하는 비율
sf_share_fun <- function(gene, cl) {
  g <- y_full == cl
  sp <- mean(specific_pr[g, gene]) - mean(specific_pr[!g, gene]); sf <- mean(fitted_full[g, gene]) - mean(fitted_full[!g, gene])
  sf / sp
}
table_s22a2 <- sf_wide %>% filter(FDR_Mismatch < 0.05) %>% group_by(Subtype) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(d_Mismatch)), .by_group = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number(), RNA_explained_share = mapply(sf_share_fun, Gene, Subtype)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Subtype, Rank, Gene, d_RNA, d_Protein, d_Mismatch, gain, mm_specific, RNA_explained_share)
table_s22a2

# (B) 교집합 16개 (예산 150) : 아형별 "눈에 띔" 검사
sf_iqr_sep_fun <- function(X, g, gene) { r <- X[!g, gene]; med <- median(X[g, gene]); med < quantile(r, .25) | med > quantile(r, .75) }
table_s22b <- purrr::map_dfr(subtype_levels, function(cl) {
  g <- y_full == cl
  o <- sf_ovr %>% filter(Subtype == cl, Gene %in% g_mm_block) %>% group_by(Modality) %>% mutate(FDR16 = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup()
  dp <- o %>% filter(Modality == "Protein"); dm <- o %>% filter(Modality == "Mismatch"); dr <- o %>% filter(Modality == "RNA")
  tibble(Subtype = unname(subtype_label[cl]), N = sum(g),
         Median_abs_d_RNA = median(abs(dr$d)), Median_abs_d_Protein = median(abs(dp$d)), Median_abs_d_Mismatch = median(abs(dm$d)),
         Sig16_RNA = sum(dr$FDR16 < 0.05), Sig16_Protein = sum(dp$FDR16 < 0.05), Sig16_Mismatch = sum(dm$FDR16 < 0.05),
         SD_ratio_MM_over_Protein = median(apply(specific_mm[g, g_mm_block], 2, sd) / apply(specific_pr[g, g_mm_block], 2, sd)),
         Median_RNA_explained_share = median(sapply(g_mm_block, sf_share_fun, cl = cl)),
         IQR_separated_Protein = sum(sapply(g_mm_block, function(ge) sf_iqr_sep_fun(specific_pr, g, ge))),
         IQR_separated_Mismatch = sum(sapply(g_mm_block, function(ge) sf_iqr_sep_fun(specific_mm, g, ge))),
         Same_sign_shift_Protein = max(table(sign(dp$shift))), Same_sign_shift_Mismatch = max(table(sign(dm$shift))))
})
table_s22b

# (C) 클래스 균형 표집 RF (OOB recall) : 표본 수(사전확률) 효과와 분리 가능성 효과를 구분
sf_rf_recall_fun <- function(X, balanced, seed = shap_seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  rf <- if (balanced) randomForest(X, y_full, ntree = shap_ntree, strata = y_full, sampsize = rep(min(table(y_full)), 4))
        else randomForest(X, y_full, ntree = shap_ntree)
  # 2026-11-18 : 주 지표(macro F1) 추가. OOB 예측(rf$predicted)을 섹션 4 공통 함수로 평가해
  # F1 계산 규칙(예측 0건 아형 = 0)을 본 분석과 맞춘다. Recall·MBA 값은 이전과 동일.
  m <- classification_metrics_fun(y_full, rf$predicted)
  c(setNames(m$ByClass$Recall, subtype_levels),
    Macro_F1 = unname(m$Overall["Macro_F1"]),
    MBA = unname(m$Overall["Macro_Balanced_Accuracy"]))
}
table_s22c <- purrr::map_dfr(c("Mismatch", "RNA", "Protein"), function(md) bind_rows(
  tibble(Model = paste0(md, "-only"), Sampling = "default (bootstrap of all 110)", t(sf_rf_recall_fun(sf_mats[[md]], FALSE)) %>% as_tibble()),
  tibble(Model = paste0(md, "-only"), Sampling = sprintf("balanced (%d per subtype per tree)", min(table(y_full))), t(sf_rf_recall_fun(sf_mats[[md]], TRUE)) %>% as_tibble())))
names(table_s22c)[3:6] <- paste0("Recall_", unname(subtype_label[subtype_levels]))
table_s22c

# Table S19 (A · A2 · B · C 한 문서)
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par(paste(
    "Table S19. Subtype-specific features of RNA-protein mismatch beyond Luminal B (full sample, n = 110; 2,970 genes).",
    "(A) For each subtype versus the other three, Welch t tests and Cohen's d were computed on the RNA, protein and mismatch values of every gene;",
    "Sig_: genes with BH-FDR < 0.05 within that modality; Mismatch_specific: genes with |d(mismatch)| > max(|d(RNA)|, |d(protein)|) and mismatch FDR < 0.05;",
    "Top100_mm_also_sig_protein: share of the 100 genes with the largest |d(mismatch)| that are also significant on protein.",
    "(A2, provided as Supplementary Data 6) The ten genes with the largest |d| on mismatch per subtype.",
    sprintf("(B) The same quantities for the %d fold-intersection mismatch markers (budget 150): median |d|, genes significant at BH-FDR < 0.05 over the markers,", n_match),
    "median ratio of the subtype's SD on mismatch to that on protein, median share of the protein shift predicted by RNA and covariates,",
    "number of genes whose subtype median lies outside the interquartile range of the other subtypes (IQR_separated), and the largest number of genes shifted in the same direction.",
    sprintf("(C) Out-of-bag recall, macro F1 (primary metric) and macro balanced accuracy (MBA, secondary) of full-sample random forests (ntree = %d, mtry = sqrt(p)) with the default bootstrap and with class-balanced sampling; out-of-bag values on full-sample mismatch residuals are not nested cross-validation estimates.", shap_ntree)),
    style = "heading 2") %>%
  body_add_par("(A) Genome-wide one-vs-rest comparison by subtype", style = "Normal") %>% body_add_flextable(iv_ft_fun(table_s22a, 1)) %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_par("(B) Fold-intersection mismatch markers by subtype", style = "Normal") %>% body_add_flextable(iv_ft_fun(table_s22b, 1)) %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_par("(C) Effect of class-balanced sampling on out-of-bag recall", style = "Normal") %>% body_add_flextable(iv_ft_fun(table_s22c, 2)) %>%
  body_end_section_landscape()
print(doc, target = file.path("table", "TableS19_Subtype_Mismatch_Features.docx"))
# Supplementary Data 6 (2026-10-20 분리) : (A2) 아형별 mismatch 상위 10개
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par(paste(
    "Supplementary Data 6. The ten genes with the largest |d| on mismatch for each subtype versus the other three (full sample, n = 110; mismatch FDR < 0.05);",
    "RNA_explained_share = shift of the fitted (RNA + covariates) part / shift of protein; mm_specific: |d(mismatch)| > max(|d(RNA)|, |d(protein)|). Plotted in Figure S6."),
    style = "heading 2") %>%
  body_add_flextable(iv_ft_fun(table_s22a2 %>% mutate(Subtype = unname(subtype_label[Subtype]), mm_specific = ifelse(mm_specific, "yes", "no")), 3)) %>%

print(doc, target = file.path("table", "SupplementaryData6_Subtype_Top10_Mismatch_Genes.docx"))

# Figure S6 : 아형별 mismatch 상위 10개 유전자의 RNA / Protein / Mismatch boxplot
sf_plot_df <- purrr::map_dfr(subtype_levels, function(cl) {
```

## 22. 본문 인용 수치 통합표와 세션 정보
```{r}
# 22-1. 본문 인용 수치 통합표 (Table_InText_Values : 부록 번호 없음)
#   아래 객체들은 그동안 콘솔에만 출력되어, 코드를 다시 돌렸을 때
#   논문 본문 수치와 대조할 방법이 없었다. 하나의 표로 묶어 파일로 남긴다.
#   (부록에 싣기 위한 표가 아니라 원고-코드 대조용 기록이다.)

# 3.2절에서 인용하는 pooled confusion matrix (RNA-only·Mismatch-only의 subtype별 정오 개수)
pooled_confusion_long <- purrr::map_dfr(model_names, function(model_name) {
  cm <- pooled_confusion_matrices[[model_name]]
  as.data.frame(cm, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(
      Model = model_name,
      Observed = as.character(Observed),
      Predicted = as.character(Predicted),
      N = as.numeric(Freq)
    )
})

# 3.4절(Table S1 문단)에서 인용하는 3-block sparse 모형의 outer fold별 최적 mtry 규칙
#   Outer_Fold는 식별자이므로 문자열로 두어 Item 열에 남긴다 (숫자로 두면 fold-규칙 짝이 사라짐)
sparse_mtry_rule_long <- sparse_mtry_rule_by_fold %>%
  transmute(Model, Outer_Fold = paste0("Fold ", Outer_Fold),
            Best_Mtry_Rule = as.numeric(Best_Mtry_Rule))

# Supplementary Note 3절에서 인용하는 필터 설정별 RNA-only macro F1 범위
gene_filter_baseline_long <- gene_filter_baseline_f1 %>%
  transmute(Setting, N_input_genes = as.numeric(N_input_genes), RNA_only_F1)
# id_cols : 숫자형이지만 값이 아니라 식별자인 열(예: Ntree)을 Item 쪽으로 보낼 때 지정
in_text_long_fun <- function(df, source_label, id_cols = character(0)) {
  df <- as_tibble(df)
  label_col <- names(df)[vapply(
    df, function(x) is.character(x) || is.factor(x), logical(1)
  )]
  label_col <- union(label_col, intersect(id_cols, names(df)))
  value_col <- setdiff(names(df), label_col)
  item <- if (length(label_col)) {
    do.call(paste, c(lapply(label_col, function(k) as.character(df[[k]])),
                     sep = " / "))
  } else {
    rep("", nrow(df))
  }
  purrr::map_dfr(value_col, function(k) tibble(
    Source = source_label,
    Item = item,
    Quantity = k,
    Value = as.numeric(df[[k]])
  ))
}
```
